title: Head of Sales - Japan
locations: Tokyo, Japan
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

At Square, our purpose is to build tools that help sellers start, run, and grow their businesses. What began as payments has evolved into a broad ecosystem of commerce solutions — including software, banking, financial services, and omnichannel capabilities designed to work together seamlessly.

Japan represents one of the most strategic growth opportunities for Square globally. It is a complex, highly competitive market with enormous potential across commerce, hospitality, retail, and services. We believe the opportunity ahead is significant — but winning in Japan will require bold commercial leadership, operational intensity, and a relentless focus on execution.

We are entering the next phase of growth in Japan with the ambition not just to participate in the market, but to build a category-defining business.

The Role

Square is seeking a Head of Sales for Japan to build and rapidly scale our commercial business in-market.

This leader will be responsible for accelerating revenue growth, increasing market penetration, and building a high-performing sales organization capable of winning at scale in one of the world’s most important and demanding commerce markets. This is a builder role for a commercially driven operator who thrives in fast-growth environments and knows how to turn opportunity into execution.

The ideal candidate combines deep enterprise and SMB commercial expertise with strong knowledge of the Japanese market, customer expectations, competitive landscape, and a strong bias for action. They know how to build strong teams, drive urgency, unlock new growth vectors, and push organizations to move faster and execute at a higher standard.

This role requires a leader who is highly motivated, commercially aggressive, and execution-oriented — someone who embraces ambitious goals, operates with intensity, and can help establish Square as a market leader in Japan.

What You’ll Lead

Growth & Commercial Expansion

  • Own overall revenue growth and market expansion strategy for Japan.
  • Build and execute an aggressive growth plan across SMB, mid-market, enterprise, and strategic verticals.
  • Identify and unlock new commercial opportunities, partnerships, channel strategies, and scalable go-to-market motions.
  • Develop and scale a high-performing channel and partner sales strategy to accelerate market penetration and revenue growth.
  • Build strong relationships with strategic channel partners, resellers, ISVs, and ecosystem players to expand Square’s reach and influence in Japan.
  • Drive pipeline generation, conversion, and expansion with a strong focus on execution velocity and measurable outcomes.
  • Increase competitive win rates and establish Square as a differentiated leader in the Japanese market.
  • Develop clear market segmentation and prioritization strategies to maximize growth and resource allocation.
  • Build scalable commercial motions that support rapid long-term expansion in Japan.

Sales Leadership & Operational Excellence

  • Lead and scale a high-performing, multi-layered sales organization across Japan.
  • Create a culture of accountability, urgency, resilience, and execution excellence.
  • Raise the talent bar through strong hiring, coaching, performance management, and leadership development.
  • Improve sales productivity, forecasting accuracy, and operational rigor across the organization.
  • Build repeatable sales motions and operating mechanisms that enable scale.
  • Drive disciplined execution while maintaining agility in a fast-moving market.

Market Leadership & Strategic Influence

  • Serve as one of Square’s senior commercial leaders in Japan and represent the voice of the market internally.
  • Partner closely with Product, Marketing, Partnerships, Customer Success, and Global Sales leaders to accelerate growth and unlock new opportunities.
  • Influence regional and global strategy through strong market insight and customer understanding.
  • Build strong executive-level relationships with key customers, partners, and ecosystem stakeholders.
  • Help shape Square’s long-term market position and brand presence in Japan.

Cross-Functional & Global Collaboration

  • Partner closely with international sales and GTM leaders to share best practices and accelerate learning across markets.
  • Ensure Japan both benefits from and contributes to Square’s global commercial strategy and innovation.
  • Collaborate effectively across time zones, functions, and cultures to drive alignment and execution.
  • Balance strong local market judgment with global operating standards and strategic priorities.

We’re Looking For

  • 15+ years of sales and commercial leadership experience, including significant experience scaling high-growth businesses.
  • Proven track record of rapidly growing revenue and taking market share in highly competitive environments.
  • Strong builder mentality with experience creating and scaling organizations, GTM motions, and commercial infrastructure from the ground up.
  • Deep commercial expertise across complex sales environments, including SMB, mid-market, enterprise, strategic partnerships, and channel sales.
  • Strong experience building and scaling channel sales, strategic partnerships, and indirect go-to-market motions in complex and competitive markets.
  • Proven ability to leverage partner ecosystems to accelerate growth, increase distribution, and drive commercial scale.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity, move with urgency, and drive operational discipline at scale.
  • Strong executive presence with the ability to influence cross-functional and global stakeholders.
  • Experience operating within global organizations and navigating cross-cultural environments.
  • Deep understanding of the Japanese commerce, payments, SaaS, or technology landscape strongly preferred.
  • Fluency in Japanese and English preferred.

Why This Role Matters

Japan is one of Square’s most important long-term growth markets globally. The opportunity is substantial, but success will require a leader who can build aggressively, execute decisively, and scale a world-class commercial organization.

This role is not about maintaining the status quo. It is about accelerating growth, increasing market share, building competitive advantage, and creating a durable commercial engine for the future.

The right leader will combine strategic thinking with operational intensity. They will build strong teams, move quickly, raise standards, and help establish Square as a market leader in Japan.

title: Senior Security Engineer, Platform Security
locations: Bay Area, CA, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
Block builds simple, powerful tools that make progress towards an economy that’s truly open to all.

Each of our brands unlocks different aspects of the economy for more people. Square makes commerce and financial services accessible to sellers. Cash App is the easy way to spend, send, and store money. Afterpay is transforming the way customers manage their spending over time. TIDAL is a music platform that empowers artists to thrive as entrepreneurs. Bitkey is a simple self-custody wallet built for bitcoin. Proto is a suite of bitcoin mining products and services. Together, we’re helping build a financial system that is open to everyone. Join us.

The Role

The Platform Security team is responsible for securing Block's cloud, compute, and network infrastructure across multiple business units including Square, Cash, and Afterpay.

We discover, track, and enable the business to remediate the most critical security risks across Block's cloud ecosystems (AWS and GCP). We drive the creation of cloud security policy and best practices, measure and aggregate deviations from these policies, and develop capabilities to estimate security risk based on cloud signals and business context. This work drives Block's cloud security strategy and is the lens through which Block measures progress of our cloud security posture over time.

We believe that the secure option should be the easiest option for our users. We're looking for a strong Senior Platform Security Engineer with a deep understanding of securing cloud infrastructure and services at scale to help us execute on this vision.

You Will

  • Build security guardrails across our infrastructure. Design and deploy controls for cloud resources, compute workloads, and network traffic across AWS, GCP, and hybrid environments.
  • Strengthen cloud security. Improve IAM and organization-level policies, automate the discovery and prioritization of misconfigurations and sensitive data exposures, and evolve security exception workflows.
  • Secure workloads from build to runtime. Improve Kubernetes and container isolation, protect CI/CD secrets and permissions, and strengthen image signing and software supply chain controls.
  • Protect service connectivity. Develop network segmentation, ingress and egress policies, firewall controls, and edge protections that reduce exposure while supporting business needs.
  • Write and operate production software. Build tested, maintainable services, integrations, and infrastructure-as-code that make security controls reliable and manageable at scale.
  • Partner with platform and application teams to embed secure defaults into shared infrastructure and eliminate recurring categories of risk.
  • Use security findings, operational telemetry, and business context to prioritize improvements and measure their effectiveness.
  • Participate in the Platform Security on-call rotation, troubleshoot issues across infrastructure layers, and turn recurring support needs into automation and self-service capabilities.
  • Lead projects from design through rollout, document technical decisions, and share expertise through mentoring and engineering reviews.

You Have

  • 8+ years of experience as a software, infrastructure, or security engineer, including 4+ years securing production infrastructure at scale.
  • Hands-on experience securing production infrastructure in AWS and/or GCP.
  • Deep expertise in infrastructure security, with the ability to apply your knowledge across unfamiliar systems and technologies.
  • A solid understanding of infrastructure security fundamentals, including least privilege, workload isolation, network segmentation, and secure service communication.
  • Strong programming skills in Python, Go, or a similar language, with experience building and maintaining production tooling or services.
  • Experience using Terraform or similar infrastructure-as-code tools to manage controls through reviewed, tested, and staged changes.
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver complex projects and make practical tradeoffs between security risk, reliability, and developer experience.
  • Clear communication and troubleshooting skills, including working with people outside security to resolve ambiguous problems.
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools in engineering workflows while taking responsibility for validating code, tests, and security implications.

Bonus If You Have

  • Experience delivering security improvements that span multiple infrastructure layers and teams.
  • Familiarity with cloud security posture management (CSPM), data security posture management (DSPM), security metrics, or automated exception workflows.
  • Experience operating controls across large multi-account, multi-project, or shared Kubernetes environments.
  • Experience supporting multiple business units with different infrastructure, compliance, and regulatory requirements

title: Senior Partnerships Manager, Australia
locations: Melbourne, Australia
descriptionHtml:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn't work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we've embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We're building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

The Role

Square is seeking a Senior Partnerships Manager to develop and own a portfolio of Square's strategic partners in Australia. This role reports to the Partnerships Lead, APAC.

The role will involve designing, negotiating, and scaling partnerships for Australia as the primary focus, but with a view to install best practices globally where opportunities present themselves. This is primarily a Business Development role, though deep expertise in partner management is required.

Partners within the Australian portfolio include referral networks, distributors, service providers, technology platforms, and strategic ecosystems where there's mutual benefit to sellers through lead generation, co-sell, co-marketing, and product enablement. You'll use your deep payments knowledge and creativity to land win-win deals across all partner types.

This is a senior individual contributor role at the intersection of business development, growth, product, and go-to-market strategy. You will set the vision for your assigned partner portfolio. You will then work globally and cross-functionally, using your payments and relationships expertise to turn your vision into business outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Sourcing & Negotiation: Evaluate and secure high-impact partners and where required, identify and qualify them; lead executive-level negotiations and close deals that advance our capabilities and growth.
  • Cross-Functional Execution: Partner with Product, Operations, Marketing, Sales, and Legal to ensure smooth execution and maximum impact.
  • Growth Accountability: Deliver measurable results in lead generation, seller acquisition, and pipeline contribution through strategic partnerships.
  • Activation & Scaling: Launch product partnerships with clear GTM plans, co-marketing initiatives, and integrated roadmaps where relevant.
  • Executive Relationship Management: Build and sustain C-level relationships with partners, ensuring long-term value creation.
  • Measurement & Optimization: Define and track KPIs for partnership success, adjusting strategy as needed to drive continuous growth.

You Have

  • 8+ years in the payments space across roles such as business development, strategic partnerships, and/or product partnerships 
  • Proven track record of structuring, launching and scaling high-impact partnerships, and where required, sourcing such partnerships
  • Strong negotiation and relationship management skills, with extensive experience working at the executive level.
  • Demonstrated ability to connect partnership strategy directly to measurable seller acquisition and revenue outcomes.
  • Experience working cross-functionally with global teams and functions, with a proven ability to thrive in this environment by collaborating globally in order to execute locally.
  • SaaS, fintech, or payments background strongly preferred. Whilst eCommerce experience will be valued highly, in-store experience is preferred.

descriptionHtml:

title: Enterprise Account Executive, Australia
locations: Sydney, Australia
descriptionHtml:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

The Role

As an Enterprise Account Executive you will lead Square’s expansion into the country’s most strategic sellers.

This is a high-impact role for a proven enterprise seller who can identify the right opportunities, build strong executive relationships, and drive complex deals from first engagement through launch.

You will own accounts end-to-end—setting account strategy, generating pipeline, and closing high-value deals across multi-stakeholder buying groups with urgency. You’ll partner closely with Solutions Engineering, Product, Partnerships, Legal, and Finance to bring the full Square ecosystem to market.

We’re looking for someone who combines strong commercial judgment with disciplined execution, and who raises the bar on how enterprise deals are run.

You Will

  • Own a targeted set of enterprise accounts Set clear priorities and be accountable for pipeline quality, deal progression, and closed revenue across your account set.
  • Define and execute a clear account strategy Focus on the highest-impact opportunities and consistently convert pipeline into high-value wins.
  • Lead complex, multi-stakeholder deals end-to-end Navigate executive, technical, and commercial stakeholders to drive alignment, accelerate decisions, and close deals at pace.
  • Develop strong, insight-led account POVs Translate Square’s platform into differentiated value that advances deals and improves win rates.
  • Run a disciplined, detail-oriented sales process Maintain momentum across long cycles, qualify rigorously, and increase conversion at each stage of the funnel.
  • Partner cross-functionally to win Work across Solutions Engineering, Product, Partnerships, Legal, and Finance to remove blockers and close complex deals effectively.
  • Represent Square with credibility at senior levels Build trusted relationships with executives that unlock access, influence decisions, and drive long-term partnerships.

You Have

  • 8+ years of enterprise or strategic sales experience, with a consistent track record of exceeding targets and closing complex, high-value deals with full ownership
  • Proven ability to build, qualify, and convert pipeline within a focused account set, with strong judgment on where to invest time and why
  • Deep experience leading multi-threaded enterprise deals, navigating executive, technical, and procurement stakeholders with clarity and control
  • Strong commercial acumen, with the ability to structure and negotiate deals thoughtfully across pricing, scope, and long-term value
  • Executive presence and credibility—you communicate with precision, challenge constructively, and earn trust with senior decision-makers
  • Experience selling a complex platform, SaaS, fintech, or payments solution into large or operationally sophisticated organisations
  • A high standard for execution: you are disciplined, prepared, and follow through consistently, especially in long and ambiguous sales cycles
  • A strong sense of ownership—you take responsibility for outcomes, not just activity, and operate effectively without heavy structure
  • The ability to simplify complexity and drive clarity, both externally with customers and internally across teams

title: Finance & Strategy Manager
locations: New York, NY, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
Block builds simple, powerful tools that make progress towards an economy that's truly open to all. Each of our brands unlocks different aspects of the economy for more people. Square makes commerce and financial services accessible to sellers. Cash App is the easy way to spend, send, and store money. Afterpay is transforming the way customers manage their spending over time. TIDAL is a music platform that empowers artists to thrive as entrepreneurs. Bitkey is a simple self-custody wallet built for bitcoin. Proto is a suite of bitcoin mining products and services. Together, we're helping build a financial system that is open to everyone. Join us.

The Role

We are seeking a Finance & Strategy Manager to join Block's Business Strategic Finance team, supporting our largest strategic commercial partnerships. You'll partner with Financial Operations, Product, Data Science, and Legal to shape the commercial agreements that underpin Square, Cash App, and Afterpay, spanning payment networks, banks, and processors. Your work will directly influence how Block negotiates, prices, and forecasts the costs that flow through every transaction we process. You'll report to a Finance & Strategy Lead within Block's Business Strategic Finance team.

This is a hands-on, high-impact role. You'll shape Block's approach to its most important partners, lead the modeling behind high-stakes negotiations, and own the forecast for one of Block's largest cost lines. Success requires deep analytical rigor, intellectual curiosity, the ability to navigate ambiguity, and the confidence to drive change even when playbooks don't yet exist.

Candidates can sit in any Block office in the US or be remote from any US state with the exception of Alaska.

You Will

  • Act as the key Strategic Finance partner for Block's commercial partnership portfolio, owning the financial and strategic narrative for how we manage these relationships and where we take them next.
  • Develop Block's point of view on where value sits across our partner relationships, drawing on market trends, competitive intelligence, and internal data to shape what we should be negotiating for and when.
  • Lead the financial modeling and deal advisory behind major partner negotiations (pricing tiers, volume commitments, incentive mechanics), from initial framing through term sheet to signed agreement.
  • Forecast variable costs across brands, and explain the drivers behind volume and mix shifts that move the rate we pay.
  • Drive cross-functional strategic projects (Financial Operations, Product, Data Science, Legal, Accounting) from problem framing through recommendation and execution.
  • Distill complex findings into concise narratives and visualizations for executive-level decisions.
  • Champion rigorous analytics, building dashboards, SQL queries, and automated reporting to surface insights at scale.

You Have

  • 5+ years in investment banking, private equity, strategic or corporate finance, or management consulting (tech or financial-services focus is a plus)
  • Experience building the financial analysis behind a commercial negotiation, contract, or partnership, including modeling deal structures and pricing mechanics, and translating signed terms into a forecast.
  • Demonstrated intellectual curiosity: you probe beneath the surface and connect seemingly disparate data to form a strategic point of view.
  • Ability to build a point of view from incomplete information: reading market and competitive signals, forming a recommendation, and defending it with senior stakeholders.
  • Mastery of Excel / Google Sheets and comfort with SQL and modern AI-assisted analytics tools.
  • Track record of owning work end to end, from an ambiguous starting question through to decision-making.
  • Experience leading projects with multiple cross-functional partners in fast-paced environments.
  • Passion for Block's broader purpose of Economic Empowerment and a commitment to building inclusive financial products.

locations: New York, NY, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
Block is one company built from many blocks, all united by the same purpose: economic empowerment. We build technology that increases access and independence for sellers, individuals, and artists around the world. Working at Block means working on and across our brands—Square, Cash App, Afterpay, TIDAL, Spiral, and Proto— in roles that connect, enable, and push all of them forward faster.

The Role

Our Strategic Finance team improves financial and operational decision-making across Square. Our team's core value is trust - we build it by making what is complex simple, and we do it with analysis that is accurate and easy-to-understand. Partners appreciate our insight and trust us to help solve difficult problems. title: SMB Account Manager
locations: Tokyo, Japan
descriptionHtml:
The Role

The Account Management team is looking for a motivated account manager or sales professional to join our SMB team and help our merchants retain, grow, and get more from Square's platform. In this role, you'll own a portfolio of small and medium-sized business customers, engaging with them at high-stakes moments in their journey — whether that's preventing churn, unlocking a new product, or helping them see what's possible with Square.

You'll be equal parts advisor and problem-solver: diagnosing customer needs, deploying retention and growth strategies, and acting as a connector between the seller and the broader Square team. This isn't a reactive support role — you'll proactively manage your book with urgency and intent, building playbooks and narratives that move the needle.

The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, loves the challenge of hard conversations, and cares deeply about small business success. You bring a track record in account management or sales, a natural curiosity for how products work, and the ability to turn insight into action.

You Will

  • Own a multi-million dollar, dynamic portfolio of SMB merchants across all verticals,  you set the strategy, drive the outcomes, and are accountable for every number in your book
  • Obsess over retention: develop a deep understanding of your merchants' businesses, identify churn risk before it surfaces, and deploy commercially precise strategies that consistently convert high-risk moments into durable, long-term wins
  • Think and act like a GM of your book: managing a high-velocity pipeline, closing upsell, cross-sell, and contract adoption opportunities with the discipline of someone who knows exactly where each deal stands and what it takes to move it forward
  • Earn trust by delivering results: build relationships with business owners where you are the first call when something matters, because you've proven you see their business clearly and act in their interest
  • Lean into hard conversations: own competitive threats, commercial pushback, and escalations with clarity and conviction, and walk away with a stronger partnership every time
  • Raise the bar for the team: write the post-mortems others learn from, build the talk tracks others adopt, and develop the playbooks that outlast you in the role
  • Use data to drive decisions: translate portfolio-level patterns into sharp, specific recommendations that influence how Square builds and goes to market for SMB merchants
  • Close the loop cross-functionally: partner with Sales, Support, Product, and Analytics to solve problems structurally and prevent recurrence

You Have

  • 5+ years in account management, sales, or a related client-facing role, with a clear track record of delivering against retention and revenue goals in a performance-based environment
  • Experience managing a dynamic, high-volume book and closing both retention and growth opportunities simultaneously, you stay organised under pressure and know how to prioritise
  • Strong negotiation skills built through real commercial experience, you're comfortable in difficult conversations, find creative paths forward, and keep the relationship intact in the process
  • The ability to communicate clearly and persuasively, in writing, in a pitch, or in a tough conversation with a merchant who's ready to leave
  • Solid financial and analytical skills; you use data to understand your book, size opportunities, and make a case for the resources or decisions you need
  • A collaborative instinct, you work well across Sales, Product, Support, and Analytics, and you bring useful context to those conversations rather than just escalating problems
  • A habit of reflection, you write up what went wrong, share what you've learned, and use it to do better next time
  • A real interest in small business and the challenges SMB owners face day to day, it shows in how you show up for your merchants
  • Language requirement: Native Japanese and business-level English

Bonus Points

  • Formal sales methodology training 
  • Experience with fintech, payments, or SaaS platforms
  • A history of contributing to team playbooks, talk tracks, or process improvements

title: Senior Manager, Strategic Finance, Commerce Go-to-Market
locations: Bay Area, CA, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
It all started with an idea at Block in 2013. Initially built to take the pain out of peer-to-peer payments, Cash App has gone from a simple product with a single purpose to a dynamic ecosystem, developing unique financial products, including Afterpay/Clearpay, to provide a better way to send, spend, invest, borrow and save to our 50+ million monthly active customers. We want to redefine the world’s relationship with money to make it more relatable, instantly available, and universally accessible.

Today, Cash App has thousands of employees working globally across office and remote locations, with a culture geared toward innovation, collaboration and impact. We’ve been a distributed team since day one, and many of our roles can be done remotely from the countries where Cash App operates. No matter the location, we tailor our experience to ensure our employees are creative, productive, and happy.

The Role

The Go-To-Market Strategic Finance team partners with leaders across Sales, Marketing, Partnerships, Revenue Operations, Product, and Data to shape how we invest in growth. As Senior Finance Manager, Commerce Go-to-Market, you will partner with the Global Head of Revenue for Cash App, Afterpay, and Clearpay. You will lead financial planning, forecasting, performance management, and investment analysis for the organization. 

You Will

  • Serve as the primary finance partner to Commerce go-to-market leaders, supporting day-to-day decisions and long-term strategy.
  • Lead annual planning, quarterly forecasting, and ongoing performance management across revenue, gross profit, headcount, operating expenses, and key commercial metrics.
  • Build driver-based forecasts that connect pipeline, conversion, sales capacity, productivity, pricing, product adoption, transaction activity, and retention to financial outcomes.
  • Evaluate investments across Sales, Marketing, Partnerships, channels, and customer segments using business cases, scenario analysis, and return-on-investment frameworks.
  • Prepare concise, decision-ready materials for senior leaders and company planning processes.
  • Lead and develop finance team members while remaining directly involved in the team’s highest-impact analyses and deliverables.

You Have

  • 8+ years of relevant experience in strategic finance, financial planning and analysis, sales or go-to-market finance, investment banking, consulting, or a related analytical role.
  • Experience partnering with Sales, Marketing, Partnerships, Revenue Operations, or another commercial organization.
  • Experience leading financial planning and performance analysis, with strong modeling skills across forecasting, resource allocation, scenario analysis, and investment returns.
  • Strong analytical ability, experience working with complex models, large datasets, and analysis tools (SQL, Python)
  • AI-fluency including analysis, insight generation, process automation and improvement.
  • Experience in payments, financial technology, merchant services, marketplaces, commerce, or another transaction-based business is helpful.
  • 2+ years of people-management experience, including coaching and developing finance professionals.

title: Manager, Mid-Market Sales
locations: Bay Area, CA, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn't work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we've embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We're building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

The Role

We’re building a team of elite sales leaders who raise the performance of everyone around them.

As a Senior Sales Manager, you'll lead a team of approximately 10 Senior Account Executives while owning one of our most important growth levers: developing talent that consistently outperforms expectations. This role isn't about managing activity, it's about building a high-performance sales organization where every hire strengthens the team, every coaching conversation improves execution, and every business decision is grounded in data.

You'll lead our most experienced Account Executives, AEs with 5+ years of full-cycle closing experience, on a fully outbound team where pipeline is strategic and self-sourced across executive networks, partnerships, trade shows, intent data, and more. Your reps own the execution. You sharpen the strategy behind it, and you coach in the work rather than after it. That means diagnosing pipeline health before it becomes a forecasting problem, developing future leaders before promotions become necessary, and building playbooks and an operating rhythm that makes growth predictable.

You'll partner cross-functionally to improve how we sell, challenge the status quo, and continuously raise the talent bar across the organization. Success is measured not only by quota attainment, but by the strength of your team, the quality of your pipeline, and the leaders you develop.

You Will

  • Build a High-Performance Team
    • Hire exceptional Account Executives and raise the talent bar with every addition to your team. 
    • Develop a culture of ownership, accountability, continuous learning and high standards. 
    • Identify future top performers early and create development plans that accelerate their growth. 
  • Coach Through Data & Business Intelligence
    • Lead your business through rigorous pipeline inspection, forecasting and performance diagnostics. 
    • Use leading indicators to identify performance gaps early and coach reps toward sustainable improvement. 
    • Turn data into action by identifying trends, diagnosing root causes and driving measurable improvements across your team. 
  • Drive Operational Excellence 
    • Establish predictable operating rhythms around forecasting, pipeline management and business reviews. 
    • Build disciplined education that creates consistent, repeatable revenue outcomes. 
    • Continuously improve how your team sells by refining processes, simplifying execution and eliminating friction. 
  • Lead Through Influence 
    • Partner closing with sales Leadership, Marketing, Enablement, Operations and Product to improve the customer journey and strengthen commercial execution. 
    • Use customer insights and field intelligence to shape strategy and influence product evolution. 
    • Lead through change by helping your team adapt quickly while maintaining high performance. 

You Have

  • 7+ years experience as a sales manager. 
  • 3 years of documented sales success as an individual contributor exceeding target. 
  • A proven track record leading high-performing sales teams in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
  • Experience leading an outbound-led team, with the ability to coach outbound as a strategy: ICP targeting, multi-channel approach, and pipeline quality over sheer volume, rather than as an activity metric.
  • Success developing Account Executives into top performers through structured coaching and clear performance expectations.
  • Deep expertise in pipeline management, forecasting, and using data to improve business outcomes.
  • Demonstrated experience hiring exceptional talent and building teams that consistently outperform.
  • Strong business judgment with the ability to balance short-term execution and long-term organizational health.

title: Principal Security Engineer
locations: Bay Area, CA, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
Block is one company built from many blocks, all united by the same purpose of economic empowerment. The blocks that form our foundational teams — People, Finance, Counsel, Hardware, Information Security, Platform Infrastructure Engineering, and more — provide support and guidance at the corporate level. They work across business groups and around the globe, spanning time zones and disciplines to develop inclusive People policies, forecast finances, give legal counsel, safeguard systems, nurture new initiatives, and more. Every challenge creates possibilities, and we need different perspectives to see them all. Bring yours to Block.

The Role

As a Principal Security Engineer focused on Software Security Engineering at Block, you will be a technical leader reporting to the CISO responsible for setting the bar for security excellence and driving the creation of innovative, world-class software solutions to complex security problems. You will work across Engineering and Information Security (InfoSec) to champion a "Secure by Design" culture, directly influencing the architecture of Block's core products and infrastructure. Your mandate is to provide deep technical expertise and strategic direction to ensure that security is enabling fast, secure innovation across the business.

You Will

  • Software Security Innovation: Deliver world-class and innovative software solutions to security problems, tackling Block's top risks such as technology fragmentation and security after-the-fact.
  • Technical Strategy & Architecture: Define the multi-year technical strategy for software security at Block, guiding architectural decisions and ensuring alignment with engineering best practices.
  • Cross-Cutting Solution Leadership: Identify and lead the development and implementation of common, high-leverage security solutions and infrastructure across Block's business units (Square, Cash App, TBD, etc.) to combat data sprawl and overpermissioning.
  • Drive engineering excellence, specifically around security, for critical systems like tokenization platforms, ensuring integrity, performance, and scalability.
  • Spearhead the security strategy and engineering excellence for mobile software and platforms across Block's product ecosystem.
  • Champion security reliability engineering (SecRelEng) practices to improve the overall resilience and availability of security services and infrastructure.
  • Execution Excellence: Lead technical planning and implementation for high-priority security initiatives, acting as a technical decision maker/tie-breaker and upholding high technical standards.
  • Consultation & Guidance: Partner with engineering leaders to integrate security practices early into the development lifecycle (Secure SDLC) and provide security architecture review and threat modeling for critical systems.
  • Mentorship & Enablement: Foster technical excellence within InfoSec and mentor engineers on technical execution, system design, and technology choices, driving knowledge sharing and documentation.

You Have

  • Track record of exemplary technical leadership and decision-making at a Principal or equivalent level (L8+ technical capabilities preferred).
  • 10+ years of experience developing and shipping production software and critical services, with a minimum of 5 years focused on establishing and scaling security practices in a large, modern technology environment.
  • Mastery of system design and architecture, with demonstrable experience solving ambiguous, domain-heavy problems by structuring the approach, clarifying scope, and driving clarity among stakeholders.
  • Deep technical understanding of security vulnerabilities, risks, countermeasures, and compensating controls, particularly in high-volume, real-time transaction processing environments.
  • Exceptional collaboration and communication skills, with proven ability to influence executive leadership and direct engineering teams in prioritizing security roadmap items to balance security and business risks.
  • Demonstrable ability to write production-quality code/script for security automation and tooling.

Preferred: 

  • Experience leading and driving significant technical initiatives across multiple team, organizational and product boundaries.
  • Experience in the financial technology, payments, or cryptocurrency/bitcoin domain, reflecting Block's unique security characteristics.
  • Experience improving engineering standards and practices for security, and building systems to achieve sub-linear growth of security resources relative to the business (Design for Leverage, Not Coverage).

Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

The Role

As the Senior Manager, GTM Strategy & Operations, you'll be a strategic partner to Square's Revenue leaders and own the most consequential decisions shaping how our go-to-market organization is structured, prioritized, and scaled across the full seller lifecycle — from acquisition and conversion through retention, expansion, and portfolio growth. You'll partner with senior leaders across Sales, Account Management, Partnerships, Finance, Data Science, Marketing, Product, and Engineering to translate company priorities into clear GTM direction and shape the bets that define Square's revenue trajectory.

This is a hands-on strategic role. You'll define the right questions, bring an independent point of view on where our GTM motions need to evolve, and influence executive decisions through structured frameworks, operational rigor, and sharp written narrative. You'll also stay close to execution — building prototypes, owning complex cross-functional workstreams end-to-end, and raising the analytical bar across the team.

Your work will shape planning and investment strategy, the operating cadence of Revenue leadership, the design of Square's GTM motion across segmentation and coverage, and the executive narrative that aligns cross-functional partners around our most important bets. This role is designed to flex across the Revenue organization — anchored in Strategy & Ops with scope that can shift across acquisition and post-sale motions based on where the business most needs leverage. You will report to the Director of GTM Strategy & Operations and will mentor junior members of the team.

Key Responsibilities

GTM Strategy 

  • Serve as a thought partner to senior Revenue leaders, helping shape business priorities, resource allocation, and performance strategy across the GTM organization.
  • Partner with Revenue leadership and Finance to design the GTM motion — including segmentation, territory and coverage models, engagement strategies, and the operating playbooks that scale across acquisition and post-sale.
  • Own complex, cross-functional strategic initiatives end-to-end: problem framing, business case, stakeholder alignment, execution, and post-launch measurement.

Performance & Business Insights

  • Analyze pipeline, productivity, and lifecycle performance data to diagnose gaps and surface initiatives that improve conversion, deal velocity, retention, and expansion outcomes.
  • Partner with Data Science and Finance to define KPIs, build executive-ready dashboards, and own the WBR/MBR cadence that keeps Revenue leadership close to the business.
  • Translate complex analyses into executive-ready performance narratives and recommendations that drive leadership decisions and shape strategic bets.

Cross-Functional Execution & Program Management

  • Lead cross-functional workstreams across the Revenue organization and its partner teams, driving clarity, alignment, and structure through ambiguity.
  • Translate business goals into clear technical requirements (PRDs/BRDs) and partner with technical teams to deliver programs on time and to spec.
  • Break large, multi-quarter initiatives into pilots and iterations; manage the roadmap in collaboration with leadership and cross-functional partners.

AI, Automation & Process Innovation

  • Identify and champion AI-native opportunities to increase rep productivity across the full seller lifecycle — from prospecting and acquisition through portfolio management, retention, and expansion.
  • Partner with CRM, Systems, and Engineering on the design of process, policy, and system architecture, including routing, SLAs, rules of engagement, segmentation, and handoffs.
  • Stay at the frontier of AI-native GTM tooling and bring proven new approaches into the team's playbook.
  • Raise the AI-native operating bar across the GTM Strategy & Ops team — model what hands-on AI fluency looks like for other operators.

Team Leadership & Craft

  • Mentor junior members of the GTM Strategy & Ops team; raise the bar on analytical rigor, written communication, and executive-ready output.

• • Model the operating standards (ownership, bias to action, builder mindset) that define how the team works.

You have:

  • 8+ years of related experience with a Bachelor's degree; or 6 years and a Master's degree; or a PhD with 3 years experience; or equivalent experience in GTM / Revenue Strategy & Operations, Business Operations, or Management Consulting — ideally within SaaS, FinTech, or high-growth technology.
  • Proven track record of leading global, cross-functional strategic initiatives that drive measurable revenue, retention, or expansion outcomes.
  •  Demonstrated ability to influence executive-level stakeholders through structured analysis, clear narratives, and strong business judgment.
  •  Strong commercial instincts; comfort tying strategic decisions to investment prioritization and revenue outcomes.
  •  AI-native operating mindset: fluent with AI/LLMs in day-to-day work, hands-on with workflow automation, and energized by shipping real tools that remove manual work from the team.
  •  Expertise in CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce), GTM analytics tools (Looker, Snowflake, or equivalents), and SQL for independent data analysis.
  •  Executive-ready written and verbal communication — able to distill complex analyses into clear leadership narratives and board-level recommendations.

title: Manager, KYC Due Diligence Policy & Strategy
locations: Denver, CO, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
It all started with an idea at Block in 2013. Initially built to take the pain out of peer-to-peer payments, Cash App has gone from a simple product with a single purpose to a dynamic ecosystem, developing unique financial products, including Afterpay/Clearpay, to provide a better way to send, spend, invest, borrow and save to our 50+ million monthly active customers. We want to redefine the world’s relationship with money to make it more relatable, instantly available, and universally accessible.

Today, Cash App has thousands of employees working globally across office and remote locations, with a culture geared toward innovation, collaboration and impact. We’ve been a distributed team since day one, and many of our roles can be done remotely from the countries where Cash App operates. No matter the location, we tailor our experience to ensure our employees are creative, productive, and happy.

The Role

The Customer Onboarding team, part of Block's Financial Crimes organization, protects Block's ecosystem through the protocols that govern secure customer onboarding, ongoing monitoring and EDD, and compliant account restoration. As an enterprise role, the KYC Due Diligence Policy and Strategy Manager sets KYC policy and strategy for Block, Inc. as a whole — spanning Square, Cash App, TIDAL, and other business lines — combining policy expertise with practical implementation to strengthen KYC processes, with particular emphasis on identity verification and EDD.

You Will

  • Lead the development, review, and maintenance of enterprise KYC policies, standards, supplementary guidance, and exception requests
  • Monitor regulatory change, assess impact on existing KYC frameworks, and keep global standards aligned with local requirements
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to implement KYC requirements, and advise compliance technology teams on the policy requirements shaping KYC solutions
  • Define policy requirements, guardrails, and validation criteria for AI/ML-driven risk-based segmentation and identity verification — and advise where automation is and isn't appropriate for KYC decisioning
  • Monitor KYC metrics and program performance to assess effectiveness, enhance controls, and identify process improvements
  • Serve as subject matter expert to business units and to legal, audit, and risk partners; participate in governance forums and support regulatory examinations and internal audits
  • Identify, escalate, and help remediate KYC compliance risks, including those specific to AI/automation such as model drift, bias, false positives/negatives, and explainability gaps

You Have

  • 10+ years in BSA/AML/KYC compliance or compliance operations at a financial services firm, preferably payments or fintech
  • A track record of influencing enterprise-wide compliance programs and advising executive leadership on complex regulatory matters
  • Strong knowledge of compliance regulations, risks, and typologies, paired with an analytical, metrics-driven approach to building substantiated solutions
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills and the organizational skills to manage competing priorities in an agile, fast-paced environment
  • The ability to execute independently and at a high level while working effectively with team members at all levels
  • Demonstrated AI fluency: framing ambiguous compliance problems for AI, critically evaluating outputs for gaps, bias, or risk, and using AI to accelerate execution without compromising quality or compliance standards
  • Preferred: experience engaging federal or international banking regulators, relevant certifications (CAMS, CFE, CFCS, CRCM), and exposure to AI/ML-driven compliance or risk-decisioning tools

title: Chargé de Compte PME
locations: Toronto, Ontario, Canada
descriptionHtml:
Depuis nos débuts en 2009, le monde du commerce a énormément évolué. Square aussi. Après avoir permis à tout un chacun d’encaisser les paiements et de ne jamais rater une vente, nous avons remarqué que les commerçants étaient ralentis par des produits et des outils disparates et obsolètes qui ne fonctionnent pas harmonieusement.

Nous nous sommes donc lancés dans le développement de logiciels et avons créé des solutions intégrées et omnicanales afin d’aider les commerçants à vendre en ligne, à gérer leurs stocks, à proposer la fonctionnalité « Achetez maintenant, payez plus tard », à fixer des rendez-vous, à fidéliser leurs clients et à embaucher et payer leurs employés. À travers tout cela, nous avons intégré des outils de services financiers au système de caisse, afin que les commerçants puissent accéder à un prêt commercial et gérer leur trésorerie en un seul endroit. Afterpay contribue à notre objectif de fournir des outils omnicanaux qui génèrent une valeur et une croissance significatives, permettant aux commerçants d’attirer la prochaine génération d’acheteurs, d’augmenter le volume des commandes et d’être compétitifs à plus grande échelle.

Aujourd’hui, nous sommes le partenaire de commerces de toutes tailles, de grandes entreprises aux opérations complexes, de vendeurs qui débutent, ainsi que de commerçants qui ont commencé à vendre avec Square et qui se sont développés au fil du temps. Nos solutions évoluent au même rythme que nos commerçants. Une opportunité incroyable s’offre à nous. Nous construisons une entreprise importante, significative et durable, et nous aidons des commerçants du monde entier à faire de même

Le poste

Chez Square, nous réinventons la façon dont les petites et moyennes entreprises se développent. En tant que chargé de compte PME, vous convertirez des leads intéressés de grande qualité en clients à long terme, tout en recherchant vos propres opportunités pour que votre pipeline ne désemplisse pas. Vous serez au cœur de notre moteur de croissance : rapide,

soucieux des indicateurs et conçu pour les personnes qui se fixent des objectifs plus élevés que la norme. C’est le poste idéal pour les personnes qui n’attendent pas qu’on leur dise quoi faire, qui ne cherchent pas d’excuses et font preuve d’exigence.

Si vous êtes capable de conclure des ventes en saisissant les opportunités qui se présentent à vous, que vous aimez résoudre des problèmes concrets pour les entreprises et que vous souhaitez travailler dur dans un environnement dynamique, où l’effort est directement couronné de succès, ce poste est fait pour vous.

Square offre la possibilité d’évoluer dans un environnement de prospection sortante dynamique, où vos prises de contact vous permettent de proposer les outils de Square à un plus grand nombre de vendeurs, et où votre réussite s’inscrit dans notre mission d’offrir des conditions équitables aux entrepreneurs. Nous agissons rapidement, nous apprenons continuellement et nous récompensons le courage et les résultats en offrant un potentiel de rémunération illimité

Vos missions

  • Gérer l’ensemble du cycle de vente, du premier échange à la conclusion du contrat, avec des commerçants PME de divers secteurs d’activité.
  • Engager et convertir un flux régulier de leads intéressés provenant du marketing, des partenariats out ayant manifesté leur intérêt pour nos produits
  • Générer une part importante de votre pipeline grâce à la prospection. Vous construisez sans relâche votre pipeline grâce à la prospection : vous ne comptez pas sur les demandes reçues, vous prenez les devant. Vous savez identifier de nouvelles opportunités, élaborer une approche personnalisée et créer de la demande là où il n’y en avait pas.

descriptionHtml:
The North American SMB Sales team at Afterpay and Cash App is responsible for driving revenue to our core consumer payments businesses, giving our Merchant partners access to the largest and most engaged network of next generation consumers.

We are looking for a strategic, analytical, and experienced Head of SMB Sales to build and scale a high-velocity, playbook-driven sales engine across a broad and growing base of small and medium-sized businesses, unlocking new revenue opportunities across our Buy Now Pay Later and Pay Now products. The SMB segment spans three motions: a BDR function that sources and books meetings for Account Executives, an Inbound motion serving our smaller, higher-volume businesses, and an Outbound-led motion focused on our larger, higher-growth SMB accounts. You will be responsible for orchestrating these motions into a single, cohesive system, and for the discipline, tooling, and processes that help generate pipeline and let the team convert and onboard merchants efficiently and at scale.

A successful candidate exhibits a strong sense of ownership to win new business for Afterpay and Cash App, and a demonstrated ability to navigate ambiguity; think strategically and operationally about business, marketing and technical challenges; and lead cross-functional workstreams ultimately tied to pipeline creation and conversion. This role requires a strategic problem solver who is a rigorous operator and an effective influencer, comfortable balancing data-driven rigor with a strong bias for action and hands-on execution. 

Beyond ultimately being responsible for revenue outcomes across our SMB merchant pipeline, spanning a broad range of industries across retail, fashion, beauty, travel, home and more in North America, you'll also be building and supporting a strong culture of performance. 

The ideal candidate has demonstrated excellence in building and operating high-velocity sales motions at scale, leading and managing high-performing teams, and a dedication to continuous improvement.

You will:

  • Oversee the North American SMB Sales Team: Lead a multi-motion team spanning BDR, Inbound, and Outbound Account Executives. Build and continuously refine the playbooks, processes, and tooling that let the team convert and grow merchants efficiently at high volume, moving with a bias for action and iterating quickly based on data. Craft a segment-wide strategy and hold the team accountable to delivering on OKRs and revenue targets across each motion, in concert with the broader Sales & Account Management function at Afterpay and Cash App.
  • Build an A-Team: You will inherit a team of strong performers with relevant experience. Further develop their skills, knowledge, efficacy, and an overall team culture focused on performance and betterment, including coaching frontline managers to drive results through their own teams. Set an energetic, accountable tone for the North America sales organization, rooted in a strong sense of ownership and led with empathy over ego.
  • Develop Meaningful Cross-Functional Partnerships: Work closely with cross-functional teams to better support your team in generating revenue, including Marketing, Finance, Product, Risk, Legal, Account Management and more. You can influence without authority across teams and build the internal relationships required to navigate a distributed and matrixed set of stakeholders.
  • Own Sales Process and Methodology: Build and refine a repeatable sales approach that covers the full deal lifecycle — from discovery and qualification through articulating value, negotiating, and closing.
  • Drive Forecasting Rigor and Pipeline Hygiene: Implement best practices in forecasting accuracy and pipeline health, partnering closely with Finance and Sales Ops/Strategy to keep both sharp.
  • Define Ideal Customer Profile and Value Proposition: Shape and sharpen our ideal customer profile, key use cases, and value proposition, and centralize and socialize the sales and growth narratives that resonate most with SMB Merchants to inform our broader B2B marketing and sales strategy.
  • Be the Voice of Afterpay and Cash App: Represent the business to SMB Merchants as a thought-leader in the payments and Buy Now Pay Later landscape, and demonstrate Afterpay and Cash App's value as a growth driver for small and growing businesses.
  • Be the Voice of the Merchant: Represent market feedback and sentiment internally, advocating for your clients while balancing against the needs and constraints of our business, by aggregating and delivering key insights across the organization in a structured, consistent, and proactive manner.

You have:

  • An obsession with our products and a motivation fueled by feeling the impact of your work as more consumers build financial wellness with Afterpay and Cash App. 
  • 12+ years of experience in high-growth environments leading SMB Sales, BDR, or Account Management organizations, preferably in a fast-moving technology or financial services company, with experience operating at high volume and velocity.
  • Excellent leadership skills with the ability to develop talent, motivate high-performing teams, and build strong cross-functional relationships, including a proven track record of coaching and managing frontline managers to results. You put your people in the best position to succeed, and your management style is tailored to each individual to maximize their performance and engagement at work.
  • Experience standing up or scaling sales organizations from scratch — hiring, onboarding, and developing talent across BDRs, AEs, and frontline managers.
  • Demonstrated ability to build, operate, and continuously improve playbooks that scale across a large and growing team.
  • Experience working closely with Product and Marketing to drive conversion — improving self-serve sign-up, activation, and onboarding flows to convert more prospective merchants into active partners. 
  • Strong presence with senior internal leaders, with demonstrated ability to influence and earn trust, ask the right questions, and use sound business judgment across the organization.
  • A demonstrated track record of leading teams that consistently drive revenue growth and exceed their revenue targets.
  • Comfort working with analytics and tools that support business performance measurement and management, particularly around forecasting, funnel, and pipeline conversion metrics at scale.
  • Creative storytelling abilities, ability to seek out relevant, meaningful data and build business cases to inform partners on Afterpay and Cash App's value proposition.

title: Deputy Chief Compliance Officer / Deputy BSA Officer, Builders Bank & Trust
locations: Bay Area, CA, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
Block is one company built from many blocks, all united by the same purpose of economic empowerment. The blocks that form our foundational teams — People, Finance, Counsel, Hardware, Information Security, Platform Infrastructure Engineering, and more — provide support and guidance at the corporate level. They work across business groups and around the globe, spanning time zones and disciplines to develop inclusive People policies, forecast finances, give legal counsel, safeguard systems, nurture new initiatives, and more. Every challenge creates possibilities, and we need different perspectives to see them all. Bring yours to Block. 

Block is pursuing an OCC charter to form Builders Bank & Trust, a proposed uninsured national trust bank. Builders Bank is being organized to exercise fiduciary powers and conduct trust company operations in accordance with the National Bank Act and 12 CFR Part 9. The bank's core activities will include digital asset custody, safekeeping, and related fiduciary services for its clients.

The Role

We are building a compliance program designed to enable Block and support the establishment of Builders Bank. We seek a Deputy Chief Compliance Officer who is builder-focused and can hold the bar to OCC standards without losing the operating tempo that has defined Block since inception. The Deputy Chief Compliance Officer supports the Chief Compliance Officer / BSA-AML (CCO/BSA) Officer in the design, implementation, and ongoing administration of Block Trust Bank’s compliance management system and BSA/AML program. This role is dedicated to the trust bank charter team and is responsible for helping the leadership implement compliance architecture to maintain and ensure that the bank maintains an effective, independent, and well-documented compliance function appropriate for a federally chartered national trust bank supervised by the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC).

The Deputy CCO is a hands-on compliance leader who assists with day-to-day building and execution of the trust bank’s compliance program, including BSA/AML controls, OFAC sanctions compliance, customer due diligence, transaction monitoring oversight, regulatory change management, compliance testing, issue remediation, and examination readiness. This role works closely with the CCO, Risk Lead, COO, CFO, CISO, Legal, and relevant first-line teams while maintaining appropriate independence from revenue-generating business activities.

You Will

  • Support the CCO/BSA Officer in establishing and maintaining the trust bank’s Compliance Management System, including policies and procedures, training, monitoring, testing, issue management, and Board reporting
  • Assist in designing, maintaining, and executing BSA/AML policies, procedures, and internal controls consistent with 31 CFR 1020.210
  • Support customer identification, customer due diligence, enhanced due diligence, beneficial ownership, and ongoing customer risk rating processes
  • Oversee day-to-day compliance operations related to transaction monitoring, alert review, case escalation, SAR investigation support, and FinCEN reporting workflows
  • Support OFAC sanctions screening, sanctions escalation, Travel Rule compliance, and digital asset wallet screening processes
  • Help implement and tune blockchain analytics tools used for transaction monitoring, wallet screening, typology development, and sanctions risk detection
  • Develop and maintain digital asset-specific AML typologies, red flags, and escalation procedures for custody and fiduciary activities
  • Coordinate compliance monitoring and testing activities, including tracking of findings, remediation plans, root-cause analysis, and evidence of closure
  • Support annual independent BSA/AML audit and compliance testing; help ensure findings are reported, tracked, and remediated
  • Assist with OCC examination preparation, document production, management responses, and remediation of supervisory findings
  • Support regulatory change management for applicable banking, fiduciary, BSA/AML, OFAC, Travel Rule, and emerging digital asset requirements
  • Prepare compliance reporting for the CCO, President & CEO, Board Audit & Risk Committee, and other governance forums

You Have

  • 7+ years in compliance, BSA/AML, financial crimes, or regulatory compliance at a federally supervised financial institution or similarly regulated financial services firm
  • Strong working knowledge of BSA/AML program requirements, including CIP, CDD/EDD, SAR processes, transaction monitoring, OFAC sanctions screening, and regulatory reporting
  • Experience supporting compliance programs subject to OCC, Federal Reserve, FDIC, FinCEN, or state banking regulator examination
  • Familiarity with compliance management systems, compliance testing, issue management, regulatory change management, and Board-level reporting
  • Experience with digital asset AML risks, blockchain analytics, virtual currency typologies, wallet screening, or Travel Rule compliance
  • Demonstrated ability to operate independently, escalate issues appropriately, and maintain compliance function independence from business line objectives
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including ability to prepare clear compliance documentation for senior management, auditors, and regulators
  • Must demonstrate a personal history reflecting responsibility, honesty, and integrity, and satisfy OCC background investigation requirements assessing competence, experience, integrity, and financial ability

Even Better

  • CAMS certification strongly preferred
  • Prior experience at a trust company, custody bank, digital asset exchange, or digital asset custody provider
  • Experience helping build or scale a BSA/AML or compliance program for a de novo bank, trust company, or newly regulated financial institution
  • Experience with OCC or FinCEN examinations, independent BSA/AML audits, or remediation of MRAs, MRIAs, consent orders, or similar supervisory findings
  • Familiarity with OCC safety and soundness expectations, 12 CFR Part 9 fiduciary requirements, OCC Bulletin 2023-17, and 12 CFR Part 30
  • Working knowledge of emerging digital asset regulatory frameworks, including stablecoin, qualified custodian, and digital asset custody requirements

title: Software Engineer, Reconciliation & Reporting
locations: Bay Area, CA, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

The Role

You will join the Recon and Reporting team, which owns our post-transaction systems: the platform responsible for reconciling money, tracing the end-to-end flow of funds, and meeting our tax and regulatory reporting obligations to merchants, customers, and authorities worldwide. Reconciliation and financial reporting are essential to running a payments business, and given our transaction volume, the projects you own will have direct, measurable impact on financial accuracy and trust.

You will help build and operate the systems that ingest and integrate global card-network settlement and report files (Visa, Mastercard, and equivalents), along with data from acquirers, processors, and banks, and reconcile them against internal payment data to power settlement, dispute, cost, tax, and regulatory reporting. You will own well-scoped projects within this platform end-to-end, with guidance from more experienced engineers. Our vision is to make reconciliation and reporting accurate, automated, and near real-time.

You Will

  • Own small, well-bounded projects end-to-end with guidance available: clarify requirements, design, build, test, ship, and follow up.
  • Build and maintain features within the ingestion and reconciliation pipelines that match card-network and partner reports against internal transaction data.
  • Contribute to tooling that provides end-to-end traceability of money throughout the system.
  • Develop features for reporting and reconciliation products that are accurate, reliable, timely, scalable, and user-friendly for both internal finance teams and external merchants.
  • Produce standardized journals and summaries that feed downstream accounting, audit, and analysis.
  • Contribute to our large-scale tax and regulatory reporting systems, including US IRS information returns (the 1099 family, issued at the scale of tens of millions of forms annually to merchants and customers) and international regimes such as EU-wide CESOP and country-specific reporting for Australia, Ireland, and Spain.
  • Support broader regulatory and compliance obligations (AML, KYC, and similar), with careful handling of sensitive and PII data, including TIN validation and secure form generation and filing.
  • Validate your work before calling it done, using code review, tests, small experiments, or usage signals, including for AI-assisted changes.
  • Take agency in debugging and escalating production issues across services, giving the team clear context on what changed, when it changed, how it changed, and what risk remains.
  • Collaborate with engineers, product managers, data analysts, and finance, tax, and compliance partners, contributing to technical design and product decisions that shape feature outcomes.
  • Review peers' work, apply their feedback to your own, and document learnings, including AI workflows the team can reuse.
  • Opportunistically improve the systems you touch when it fits your project scope, replacing manual and redundant work with automation, and route larger issues to the right owner.

You Have

  • 3+ years of professional software or data engineering experience.
  • A Bachelor's degree in a technical field (Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or similar) or equivalent technical experience.
  • Experience building or maintaining batch- or event-driven data pipelines, with exposure to workflow-orchestration technologies (e.g., Airflow, Temporal, Spark, or equivalent) and a working understanding of distributed systems.

descriptionHtml:
It all started with an idea at Block in 2013. Initially built to take the pain out of peer-to-peer payments, Cash App has gone from a simple product with a single purpose to a dynamic ecosystem, developing unique financial products, including Afterpay/Clearpay, to provide a better way to send, spend, invest, borrow and save to our 50+ million monthly active customers. We want to redefine the world’s relationship with money to make it more relatable, instantly available, and universally accessible.

Today, Cash App has thousands of employees working globally across office and remote locations, with a culture geared toward innovation, collaboration and impact. No matter the location, we tailor our experience to ensure our employees are creative, productive, and happy.

The Role

At Block, we strive to build the best financial products in the world. The Financial Platform Issuing team owns the card issuing platform that serves every Block brand — powering Cash App Card, the largest card program of all, alongside Square Card and the new programs Block launches next. We run the full lifecycle of a card: issuance, fulfillment, and activation; real-time transaction authorization and processing across card networks, digital wallet provisioning, 3-D Secure authentication and the disputes systems. When a customer taps their card at a register, our systems decide the outcome in milliseconds, around the clock, in partnership with card networks and bank partners.

As a software engineer on the Issuing server engineering team, you will design, build, and operate the services that power these card experiences, through close collaboration with your team and partner disciplines. You'll own well-scoped features end to end — from design through testing, launch, and operation — and grow your scope as you go. The things you build will run at a massive scale and directly shape how millions of customers across Block spend their money every day.
