title: Business Intelligence Analyst
locations: Toronto, Ontario, Canada
descriptionHtml:
It all started with an idea at Block in 2013. Initially built to take the pain out of peer-to-peer payments, Cash App has gone from a simple product with a single purpose to a dynamic ecosystem, developing unique financial products, including Afterpay/Clearpay, to provide a better way to send, spend, invest, borrow and save to our 50+ million monthly active customers. We want to redefine the world’s relationship with money to make it more relatable, instantly available, and universally accessible.

Today, Cash App has thousands of employees working globally across office and remote locations, with a culture geared toward innovation, collaboration and impact. We’ve been a distributed team since day one, and many of our roles can be done remotely from the countries where Cash App operates. No matter the location, we tailor our experience to ensure our employees are creative, productive, and happy.

The Role

You will join the Recon and Reporting team, which owns our post-transaction systems: the platform responsible for reconciling money, tracing the end-to-end flow of funds, and meeting our tax and regulatory reporting obligations to merchants, customers, and authorities worldwide. Reconciliation and financial reporting are essential to running a payments business, and given our transaction volume, this role has direct, measurable impact on financial accuracy and trust.

As a Senior Analyst on the team, you will independently own reconciliation and reporting workstreams end to end. You will be the subject matter expert who ensures the numbers tie out: reconciling card-network settlement and report files (Visa, Mastercard, and equivalents), along with data from acquirers, processors, and banks, against our internal payment and ledger data. You will translate ambiguous reconciliation and reporting needs into concrete metrics, controls, and automated solutions, drive discrepancies to root cause and resolution, and directly influence the team's roadmap and the priorities of our finance, accounting, and engineering partners. Our mantra: all funds in the right place, at the right time, for the right purpose.

You Will

  • Independently prioritize, design, develop, and deploy end-to-end reconciliation and reporting solutions: matching logic, break dashboards, exception queues, settlement summaries, and standardized journals that feed downstream accounting, audit, and regulatory processes.
  • Own time-sensitive daily, weekly, and monthly reconciliations across card networks, banking partners, processors, and internal transaction and ledger data, including full ownership of discrepancy management from detection through root cause, corrective action, and control improvement.
  • Translate ambiguous business, finance, and regulatory needs into concrete measurement systems: define and roll out key metrics for the reconciliation and reporting domain (match rates, break aging, time-to-resolution, funding compliance, reporting SLAs) and ensure stakeholders interpret them in the correct context.
  • Serve as the subject matter expert on settlement, funding, and money-movement flows; field questions on transaction lifecycles, data models, and the reconciliation tech stack from stakeholders and leadership.
  • Own the design, development, and documentation of automated SQL-based reporting using best practices, navigating new and unfamiliar datasets to answer complex questions about the flow of funds.
  • Work independently or partner with data engineering to design, build, validate, troubleshoot, and maintain the datasets and pipelines that power reconciliation and reporting, making sound trade-offs between accuracy, implementation effort, and complexity.
  • Proactively identify control gaps, revenue leakage, manual toil, and upstream data-quality issues; drive the automation and process improvements that fix them, and monitor daily settlement and banking activity for irregularities.
  • Own relationships with technical and non-technical stakeholders across Engineering, Product, Accounting, Treasury, Tax, and Compliance; directly influence the priorities, decisions, and roadmap of the team and its partners.
  • Lead month-end close support for the domain: reconciliation reporting, standardized summaries, and audit-ready documentation, including supporting internal and external audits.
  • Define business requirements and test plans for system changes, validate new processes and reconciliation capabilities before deployment, and partner with Engineering and Data teams to resolve bugs and ship enhancements.
  • Help onboard and mentor other analysts, including reviewing code and evangelizing reconciliation and reporting best practices.
  • Apply an AI-first mindset to improve the speed, quality, and insight of analytical work, and guide responsible AI use on the team.

You Have

  • 5+ years of related experience in reconciliation, settlement, payment operations, accounting, or finance analytics with a Bachelor's degree (Finance, Accounting, Economics, a quantitative field, or similar); or 3+ years with a Master's degree; or equivalent work experience.
  • Expert-level SQL, including owning the design, development, and documentation of automated SQL-based reporting, and the ability to navigate new datasets and answer complex questions independently.
  • Demonstrated experience independently owning reconciliation, settlement, or financial reporting workstreams end to end, including defining metrics and driving them to adoption.
  • Strong knowledge of accounting principles, double-entry concepts, and the mechanics of money movement, with the judgment to question the correctness and completeness of financial data.
  • Experience partnering with data engineering (or working independently) to design, build, validate, and maintain data pipelines, with the ability to make sound technical trade-offs.
  • Advanced Excel proficiency (complex formulas, pivot tables) and experience with reconciliation tooling and banking portals.
  • Excellent communication skills: able to own senior stakeholder relationships, present findings and recommendations, and drive clear next steps in areas without clear ownership.
  • Track record of proactively identifying and delivering process improvements and automation in a deadline-driven, high-accuracy environment.

Preferred Experience

  • Deep experience with card-network reconciliation and settlement (Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover), including network settlement, clearing, and report file formats.
  • Strong familiarity with funds-transfer processes and rails (ACH, wire, SWIFT, RTP/FedNow) and the payments ecosystem: merchants, acquirers, issuers, processors, and program banks.
  • Scripting skills (Python or similar) for data analysis and process automation.
  • Experience with cloud data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery) and BI platforms (e.g., Looker, Tableau), including building governed reporting layers with SLAs.
  • Exposure to interchange and fee/cost reconciliation, revenue-leakage detection, and tax or regulatory reporting regimes.
  • Experience supporting audits, internal controls, or SOX-adjacent processes, and mentoring junior analysts.
  • Curiosity about payments products and financial markets.

title: Regulatory Program Lead, Canada
locations: Toronto, Ontario, Canada
descriptionHtml:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

The Role

Block's Canada Compliance team is building a scalable, technology-enabled compliance function for our regulated Canadian entities - Square Canada and Afterpay Canada. Reporting to the Chief Compliance Officer, Canada, and serving as a designee of the CCO in governance forums, Board meetings, and regulatory engagements, you will be a “full-stack” compliance leader: driving the annual compliance plan end-to-end, overseeing frameworks across AML/ATF, sanctions, the Retail Payment Activities Act (RPAA), consumer protection, privacy, and payment card industry obligations, and co-building the AI-enabled programs and tools that keep both entities aligned with Canadian regulatory expectations and Block's global standards.

You Will

  • Serve as the Regulatory Program Lead for Block's Canadian regulated entities, acting as a designee of the CCO in governance forums, Board meetings, and regulatory engagements
  • Lead end-to-end execution of the annual Canada Compliance Plan -  regulatory change management, monitoring and testing, risk assessments, and policy reviews - delivering against key milestones and regulatory commitments
  • Run Canada's compliance programs across AML/ATF (Square Canada MSB), RPAA, the PCI Code of Conduct, and consumer protection and privacy obligations (PIPEDA, CASL, FCAC, provincial requirements), including FINTRAC registration and support for regulatory examinations and audits
  • Lead governance and tracking of regulatory commitments, audit actions, and findings - driving issue management and remediation through to closure - while maintaining the compliance risk assessment framework, policies, and governance documentation
  • Prepare Board and governance committee materials, translating multi-domain regulatory complexity into clear, decision-ready narratives for senior leadership
  • Lead cross-functional regulatory programs across Legal, Risk, Product, Operations, and Engineering, driving operational excellence through process improvement, automation, and AI-enabled compliance solutions
  • Coordinate compliance training and targeted regulatory awareness materials for senior leadership, Boards, and business stakeholders

You Have

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in compliance, financial crime, or regulatory affairs, which must include payments compliance at a regulated payments entity - an MSB, payment service provider, acquirer, or comparable fintech such as Square Canada and serving in, or directly supporting, a senior compliance leadership role (CCO, Deputy CCO, Head of Compliance, CAMLO / Deputy CAMLO)
  • Deep knowledge of Canadian AML/ATF legislation (PCMLTFA, FINTRAC guidance), the RPAA, the Code of Conduct for the Payment Card Industry in Canada, consumer protection frameworks (FCAC, PIPEDA, CASL), and Canadian sanctions regimes (SEMA, UN sanctions)
  • Executive presence, with experience preparing and presenting Board-level compliance reporting and engaging directly with regulators through examinations and ongoing supervision
  • Direct end-to-end working knowledge of payment systems, money services businesses - including payments-specific financial crime typologies and controls
  • Hands-on, day-to-day use of AI tools for regulatory analysis, drafting, and process automation - with sound judgment about their limits
  • A builder mindset with proven leadership, people management, and stakeholder engagement capabilities in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment; CAMS, ICA, or equivalent certification
  • Bonus points: knowledge of buy-now-pay-later compliance programs, Quebec regulatory regime, hands-on RPAA compliance, OSFI guidelines, the AUSTRAC / Australian AML/CTF regime, or bilingual English/French

Technologies We Use and Teach

  • Protecht (GRC / issue and risk management)
  • AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT / OpenAI Enterprise / GitHub) for regulatory analysis, drafting, and process automation
  • JIRA and Confluence (program and documentation management)
  • Looker / Tableau (reporting and dashboards)

locations: Bay Area, CA, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

The Role

At Block, we strive to build the best financial products in the world. The Financial Platform Acquiring team owns the acquiring side of card payments for Square, Cash App, and Afterpay. When someone pays with a card at a Square seller, through Afterpay, or uses a card to move money in or out of Cash App, our systems make sure that payment happens correctly, every time.

We take in and tokenize card data from chip, tap, digital wallets, and online checkout, route each payment, and get it authorized over our direct network connections and acquiring partners. Then we capture, clear, and settle it, in the US and internationally. Across Square and Cash App, Block processed nearly $260 billion in payment volume in 2025, and we run our own direct connections to card networks in several countries alongside our acquiring partners. When a customer taps their card at a register, our systems route the authorization and bring back the issuer's answer in under a second, around the clock, in partnership with card networks and bank partners.

As a Staff Software Engineer on the Acquiring team, you will bring deep card payments experience to some of the most complex technical work on our roadmap. That work includes expanding our direct network and acquirer connections, delivering network mandates, and making it cheaper and more reliable to accept cards. You will lead one or two of these projects at a time. If you have worked deep in the card payment stack, at a payments company, a card network, or a large merchant, and want to own hard problems at Block's scale, this role is built for you.

This is a hands-on role. You will build systems and tooling, debug at the message level, and turn your payments expertise into durable capabilities that other engineers can use. Much of the team built its payments depth here at Block. You will bring a view of how other companies solve the same problems, and learn our systems from a team that knows them deeply.

In your first year, you will ship at least one of those projects to production, leave behind standards and tooling that make the next one easier, and share what you learned elsewhere so the whole team goes deeper. You will report to the engineering manager for Acquiring.

This role works US West Coast hours, from our Bay Area or Seattle offices or remotely within the Pacific time zone. The team is mostly in US Eastern and Australian time zones, and Pacific hours overlap with US Eastern in the morning and with Melbourne in the late afternoon.

You Will

  • Bring deep card acceptance expertise to the team, reading network specifications, ISO 8583 messages, mandates, and interchange rules, and turning them into sound engineering decisions.
  • Own the technical direction of your projects from design through production rollout, and lead the engineers working on them.
  • Partner with our technical leads, product and finance operations partners, and stakeholders across Square, Cash App, and Afterpay to shape solutions where card-network requirements intersect with Block's acquiring platform.
  • Stay deeply hands-on: write production code, build testing and certification tooling, analyze network messages, review designs and code, and debug issues down to the protocol and field level.
  • Make and defend the technical calls on routing, retries, and processing cost, backed by data on authorization rates and fees.
  • Establish shared frameworks, standards, tooling, and practices that make payments expertise durable so the team makes good payments decisions without routing every question through you.
  • Raise the technical capability of engineers around you through design guidance, code reviews, mentorship, documentation, and clear technical judgment. Help grow the next staff engineers on the team.
  • Build with AI agents across the engineering lifecycle, and help set the patterns for using them safely on systems that move money.
  • Share operational ownership of critical financial systems through on-call, incident response, and continuous improvements to reliability and correctness

You Have

  • Deep card payments experience at the message level: you have built or run the integrations that talk to networks, acquirers, or processors (ISO 8583 or an acquirer's host format), not only called a payment provider's API. Acquiring or merchant-side experience is ideal, and a direct network connection is a strong plus. ISO 20022 is a plus.
  • Experience with the hard cases in real card transactions, such as partial and incremental authorizations, reversals, tips, currency conversion, and interchange qualification.
  • Strong hands-on software engineering experience building and operating highly reliable financial or payments systems at scale, with solid habits in design review, automated testing, and safe, observable rollouts.
  • A track record of leading technically complex projects from design through delivery and setting technical direction for the engineers working on them.
  • Experience creating durable technical leverage — frameworks, standards, tooling, architecture, or practices that other engineers and teams adopt.
  • Broad understanding of how a card payment moves end to end, with depth in areas such as card data security and tokenization, routing, authorization, capture, clearing and settlement, reconciliation, interchange and processing costs, or chargebacks.
  • Solid understanding of card network rules (Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, and US debit networks), and of how acquirers, processors, payment facilitators, and sponsor banks fit between sellers and the networks.
  • Daily experience building with AI coding agents, and good judgment about when their output is right.
  • Willingness to participate in an on-call rotation for critical financial systems.

title: Staff iOS Software Engineer, Bitcoin
locations: Bay Area, CA, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
The Team

Bitcoin at Block builds products and platforms that help make bitcoin, stablecoins, and non-custodial wallets accessible to people around the world. We work across Cash App, Square, and Bitkey to create secure, reliable, high-quality mobile and hardware experiences used by millions of people.

We’re looking for an iOS engineer who loves building products and can move quickly through unfamiliar problems. You’ll work closely with product, design, and engineering partners to turn complex financial capabilities into clear, reliable customer experiences.

The Role

As a Staff iOS Engineer on Bitcoin, you will own the technical direction and delivery of a critical area of our iOS product experience with bitcoin and stablecoin. This is a hands-on role: you’ll prototype new ideas, make architectural decisions, write production code, and lead work through launch and ongoing improvement.

The work extends beyond the client. You’ll align product requirements with backend capabilities, resolve dependencies with partner teams, and make tradeoffs across customer experience, delivery speed, security, and reliability. You’ll personally tackle the hardest design and implementation problems while helping other engineers contribute effectively.

Your impact will come from shipping valuable products and making the next release better: fewer recurring problems, clearer interfaces, stronger testing, and practices the team can use independently.

You Will

Build and evolve the iOS product

  • Build products in iOS related to bitcoin, stablecoin and non custodial wallets.
  • Work across interfaces in Cash App, Square and Bitkey.
  • Own complex features end to end, including client architecture, service integration, testing, rollout, and post-launch improvements.
  • Work with product and design to shape customer journeys, prototype new interactions, and turn open questions into delivery plans.
  • Build prototypes, reference implementations, and critical paths that prove a direction before broader adoption.
  • Contribute bitcoin and stablecoin technology to open source when it creates value for the broader community.
  • Influence the technical direction within the product area, making explicit tradeoffs and sequencing dependencies with adjacent teams.
  • Improve architecture and shared components where they make product development faster, safer, or more consistent.
  • Build automated testing, observability, and safe rollout practices into delivery, with security, privacy, and compliance safeguards appropriate to the risks.

Lead as an AI-fluent engineer

  • Integrate AI-assisted development tools into daily workflows to drive leverage across bitcoin engineering.
  • Evaluate emerging tools and practices, building durable, AI-powered capabilities where they add clear value.
  • Verify AI-assisted outputs and ensure high standards for software quality, security, and reliability.
  • Contribute to codebases beyond your iOS specialty.

Make the team more effective

  • Operate beyond your immediate team to identify and address cross-cutting technical problems.
  • Lead architecture and design reviews across team boundaries.
  • Surface systemic risks before they become customer, seller, or engineering problems.
  • Mentor engineers through design discussions, code reviews, and structured guidance that helps them take on greater ownership.
  • Help set technical standards that improve the quality and velocity of iOS development over time.

Collaborate broadly

  • Partner with engineers, product managers, designers, and engineering leaders to align technical investments with product needs.
  • Work with Android, web, and backend engineers to improve shared product foundations and cross-platform experiences.
  • Represent bitcoin iOS in cross-team and company-wide technical discussions.
  • Communicate complex technical decisions clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences.

Qualifications

You have:

  • 12+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 4+ years building native iOS products.
  • Deep experience building, shipping, and maintaining native iOS products using Swift and Apple frameworks.
  • Experience creating foundational systems, shared frameworks and tooling used widely on your team.
  • A record of leading strategic initiatives with broad adoption and durable impact.
  • Strong systems thinking, technical communication, mentoring, and organizational influence.

Ideally, you also have:

  • Experience working in large, modular iOS applications, including existing UIKit or Objective-C codebases.
  • Experience with build systems, continuous integration and delivery, testing infrastructure, observability, or mobile performance.
  • Experience supporting customer-facing or seller-facing products in financial services, commerce, or another high-trust environment.
  • Experience with experimentation infrastructure, feature flags, or large-scale product delivery.
  • Experience working with bitcoin, stablecoin and non custodial technologies.
  • A record of identifying and leading work that was not already on a team's roadmap.

Technologies we use and teach

  • Swift, Objective-C, SwiftUI, and UIKit
  • Swift Concurrency and Combine
  • Xcode and Instruments
  • Bazel and other build and dependency-management systems
  • Protocol Buffers and shared client-server interfaces
  • Unit, snapshot, integration, and user interface testing
  • Performance, observability, and release-safety tooling
  • AI-assisted development tools

  • Develop Territory Account Executives through active, in-market coaching — from sourcing and opening conversations to consultative discovery, competitive positioning, and closing with clarity.

  • Hold the team to a high bar of execution while providing the clarity, structure, and hands-on coaching needed to meet it.
  • Hire, onboard, and develop AEs to ramp quickly, deepen product expertise, and consistently exceed quota.

  • Become a product and competitive expert — ensuring your team can confidently articulate Square’s value and differentiation.
  • Build scalable, repeatable field sales motions that increase funnel quality, improve outbound productivity, and accelerate growth in your assigned cities.
  • Continuously refine strategy, playbooks, and operating rhythms to deepen Square’s presence and win market share across key local ecosystems.

Partner and innovate across the business

  • Champion the customer voice and collaborate cross-functionally to strengthen product-market fit and unlock new revenue pathways.
  •  Engage deeply with community networks, partners, and local events to amplify brand awareness and fuel top-of-funnel opportunity creation.

  • 5+ years of leadership experience, preferably managing field account executives
  • Experience in high-transaction SaaS or financial services sales
  • Strong bias toward action and experimentation, balanced with thoughtful decision-making
  • A track record of building a winning, high-performing culture through hands-on leadership and coaching
  • Extensive experience operating in a metrics-driven sales organization

locations: Bay Area, CA, United States of America
descriptionHtml:

Together, we’re helping build a financial system that is open to everyone. Join us.

The Role

We're hiring an experienced software engineer to build and own the data platform that helps teams across the company work with trusted data at scale. This role shapes the foundations for data warehousing, orchestration, business intelligence, governance, and Block's agentic workflows. You'll combine strong software engineering with hands-on experience working closely with data, building platforms that make it safer and faster for data practitioners to discover, produce, transform, govern, and use data.

You Will

  • Design, build, and operate core data-platform capabilities, including data warehousing, orchestration, business intelligence tooling, and data governance.
  • Build reliable Python services and developer-facing tools that improve how teams create and operate data products.
  • Develop scalable infrastructure as code with Terraform.
  • Establish patterns that let teams manage petabyte-scale data while maintaining strong governance, security, reliability, and usability.
  • Partner with data engineers, analysts, scientists, and product teams to turn their needs into durable platform capabilities.
  • Evaluate and build agentic workflows that make data work more effective, while maintaining appropriate controls and observability.
  • Set technical direction, raise engineering standards, and mentor other engineers.

You Have

  • Senior-level software engineering experience, with strong Python skills and a record of designing, shipping, and operating production systems.
  • Hands-on experience building or operating data platforms, data products, or large-scale data infrastructure.
  • Experience with Snowflake, Databricks, or comparable modern data platforms.
  • Experience with Terraform and infrastructure-as-code practices.
  • A practical understanding of the tradeoffs involved in managing petabyte-scale data: performance, cost, reliability, access controls, lineage, quality, and governance.
  • Experience collaborating directly with data practitioners, and empathy for the workflows they use to turn data into decisions.
  • Strong technical judgment, clear communication, and the ability to lead across teams.

Technologies We Use and Teach

  • Languages: Python, Kotlin
  • Data platforms: Snowflake, Databricks, Apache Iceberg
  • Orchestration & transformation: Apache Airflow, dbt, Prefect
  • Infrastructure as code & CI/CD: Terraform, Buildkite, GitOps
  • Catalog, lineage & data quality: DataHub, Anomalo
  • BI & analytics: Looker, Omni
  • Cloud: AWS

title: Senior Director, Global Tax Planning & Controversy
locations: Bay Area, CA, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
Block is one company built from many blocks, all united by the same purpose of economic empowerment. The blocks that form our foundational teams — People, Finance, Counsel, Hardware, Information Security, Platform Infrastructure Engineering, and more — provide support and guidance at the corporate level. They work across business groups and around the globe, spanning time zones and disciplines to develop inclusive People policies, forecast finances, give legal counsel, safeguard systems, nurture new initiatives, and more. Every challenge creates possibilities, and we need different perspectives to see them all. Bring yours to Block.

The Role

Block is looking for a Senior Director, Global Tax Planning and Controversy. Reporting to the Chief Accounting Officer, you will lead Block's global tax planning, international tax, transfer pricing strategy, M&A and investment tax activities, U.S. federal and state income tax planning, and direct tax controversy agenda and significant tax examinations and disputes. You will help shape Block's global legal-entity, financing, IP, and operating structures, and translate complex tax concepts into practical business solutions. This is a highly visible, hands-on role requiring exceptional technical judgment, commercial awareness, and executive presence.

You Will

  • Develop and execute Block's global tax planning strategies in alignment with business objectives, financial priorities, and risk tolerance. Identify opportunities, evaluate alternatives, and lead the implementation of sustainable, defensible domestic and international tax planning.
  • Lead international tax planning related to Block's global operations, including cross-border legal-entity structures, intellectual-property arrangements, intercompany transactions, financing, capital deployment, cash repatriation, and operating-model changes. Advise on complex U.S. international and foreign tax matters such as foreign tax credits, tax treaties, withholding taxes, permanent-establishment considerations, transfer pricing, and global minimum tax regimes.
  • Own U.S. federal and state income tax planning, including consolidated return matters, financing transactions, the preservation and use of tax attributes, nexus and apportionment planning, sourcing positions, filing methodology and entity structure. 
  • Analyze tax considerations for new product launches, product modifications, and new market entry or expansion efforts. Act as a thought partner to the business by collaboratively developing alternative solutions to support business initiatives.
  • Monitor U.S. and international legislative, regulatory, administrative, judicial, and policy developments. Assess their potential impact on Block's global structure, cash taxes, effective tax rate, financial reporting, and compliance obligations, and develop strategies to address material risks and opportunities.
  • Lead the tax aspects of domestic and cross-border acquisitions, dispositions, investments, joint ventures, strategic partnerships, reorganizations, and other corporate transactions — from initial evaluation through due diligence, structuring, modeling, negotiation, closing, integration, and tax return implementation. Develop and evaluate alternative transaction structures, advising senior leadership on cash-tax consequences, effective-tax-rate implications, use of tax attributes, and potential controversy risks.
  • Partner with Corporate Development and Legal in negotiating transactions. Review, draft, and negotiate tax provisions in purchase agreements, investment agreements, commercial contracts, and other transaction documents, including tax representations, covenants, indemnities, purchase-price provisions, and withholding obligations and the allocation of pre- and post-closing taxes.
  • Own Block's direct tax controversy strategy across federal, state, local, and foreign income tax examinations — from audit readiness and risk assessment through information-document requests, administrative appeals, competent-authority proceedings, settlement negotiations, and final resolution. Develop strategies for international tax controversies, including transfer-pricing disputes, permanent-establishment matters, withholding-tax and treaty-based disputes.
  • Serve as a senior representative of Block in interactions with U.S. and foreign tax authorities. Develop audit-defense and dispute-resolution strategies supported by strong technical analysis, contemporaneous documentation, and quantitative modeling.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Tax Reporting & Compliance, Legal, Corporate Development, Treasury, Accounting, FP&A, Product, People, Government Relations, and business leadership. Ensure domestic and international tax considerations are incorporated early in strategic and operational decision-making. Ensure that planning, transaction structures, uncertain tax positions, and audit resolutions are properly reflected in the tax provision, financial statement disclosures, and filed tax returns through close partnership and collaboration with Tax Reporting & Compliance.

You Have

  • 15+ years of multinational corporate income tax experience spanning complex global tax planning, M&A, and tax controversy.
  • In-house tax experience at a publicly traded multinational, advising senior executives and cross-functional partners on material tax matters.
  • Deep U.S. international tax expertise: cross-border tax, foreign tax credits, treaties, withholding, permanent establishment, cross-border financing, and transfer pricing.
  • Deep U.S. federal corporate tax knowledge: Subchapter C, consolidated returns, reorganizations, financing transactions, and attribute limitation rules.
  • A track record of developing and executing sophisticated tax-planning strategies and leading domestic and cross-border transactions end-to-end, including negotiating tax terms and developing negotiation positions.
  • Success managing significant U.S. and foreign income tax audits, developing defensible technical positions, and resolving disputes with tax authorities.
  • Strong research, modeling, and technical-writing skills, with sound judgment in areas of uncertainty.
  • Executive presence and a proven record of building high-performing teams.

Even Better

  • Big Four accounting firm experience in addition to substantial in-house public-company experience.
  • MS in Taxation, JD/LLM in Taxation, CPA, or comparable credentials.
  • Background in technology, payments, fintech, digital assets, or another highly regulated industry.
  • Experience with Treasury initiatives such as capital markets, global cash pooling, intercompany lending, debt restructurings, and capital allocation.
  • Experience partnering with government relations or tax-policy teams.
  • Experience applying tax technology, analytics, and AI to analysis, modeling, and audit readiness.

title: Manager, Mid-Market Sales
locations: Los Angeles, CA, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn't work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we've embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We're building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

The Role

We’re building a team of elite sales leaders who raise the performance of everyone around them.

As a Senior Sales Manager, you'll lead a team of approximately 10 Senior Account Executives while owning one of our most important growth levers: developing talent that consistently outperforms expectations. This role isn't about managing activity, it's about building a high-performance sales organization where every hire strengthens the team, every coaching conversation improves execution, and every business decision is grounded in data.

You'll lead our most experienced Account Executives, AEs with 5+ years of full-cycle closing experience, on a fully outbound team where pipeline is strategic and self-sourced across executive networks, partnerships, trade shows, intent data, and more. Your reps own the execution. You sharpen the strategy behind it, and you coach in the work rather than after it. That means diagnosing pipeline health before it becomes a forecasting problem, developing future leaders before promotions become necessary, and building playbooks and an operating rhythm that makes growth predictable.

You'll partner cross-functionally to improve how we sell, challenge the status quo, and continuously raise the talent bar across the organization. Success is measured not only by quota attainment, but by the strength of your team, the quality of your pipeline, and the leaders you develop.

You Will

  • Build a High-Performance Team
    • Hire exceptional Account Executives and raise the talent bar with every addition to your team. 
    • Develop a culture of ownership, accountability, continuous learning and high standards. 
    • Identify future top performers early and create development plans that accelerate their growth. 
  • Coach Through Data & Business Intelligence
    • Lead your business through rigorous pipeline inspection, forecasting and performance diagnostics. 
    • Use leading indicators to identify performance gaps early and coach reps toward sustainable improvement. 
    • Turn data into action by identifying trends, diagnosing root causes and driving measurable improvements across your team. 
  • Drive Operational Excellence 
    • Establish predictable operating rhythms around forecasting, pipeline management and business reviews. 
    • Build disciplined education that creates consistent, repeatable revenue outcomes. 
    • Continuously improve how your team sells by refining processes, simplifying execution and eliminating friction. 
  • Lead Through Influence 
    • Partner closing with sales Leadership, Marketing, Enablement, Operations and Product to improve the customer journey and strengthen commercial execution. 
    • Use customer insights and field intelligence to shape strategy and influence product evolution. 
    • Lead through change by helping your team adapt quickly while maintaining high performance. 

You Have

  • 7+ years experience as a sales manager. 
  • 3 years of documented sales success as an individual contributor exceeding target. 
  • A proven track record leading high-performing sales teams in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
  • Experience leading an outbound-led team, with the ability to coach outbound as a strategy: ICP targeting, multi-channel approach, and pipeline quality over sheer volume, rather than as an activity metric.
  • Success developing Account Executives into top performers through structured coaching and clear performance expectations.
  • Deep expertise in pipeline management, forecasting, and using data to improve business outcomes.
  • Demonstrated experience hiring exceptional talent and building teams that consistently outperform.
  • Strong business judgment with the ability to balance short-term execution and long-term organizational health.

Pay Transparency

title: Senior ML/AI Modeler, Risk Automation Machine Learning
locations: Bay Area, CA, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
Block is one company built from many blocks, all united by the same purpose of economic empowerment. The blocks that form our foundational teams — People, Finance, Counsel, Hardware, Information Security, Platform Infrastructure Engineering, and more — provide support and guidance at the corporate level. They work across business groups and around the globe, spanning time zones and disciplines to develop inclusive People policies, forecast finances, give legal counsel, safeguard systems, nurture new initiatives, and more. Every challenge creates possibilities, and we need different perspectives to see them all. Bring yours to Block.

The Role

The Risk Automation ML team automates Risk and Compliance investigations and decision making at Block through the application of agentic and generative AI technology. We work globally with partners in Product, Engineering and Operations to ensure that we are providing a safe user experience for our customers while minimizing or eliminating bad activity on our platform.

We are leveraging agentic and generative AI as an integral part of our toolkit to fulfill our mission. Block's machine learning systems monitor billions of payment transactions across traditional payment and blockchain networks and surface suspicious activity (fraudulent, suspicious, illegal activity and brand violations) for trained Operations analyst review and decisioning. We are leveraging generative AI to accelerate historically manually intensive analyst workflows; by adding features in the investigative UX to accelerate agent productivity and enable them to make faster, more informed and accurate decisions (aka Copilots). We also automate workflows end to end completely eliminating the need for manual reviews (aka Autopilots).

This is a new and significant opportunity to rethink and optimize Risk Operations at Block at scale. This is an IC role, but the senior level has significant leadership responsibilities that include owning, and driving strategic roadmaps & priorities to completion by collaborating with relevant cross functional stakeholders.

(Work from anywhere: This role can be performed from any location in the United States and Canada)

You Will

  • Experiment and deploy AI copilot and autopilot systems at scale to improve analyst productivity and/or eliminate manual decision loops altogether.
  • Own the end to end system including API calls to disparate data sources, advanced prompt tuning, orchestration, metrics and evaluation, productionization and monitoring.
  • Leverage diverse data sets that include payment transactions, connected users and asset graphs, unstructured text data and user profile information to build transformer based ML models to improve downstream detection tasks.
  • Work cross functionally with product, platform, engineering and operational stakeholders to deploy production grade systems and monitor and tune ongoing performance.
  • Use Python ML stack, LLMs, Pytorch, Snowflake, Airflow based tools, data platform and cloud services (both GCP & AWS) to get the job done.
  • Leverage agentic tools (Claude Code/Codex/Openclaw) to supercharge your research, development, devOps and documentation work as part of your day to day.

You Have

  • 8+ years of Machine Learning modeling experience. Full stack ML experience is strongly preferred.
  • A Masters or advanced degree in computer science, data science, operations research, applied math, stats, physics, or a related technical field.
  • 3+ yrs experience with AI engineering, Large language models, and a background in traditional NLP techniques is a strong plus for this role.
  • End to end experience of building and deploying ML/AI to production systems (batch and real time) that are performant at scale.
  • Experience of independently owning, influencing and driving programs with multiple cross functional stakeholders that have significant business impact.
  • Have a curious, growth-oriented mindset and the ability to think in first principles to identify creative solutions that demonstrate value.

title: Head of Financial Operations, Japan
locations: Tokyo, Japan
descriptionHtml:
Block is one company built from many blocks, all united by the same purpose of economic empowerment. Our products and services, including Square, Cash App, Afterpay, TIDAL, Bitkey, and Proto, help millions of people around the world access, manage, and move money with more flexibility and control. We believe everyone should be able to participate and thrive in the economy, and we build tools that make commerce and financial services more accessible.

Block’s Financial Operations team is responsible for the movement of money through our bank partners, card networks, payment partners, and internal platforms. The team’s mission is to ensure our customers’ experience taking payments, completing sales, settling funds, and getting paid is reliable, efficient, compliant, and cost effective. To deliver on that mission, Block operates within a complex and highly regulated ecosystem of financial institutions, payment networks, industry partners, regulatory requirements, and internal systems. Financial Operations plays an integral role in shaping the infrastructure, controls, partner relationships, and operational capabilities required to support Square’s long term growth in Japan.

As Head of Financial Operations, Japan, you will lead Square’s financial operations strategy in the market. You will own critical payment and banking partner relationships, strengthen operational resilience and controls, and ensure Square can scale reliably in Japan. This Tokyo based hybrid role requires deep payments expertise, strong commercial judgment, and the ability to influence senior internal and external stakeholders.

The Role

In this role, you will translate Square Japan’s Financial Operations strategy into measurable outcomes. You will work across payments, product, operations, partnerships, and regulatory engagement to improve performance, support new capabilities, and help Square grow in a complex and highly regulated market.

You Will

  • Lead the execution of Square Japan’s Financial Operations priorities, turning regional and global strategy into clear market plans and outcomes.
  • Own operational performance for incoming and outgoing payments, including reliability, settlement, incident management, controls, cost efficiency, and seller experience.
  • Build and manage senior relationships with banks, acquirers, card networks, payment providers, industry bodies, regulators, and other strategic partners.
  • Lead commercial and operational negotiations with payment and banking partners to support Square’s growth, product roadmap, risk requirements, and cost objectives.
  • Represent Square Japan in partner, industry, regulatory, and public forums where Financial Operations expertise is required.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Policy, Finance, Marketing, and Operations to launch new capabilities and resolve market specific challenges.
  • Identify opportunities to improve authorization performance, settlement reliability, reconciliation, payment costs, dispute outcomes, vendor performance, and operational controls.
  • Monitor regulatory, network, partner, and industry changes in Japan and lead coordinated responses across internal teams.
  • Establish governance, reporting, operating rhythms, and escalation paths that improve decision making, transparency, and accountability.

You Have

  • 15+ years of experience in fintech, payments, banking, card networks, acquiring, issuing, payment operations, or related financial services roles.
  • Deep expertise in Japan’s payments ecosystem, including card networks, acquirers, issuers, processors, banks, regulators, government bodies, and industry associations.
  • A strong track record building and influencing senior relationships with partners, financial institutions, regulators, industry bodies, and market stakeholders.
  • Strong commercial judgment, including experience negotiating complex agreements and balancing cost, risk, compliance, customer experience, product outcomes, and growth.
  • Experience representing a company externally with senior partners, regulators, government stakeholders, industry bodies, or public facing audiences.
  • Proven ability to lead through ambiguity, translate complexity into clear plans, and deliver measurable outcomes across business, product, operational, regulatory, and technical challenges.
  • Experience leading complex cross functional initiatives with Product, Engineering, Finance, Legal, Compliance, Risk, Policy, Marketing, and Operations teams.
  •  Executive level communication and presentation skills in English, with the ability to make clear and persuasive recommendations to senior stakeholders.
  • Native or business level Japanese proficiency, including the ability to negotiate, influence, and build trust with Japan based partners and regulators.

Even Better

  • Experience working directly with key regulators or government bodies in Japan, including METI, JFSA, or relevant payments and financial services authorities.
  • Understanding of Payment Facilitator, acquiring, issuing, settlement, clearing, reconciliation, and card network operating models.
  • Experience working in a US headquartered fintech, technology, payments, or financial services company.
  • Media training or experience serving as an external spokesperson, industry representative, or senior market leader.

財務オペレーション責任者（日本）

会社概要

Blockは、経済的な可能性を広げるという共通の目的のもと、多くの「ブロック」が団結した企業です。Square、Cash App、Afterpay、TIDAL、Bitkey、Protoなど、弊社の製品やサービスは、世界中の何百万人もの人々が、お金へのアクセスや管理、移動をより柔軟にコントロールできるようサポートしています。弊社は、誰もが経済活動に参加し、成功を収める機会を得られるべきだという信念のもと、商取引や金融サービスをより身近なものにするツールを構築しています。

Blockの財務オペレーションチームは、取引先銀行、カードネットワーク、決済パートナー、社内プラットフォームを通じた資金移動に関する業務を担っています。チームの使命は、顧客である加盟店さまが、決済受付、販売の完了、資金の精算、売上金の受け取りを確実かつ効率的に、規制に準拠した費用対効果の高い方法で行えるようにすることです。この使命を果たすため、Blockは、金融機関、決済ネットワーク、業界パートナー、規制要件、社内システムで構成される、厳格に規制された複雑なエコシステムの中で事業を運営しています。財務オペレーションチームは、日本におけるSquareの長期的な成長を支えるために必要なインフラストラクチャ、管理体制、パートナー社との関係、運用能力を構築する上で不可欠な役割を果たします。

日本の財務オペレーション責任者の役割は、市場におけるSquareの財務オペレーション戦略を主導することです。重要な決済パートナー社や取引先銀行との関係を統括し、業務のレジリエンスと統制を強化するほか、日本でSquareが安定して事業を拡大できるようにしていただきます。東京を拠点とするこのハイブリッドな役割には、決済に関する深い専門知識、優れた判断力、社内外の上層部のステークホルダーに働きかける能力が求められます。

職務内容

この役割では、Square株式会社の財務オペレーション戦略を測定可能な成果として具体化することが求められます。決済、製品、業務、パートナーシップ、規制当局との連携などの分野にわたって、パフォーマンスの向上、新たな機能の導入、厳格に規制された複雑な市場におけるSquareの成長をサポートしていただきます。

主な業務

  • Square株式会社の財務オペレーションにおける優先事項の実行を主導し、地域およびグローバル戦略を明確な市場計画や成果として具体化する。
  • 信頼性、決済、インシデント管理、管理体制、コスト効率、加盟店さまの体験など、入出金に関する運用パフォーマンスにおいて責任を持つ。
  • 銀行、加盟店管理会社、カードネットワーク、決済プロバイダー、業界団体、規制当局、その他の戦略的パートナー社の上層部との関係を構築・管理する。
  • Squareの成長、製品ロードマップ、リスク要件、コスト目標を支えるために、決済パートナー社や取引先銀行との商業面および業務面での交渉を主導する。
  • 財務オペレーションの専門知識が求められる、パートナー社、業界、規制当局、公の場などにおいて、Square株式会社を代表する。
  • プロダクト、エンジニアリング、リスク、コンプライアンス、法務、ポリシー、財務、マーケティング、オペレーション各チームと連携し、新たな機能を提供するとともに、日本市場固有の課題を解決する。
  • 信用照会のパフォーマンス、決済の信頼性、勘定照合、決済コスト、チャージバックの結果、取引先のパフォーマンス、運用管理体制を改善する機会を特定する。
  • 日本における規制、ネットワーク、パートナー社、業界の変化をモニタリングし、社内の各チームが足並みを揃えて対応できるよう主導する。
  • 意思決定と透明性を向上させ、責任の所在を明確にするためのガバナンス、報告体制、業務サイクル、エスカレーション経路を確立する。

応募要件

  • フィンテック、決済、銀行、カードネットワーク、加盟店契約、カード発行、決済業務、または関連する金融サービス分野での15年以上の実務経験
  • カードネットワーク、加盟店管理会社、カード発行会社、決済処理会社、銀行、規制当局、政府機関、業界団体など、日本の決済エコシステムに関する深い専門知識
  • パートナー社、金融機関、規制当局、業界団体、市場のステークホルダーの上層部との関係を構築し、働きかけてきた確かな実績
  • 複雑な契約交渉に加え、コストやリスク、コンプライアンス、顧客体験、製品がもたらす成果、成長のバランスを調整した経験を含む、ビジネス上の優れた判断力
  • パートナー社の上層部、規制当局、政府関係者、業界団体への対応や一般向けの場など、社外で会社を代表した経験
  • 不確実な状況でも周囲をリードし、複雑な課題を計画に具体化し、ビジネス、製品、オペレーション、規制、技術に関するさまざまな課題において、測定可能な成果を上げた実績
  • プロダクト、エンジニアリング、財務、法務、コンプライアンス、リスク、ポリシー、マーケティング、オペレーション各チームと連携し、複雑な部門横断的イニシアチブを主導した経験
  • 英語でのエグゼクティブレベルのコミュニケーション能力とプレゼンテーションスキル。上層のステークホルダーに対して明確かつ説得力のある提言を行う能力
  • ネイティブレベルまたはビジネスレベルの日本語能力。日本を拠点とするパートナー社や規制当局と交渉し、働きかけ、信頼関係を構築する能力を含む

望ましい経験・知識

  • 経済産業省、金融庁、または関連する決済・金融サービス分野の当局など、日本の主要な規制当局または政府機関と直接連携した経験
  • 決済ファシリテーター、加盟店契約、カード発行、決済、クリアリング、勘定照合、カードネットワークの運用モデルに関する知識
  • 米国に本社を置くフィンテック、テクノロジー、決済、または金融サービス企業での勤務経験
  • メディア対応トレーニングの受講経験、または外部スポークスパーソン、業界代表者、市場の上級責任者としての実務経験

title: Creative Director, Block
locations: New York, NY, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
It all started with an idea at Block in 2013. Initially built to take the pain out of peer-to-peer payments, Cash App has gone from a simple product with a single purpose to a dynamic ecosystem, developing unique financial products, including Afterpay/Clearpay, to provide a better way to send, spend, invest, borrow and save to our 50+ million monthly active customers. We want to redefine the world’s relationship with money to make it more relatable, instantly available, and universally accessible.

Today, Cash App has thousands of employees working globally across office and remote locations, with a culture geared toward innovation, collaboration and impact. We’ve been a distributed team since day one, and many of our roles can be done remotely from the countries where Cash App operates. No matter the location, we tailor our experience to ensure our employees are creative, productive, and happy.

The Role

Block's in-house creative team builds the brand platforms and campaigns behind Cash App, Square, and Afterpay. We're hiring a creative director who originates the big idea (brand platforms, repositionings, campaign concepts) and stays with it until it's in market.Strategy sits inside creative, so you shape the brief rather than answer it, then carry the idea across every medium it lives in: film, social, experiential, copy, and online and offline activations.

This is an individual contributor role. You'll lead project teams and set the creative standard.

You Will

  • Originate brand platforms and campaign-level ideas, and own them from concept through activation
  • Reposition brands, and keep the platform coherent across brand and product surfaces
  • Hold the idea intact from first cut to final placement
  • Shape the brief alongside an embedded creative-strategy team
  • Direct designers, writers, and production partners on the work
  • Work with marketing, product, and partnerships leadership to get campaigns made

You Have

  • A portfolio of work you led as a creative director: brand platforms, repositionings, campaigns, activations
  • An art direction background and the visual judgment to lead the idea in any medium
  • A track record setting creative vision and quality standards for a brand, while staying hands-on with the work
  • Credibility with cross-functional leadership as a peer
  • A history of catching cultural shifts early and putting them in the work
  • Experience carrying brand thinking across multiple products or business lines
  • Experience working in agencies, in-house, or both

To Apply

Submit your application along with a link to your portfolio. Be sure to include the password in your application if needed.

EEOC

We’re working to build a more inclusive economy where our customers have equal access to opportunity, and we strive to live by these same values in building our workplace. Block is an equal opportunity employer evaluating all employees and job applicants without regard to identity or any legally protected class. We will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records for employment in accordance with state and local laws and “fair chance” ordinances.

We believe in being fair, and are committed to an inclusive interview experience, including providing reasonable accommodations to disabled applicants throughout the recruitment process. We encourage applicants to share any needed accommodations with their recruiter, who will treat these requests as confidentially as possible. Want to learn more about what we’re doing to build a workplace that is fair and square? Check out our I+D page.

title: Mid-Market Account Executive, Remote
locations: Kansas City, MO, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

The Role

At Square, we’re re-imagining how mid-market businesses grow. As a Senior Sales Account Executive on our Outbound Team, you’ll bring Square’s ecosystem to new sellers across diverse industries by building, shaping, and closing your own pipeline. You’ll run sophisticated, multi-product deals from the first touch to final close — blending hunter instincts, consultative depth, and strategic execution.

If you’re an experienced closer who thrives in outbound environments, loves solving meaningful business challenges, and consistently delivers against ambitious targets — this is your role.

You Will

  • Own the full outbound sales cycle — from prospecting to negotiation to close — with mid-market merchants.
  • Build and manage a high-quality pipeline through cold outreach, social selling, targeted campaigns, and creative outbound strategies.
  • Develop multi-product solutions across Square’s ecosystem and tailor them to each merchant’s unique needs.
  • Partner with Business Development on lead flow while independently driving net-new logo acquisition.
  • Conduct high-impact discovery, demos, and negotiations with decisiveness across multi-stakeholder deals.
  • Act as a consultant and trusted advisor — seamlessly flexing across BDR, AE, and AM responsibilities when needed.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Marketing, Implementation, and Operations to deliver cohesive solutions.
  • Maintain disciplined pipeline management and forecasting accuracy in Salesforce.
  • Consistently hit and exceed revenue goals — monthly and quarterly.

You Have

  • 5+ years of sales experience in a full cycle closing role
  • A BA/BS degree or relevant experience
  • Demonstrated exceeding sales targets, selling a diverse ecosystem of products, and closing complex deals
  • The ability to drive deals independently in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
  • Business development experience (e.g. new logo sourcing and acquisition)
  • A collaborative and team player mentality
  • Prior Salesforce experience or equivalent

Pay Transparency

The successful candidate's starting pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. These ranges may be modified in the future. title: Territory Account Executive, Boston
locations: Boston, MA, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

The Role

Square is building a best-in-class, high-impact field sales organization, and we are looking for an exceptional Territory Account Executive — someone who consistently exceeds expectations, takes full ownership of their territory, and brings Square's mission of economic empowerment directly to the businesses that need it most.

This is a field-driven, execution-focused role designed for individuals who thrive in dynamic, demanding environments. You will spend most of your week out in the market — meeting businesses, conducting live demos, and closing deals with confidence. The pace is fast, the expectations are high, and your ability to operate strategically and decisively will determine your success.

You will serve as Square's presence and competitive advantage in one of our highest-opportunity markets — responsible for building pipeline from the ground up, elevating Square's visibility in your community, establishing high-value partnerships, and helping local businesses grow through our ecosystem of industry-leading software and hardware.

If you are motivated by impactful work, driven to outperform, and eager to join a high-performance team with high standards, this role is built for you.

You will:

Lead your market with disciplined, in-person execution

  • Spend ~80% of your week in the field — walking your territory, engaging local businesses, and driving 50–60 targeted business visits each week.
  • Run a full-cycle, self-sourced sales motion: generate leads, identify needs, deliver compelling demos, and close deals across Square's full product suite.

Establish yourself as the go-to Square expert in your city

  • Build strong, trust-based relationships with local sellers by being present, reliable, and value-driven.
  • Partner cross-functionally to ensure a seamless onboarding experience and fast time-to-value for new sellers.
  • Implement a disciplined referral strategy to turn every new customer into future opportunities.

Build a high-velocity pipeline from the ground up

  • Develop a repeatable top-of-funnel engine through door-to-door outreach, community engagement, events, networking, and targeted partnerships.
  • Work with channel partners to generate a consistent, high-quality referral stream that grows over time.

Master your verticals and sell with precision

  • Build deep expertise in key verticals — including restaurants, retail, and services — to diagnose challenges and position the right Square solutions.
  • Sell consultatively and competitively, staying proactive and strategic throughout the sales cycle.

Achieve exceptional results in a high-accountability environment

  • Maintain strong operational rigor in Salesforce: track activity, manage pipeline, and forecast accurately.
  • Measure performance frequently and improve continuously.
  • Consistently exceed quota within a culture where high standards are the norm.

You have:

  • 3+ years of sales experience in a full cycle closing role with field sales experience
  • Experience exceeding sales targets, selling a diverse ecosystem of products, and closing complex deals
  • Ability to drive deals independently in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
  • Business development experience (e.g. hunting and cold calling)
  • Since this is a field position, you must have reliable transportation and live in the market you are serving
  • A collaborative and team player mentality
  • Prior Salesforce experience or equivalent
  • Even better:

descriptionHtml:

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

The Role

Square is building a best-in-class, high-impact field sales organization, and we are looking for an exceptional Territory Account Executive — someone who consistently exceeds expectations, takes full ownership of their territory, and brings Square's mission of economic empowerment directly to the businesses that need it most.

This is a field-driven, execution-focused role designed for individuals who thrive in dynamic, demanding environments. You will spend most of your week out in the market — meeting businesses, conducting live demos, and closing deals with confidence. The pace is fast, the expectations are high, and your ability to operate strategically and decisively will determine your success.

You will serve as Square's presence and competitive advantage in one of our highest-opportunity markets — responsible for building pipeline from the ground up, elevating Square's visibility in your community, establishing high-value partnerships, and helping local businesses grow through our ecosystem of industry-leading software and hardware.

If you are motivated by impactful work, driven to outperform, and eager to join a high-performance team with high standards, this role is built for you.

You will:

Lead your market with disciplined, in-person execution

  • Spend ~80% of your week in the field — walking your territory, engaging local businesses, and driving 50–60 targeted business visits each week.

Establish yourself as the go-to Square expert in your city

  • Build strong, trust-based relationships with local sellers by being present, reliable, and value-driven.
  • Partner cross-functionally to ensure a seamless onboarding experience and fast time-to-value for new sellers.
  • Implement a disciplined referral strategy to turn every new customer into future opportunities.

Build a high-velocity pipeline from the ground up

  • Develop a repeatable top-of-funnel engine through door-to-door outreach, community engagement, events, networking, and targeted partnerships.
  • Work with channel partners to generate a consistent, high-quality referral stream that grows over time.

Master your verticals and sell with precision

  • Build deep expertise in key verticals — including restaurants, retail, and services — to diagnose challenges and position the right Square solutions.
  • Sell consultatively and competitively, staying proactive and strategic throughout the sales cycle.

Achieve exceptional results in a high-accountability environment

  • Maintain strong operational rigor in Salesforce: track activity, manage pipeline, and forecast accurately.
  • Measure performance frequently and improve continuously.
  • Consistently exceed quota within a culture where high standards are the norm.

You have:

  • 3+ years of sales experience in a full cycle closing role with field sales experience
  • Experience exceeding sales targets, selling a diverse ecosystem of products, and closing complex deals
  • Ability to drive deals independently in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
  • Business development experience (e.g. hunting and cold calling)
  • Since this is a field position, you must have reliable transportation and live in the market you are serving
  • A collaborative and team player mentality
  • Prior Salesforce experience or equivalent
  • Even better:

    • 1+ years of relevant audience experience (experience working in/selling to restaurants, retailers or services based businesses)

title: Legal Innovation & Operations Lead
locations: Bay Area, CA, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
Block is one company built from many blocks, all united by the same purpose of economic empowerment. The blocks that form our foundational teams — People, Finance, Counsel, Hardware, Information Security, Platform Infrastructure Engineering, and more — provide support and guidance at the corporate level. They work across business groups and around the globe, spanning time zones and disciplines to develop inclusive People policies, forecast finances, give legal counsel, safeguard systems, nurture new initiatives, and more. Every challenge creates possibilities, and we need different perspectives to see them all. Bring yours to Block.

The Role

We are looking for a collaborative, curious operations professional with a passion for leading our Legal Innovation & Operations (LIO) team within our Counsel organization. We're looking for a strategic, detail-oriented builder to lead our team operations strategy from vision to execution. You will manage multiple workstreams, from continuing the work to improve the organization's technology and automation initiatives to managing our budget and reducing third-party spend where possible. We will task you with solving problems, optimizing processes, and bringing the power of automation and AI into how our work gets done.

You Will

  • Lead the charge on defining and driving our legal tech strategy, including setting the vision, building the roadmap, and delivering tools that make our team faster, smarter, and more connected.
  • Oversee our suite of legal systems (like CLM, eBilling, knowledge management and workflow platforms), ensuring they're optimized, well-integrated, and aligned with how the business actually works.
  • Manage our core digital platforms, keeping them efficient, intuitive, and budget-conscious.
  • Partner across Legal, Policy, IT, Finance, Business Operations and beyond to evaluate and roll out technology and solutions that streamlines work and improves the experience for everyone who touches it.
  • Design elegant solutions and connecting the dots between business needs and technology.
  • Build and maintain relationships with vendors, ensuring we get measurable value from our tech investments.
  • Lead multi-quarter, cross-functional projects that push automation, AI, and data-driven insights deeper into how we deliver our work throughout the organization.
  • Help create operational excellence wherever opportunities exist.

You Have

  • 8+ years of experience in legal operations, tech strategy, or a related operations-focused role.
  • Experience leading automation or AI initiatives that drive measurable improvements.
  • Capacity for managing budgets, timelines, and stakeholders, with a sharp eye for detail and follow-through.
  • Adaptive communication methods, translating technical detail into clear business value.
  • A collaborative and curious mindset, unafraid to experiment or rethink how things are done.
  • Familiarity with platforms like DocuSign CLM or workflow automation tools (bonus points for hands-on implementation experience).
  • Experience building trust quickly and working well with everyone from senior leadership to individual contributors.

title: Programmatic Account Executive
locations: New York, NY, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
It all started with an idea at Block in 2013. Initially built to take the pain out of peer-to-peer payments, Cash App has gone from a simple product with a single purpose to a dynamic ecosystem, developing unique financial products, including Afterpay (BNPL), to provide a better way to send, spend, invest, borrow and save to our 100+ million targetable customers. We want to redefine the world’s relationship with money to make it more relatable, instantly available, and universally accessible.

Today, Cash App and Afterpay have thousands of employees working globally across office and remote locations, with a culture geared toward innovation, collaboration and impact. We’ve been a distributed team since day one, and many of our roles can be done remotely from the countries where Cash App operates. No matter the location, we tailor our experience to ensure our employees are creative, productive, and happy.

The Role

Cash App and Afterpay are scaling its commerce media business in the U.S., and we're building the team that will define what it becomes. We're looking for our first dedicated ad sales hire for the Cash App Media Network — a hybrid Account Executive/Account Manager who can both win new business and grow it once it's won. This is a 0-to-1 role: you'll be prospecting and closing new commerce advertising partnerships one day and managing and expanding existing relationships the next, with the flexibility to be a builder and a catch-all as we stand up the function.

Beyond external sales, you'll be a key internal evangelist for commerce media — helping cross functional teams, such as Growth Marketing and Partner Marketing, understand how our advertising solutions can act as a multiplier for their own goals, not just a standalone revenue line. You'll be equally comfortable pitching a brand-side CMO and pitching an internal XFN lead on why this matters.

The ideal candidate has a proven track record in programmatic and social platform sales and/or senior level account management, thrives in ambiguity, and has genuine entrepreneurial instincts — someone who wants to shape a business from the ground up rather than execute inside an established one.

You Will

  • Own the full lifecycle of a book of business — from prospecting and closing new programmatic and social partnerships (endemic and non-endemic) to managing, retaining, and growing those relationships post-sale.
  • Translate advertiser objectives into strategic programmatic campaigns using our ad formats, audience targeting, insights, and measurement tools — and oversee execution to ensure flawless delivery.
  • Serve as the primary client contact across the relationship lifecycle, building trusted relationships with brand and agency-side stakeholders top-down and bottoms-up.
  • Evangelize commerce media internally — partnering with internal functions to position our advertising solutions as a multiplier for their existing goals, not a separate initiative.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Strategy & Ops, Data Science, Product, Marketing and Payments to surface client feedback, inform roadmap priorities, collaborate strategically on endemic Enterprise merchants and ensure advertiser needs are represented.
  • Identify and pitch new growth opportunities — new formats, new surfaces, new pilots — both to external clients and internal stakeholders.
  • Inform the foundation as you go: sales narratives, case studies, playbooks, and enablement materials that don't exist yet but will be needed as the team scales.
  • Monitor campaign performance and deliver actionable insights and optimization recommendations that drive ROI and retention.
  • Stay ahead of industry trends — DSP innovation, privacy changes, audience targeting shifts, commerce media developments — to act as a trusted advisor both externally and internally.

You Have

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in business, marketing, communications, or related field.
  • 7-10+ years of experience in programmatic advertising, spanning sales and/or account management, within a retail media network, digital publisher, agency trading desk, or DSP/SSP platform.
  • A track record of both closing new business and growing existing accounts — comfortable operating across the full client lifecycle.
  • Solid understanding of the programmatic ecosystem, including DSPs, SSPs, audience targeting, measurement, attribution, and brand safety.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence both external partners and internal stakeholders across functions.
  • Comfortable working in ambiguous, cross-functional environments and collaborating closely with Strategy & Ops, Data Science, Partnerships, Ad Ops, Product and Partner Marketing.
  • A builder's mindset — comfortable with ambiguity, undefined process, and being a catch-all in the early days of a new function.
  • Passion for digital advertising and commerce media; experience in fintech, retail, or commerce-related businesses is a strong plus.
