title: Staff Software Engineer, Go-to-Market Systems & AI
locations: Bay Area, CA, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

The Role

The Go-to-Market Engineering team builds the systems, automations, and AI-powered experiences that help our sales teams spend less time on manual work and more time serving customers. As a Staff Software Engineer, you will be the technical owner of our go-to-market technology stack, setting its architecture and long-term direction while leading engineers through complex, high-impact sales problems. You will partner with Sales, Sales Strategy & Operations, Product, Data, and Engineering leaders to deliver reliable, scalable solutions that improve sales productivity and business performance.

You Will

  • Own the technical strategy, architecture, and long-term evolution of our go-to-market technology stack.
  • Design, build, and operate production-grade AI agents and automated workflows that reduce manual sales work, improve decision-making, and give time back to sales teams.
  • Lead technical execution across initiatives of varying sizes by setting direction, breaking down complex problems, reviewing designs, and helping engineers deliver high-quality solutions.
  • Remain hands-on throughout the software lifecycle, from prototyping and architecture through implementation, testing, deployment, and production operations.
  • Partner with Sales and Sales Strategy & Operations to understand workflows, identify high-value opportunities, and translate business problems into scalable technical solutions.
  • Establish the patterns, evaluation methods, and guardrails needed to build AI systems that are reliable, observable, secure, and safe to use with sensitive business data.
  • Define success measures and use data, evaluations, and user feedback to improve the accuracy, adoption, and business impact of new capabilities.
  • Make thoughtful build-versus-buy decisions and guide integrations across internal platforms, customer relationship management systems, data services, and third-party tools.
  • Build alignment with senior technical and business partners, communicate complex tradeoffs clearly, and raise engineering standards through mentorship and design reviews.

You Have

  • A minimum of 12 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 8 years and a Master’s degree; or a PhD with 5 years experience; or equivalent experience.
  • Experience setting technical direction and delivering complex, business-critical systems across multiple teams or functional areas.
  • Experience designing, building, and operating production software that uses large language models, AI agents, tool calling, retrieval, workflow orchestration, or related technologies.
  • A track record of moving AI capabilities from prototype to production, including evaluation, observability, security, reliability, and human oversight.
  • An AI-native approach to engineering, using AI tools throughout development while applying sound judgment about when to use models, deterministic software, or human review.
  • Strong software engineering and system-design skills, with the ability to work hands-on across application, service, integration, and data layers.
  • Experience leading technical execution through influence, mentorship, architecture, and direct contribution, without relying on formal reporting authority.
  • The judgment to navigate ambiguous problems, evaluate technical and business tradeoffs, and influence senior engineering and business partners.
  • Familiarity with sales processes or go-to-market systems—such as lead management, opportunity management, forecasting, account planning, or customer relationship management platforms—is helpful but not required.

title: Retail Partner Manager
locations: Bay Area, CA, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

The Role

As we grow Square's presence across the US Retail Channel, we're looking for a Retail Partner Manager to drive awareness and acquisition of Square at major US retailers such as Best Buy, Walmart, Target, and other large format retailers. You'll own quarterly sales and revenue goals for Square Hardware in the channel – optimizing our existing retail partnerships and unlocking new growth within them, from partner mix, placement, and promotional strategy to entirely new ways of partnering. This is a high-ownership role that requires an entrepreneurial operator: someone who navigates ambiguity and setbacks with resourcefulness, engages the right internal partners – across Supply & Demand, Growth Partnerships, Product Marketing, and Finance.

You will:

  • Own channel results: Meet quarterly sales and revenue goals for Square Hardware across US retail, tracking sell-through, forecasting, and growth initiatives tied to seller acquisition and revenue.
  • Build the playbook: Create, test, and evolve go-to-market strategies for key retailers – including approaches that don't exist yet today – moving fast from hypothesis to pilot to scaled rollout.
  • Grow existing partnerships: Own relationships with current retailers and distributor partners end-to-end as their primary contact at Square, proactively architecting new partnership models and formats rather than defending the status quo.
  • Source and sign new partners: Identify, evaluate, pitch, negotiate, and close new retail partnerships from the ground up – often with no existing relationship, internal champion, or playbook to follow.
  • Drive cross-functional execution: Lead work across Supply & Demand, Growth Partnerships, Finance, Product Marketing, and Operations on launches, weekly forecasting, and GTM readiness – proactively pulling in the right people for thought partnership when you hit a wall, rather than waiting to be told.
  • Deploy budget like an owner: Manage the retail marketing budget with a test-and-learn mindset – run scrappy experiments, read results quickly, and reallocate investment with urgency toward what's working.

You Have:

  • 5+ years in business-to-business sales, account management, or retail marketing – preferably in Consumer Electronics, with deep experience at Best Buy, Walmart, Costco, or other large-format retailers.
  • A proven track record of building a partnership, program, or channel from scratch and scaling it to success – without relying on existing playbooks or infrastructure.
  • Resourcefulness and tenacity to push through obstacles and find creative paths to results in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate with high autonomy and minimal oversight: setting your own priorities, moving with urgency, and proactively looping in the right internal partners rather than waiting for direction.
  • The ability to balance quarterly execution with a multi-quarter strategic view – and to see around the corner as the retail landscape evolves.
  • Strong analytical, structured thinking to assess business opportunities and campaign performance, balanced with comfort acting before all the data or process exists.
  • Experience managing external decision makers and influencing cross-functional teams through credibility rather than authority.
  • A BA or equivalent experience; ability to travel (~20%).

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Are a builder. Your best work has come from creating systems, programs, or partnerships from the ground up – not from optimizing something already running.
  • Are energized by dead ends. You don't have every answer up front, and the process of finding them invigorates you. When a path gets blocked, your instinct is to find three more, not to escalate and wait.
  • Test and learn with urgency. You'd rather run a scrappy pilot this week and learn from it than wait for a perfect plan next quarter – and you move fast once you see a signal.
  • Operate like an owner. You hold yourself accountable for outcomes, not activity, and you don't need supervision or structure to do your best work. Ambiguity is part of the gig, and you like it that way.
  • Are a connector. You know when to pull in thought partners across the company, and you build the internal relationships to do it before you need them.

title: Compensation Strategy & Program Partner
locations: Bay Area, CA, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
Block is one company built from many blocks, all united by the same purpose of economic empowerment. The blocks that form our foundational teams — People, Finance, Counsel, Hardware, Information Security, Platform Infrastructure Engineering, and more — provide support and guidance at the corporate level. They work across business groups and around the globe, spanning time zones and disciplines to develop inclusive People policies, forecast finances, give legal counsel, safeguard systems, nurture new initiatives, and more. Every challenge creates possibilities, and we need different perspectives to see them all. Bring yours to Block.

The Role

We are looking for a Compensation Strategy & Program Lead to join our team in an AI-first operating model—one where compensation rules, decisions, and reporting are increasingly encoded into automated workflows and self-service tools rather than handled case by case. As our primary compensation archetype, our Program Leads operate as internal product owners. Beyond hands-on partnership, they architect scalable frameworks, build self-service governance, and drive strategic total rewards programs across the company.

Working as part of a lean pod of peer Program Leads, you will take full ownership of major program pillars while collaborating closely on overarching compensation philosophy, automation initiatives, and data-driven tooling.

You Will

  • Own & Deliver Core Program Portfolios: Take strategic and operational ownership of assigned program pillars (e.g., focal cycles, equity architecture, salary structures, geo-pay, promotions, or specialized incentive frameworks), with the agility to evolve and rotate portfolio ownership over time.
  • Collaborate within the Program Lead Cohort: Partner with peers to ensure strategic alignment, a cohesive global philosophy, and unified program delivery across different business areas and lifecycles.
  • Build for Scalability & Self-Service: Work with Comp Ops and Data/Tooling to reduce manual triage by translating compensation rules into automated workflows, AI-assisted self-serve resources, and centralized reporting.
  • Establish Policy as Code & Governance: Design transparent guardrails and delegation-of-authority frameworks that empower managers and People partners to make confident pay decisions autonomously.
  • Serve as a Macro-Level Strategic Advisor: Advise senior leadership on talent market positioning, pay equity, and organizational design, prioritizing systemic improvements alongside the day-to-day

You Have

  • Program / Product Orientation: 6+ years of proven experience designing, iterating, and scaling enterprise compensation programs end-to-end, in addition to strong frontline consulting instincts.
  • Cohort Collaboration & Autonomy: A high degree of independence in driving your portfolios, paired with strong cross-functional collaboration to maintain alignment across the team.
  • Systems & AI-First Mindset: A strong instinct to solve edge cases through policy redesign, automation, and self-service tooling rather than repeated manual intervention.
  • Analytical & Data Rigor: High proficiency in quantitative modeling and evaluating macro compensation metrics, with comfort partnering alongside data and operations teams.
  • Experience & Tools: Substantial compensation experience (level to be calibrated to the role) and fluency with modern comp planning, HRIS, and data/analytics tooling

title: Account Executive Manager
locations: Tokyo, Japan
descriptionHtml:
The Role

As a Sales Manager, you'll lead a team of Account Executives and own one of our most critical growth levers in-market: developing talent that consistently outperforms while helping Japanese sellers succeed. This role is about building a high-performance sales organization where every hire raises the bar, every coaching conversation sharpens execution, and every decision is grounded in data — all within the realities of the Japanese market.

You'll operate at the intersection of local and global. You'll adapt our global playbooks to how deals are actually won in Japan — where trust is earned over time, decisions are made by consensus, and relationships matter as much as the commercial case. You'll bring the rigor, along with the energy.

You'll be expected to coach in the work, not after it. You'll diagnose pipeline health before it becomes a forecasting problem, develop future leaders before promotions become necessary, and create an operating rhythm that enables predictable, repeatable growth in a market with long, relationship-driven sales cycles.

You'll partner cross-functionally — locally and with regional/global HQ — to improve how we sell in Japan, challenge the status quo, and continuously raise the talent bar. Success is measured not only by quota attainment, but by the strength of your team, the quality of your pipeline, and the leaders you develop.

Build a High-Performance Team

  • Hire bilingual Account Executives who can run complex, multi-stakeholder deals in-market, and raise the bar with every addition to your team — competing effectively for scarce sales talent in Tokyo.
  • Develop a culture of ownership, accountability, continuous learning and high standards, balanced with the trust and cohesion that Japanese teams are built on.
  • Identify future top performers early and create development plans that accelerate their growth.
  • Ramp and retain talent in a competitive local labour market where strong bilingual sellers have options.

Co-Sell on Complex Deals

  • Sell alongside your team in discovery, business case development and negotiation on your most important pursuits. 
  • Engage senior stakeholders directly — including owners, operations and finance — and help your team multi-thread and navigate consensus-driven, bottom-up decision-making rather than selling to a single champion.
  • Bring commercial judgment to pricing, deal structure and competitive displacement against local players. 
  • Advance the deal while leaving the AE more capable of running the next one without you.

Coach Through Data & Business Intelligence

  • Lead your business through rigorous pipeline inspection, forecasting and performance diagnostics.
  • Use leading indicators to identify performance gaps early and coach reps toward sustainable improvement.
  • Turn data into action by identifying trends, diagnosing root causes and driving measurable improvements across your team.
  • Forecast accurately on long-cycle deals, which depends on stage integrity rather than optimism — and account for local cycle length and relationship-building phases.

Drive Operational Excellence

  • Establish predictable operating rhythms around forecasting, pipeline management and business reviews.
  • Build disciplined execution that creates consistent, repeatable revenue outcomes.
  • Continuously improve how your team sells by refining processes, simplifying execution and eliminating friction.
  • Build repeatable plays for how this segment is won in Japan — from acquisition through implementation and expansion.

Lead Through Influence

  • Partner closely with Sales Leadership, Marketing, Enablement, Operations, Partnerships and Product — locally and at regional/global HQ — to improve the customer journey and strengthen commercial execution.
  • Act as a two-way bridge: bring global best practice into Japan, and bring the Japanese customer voice and field intelligence back to shape strategy and influence product evolution.
  • Use customer insights and local market knowledge to localise strategy for Japan's cashless transition (the national push toward ~65% cashless by 2030) and the merchant landscape.
  • Lead through change by helping your team adapt quickly while maintaining high performance.

You Have

  • 6+ years experience as a sales manager, including time leading teams selling into complex, multi-stakeholder accounts with cycles measured in months.
  • Native or business-level fluency in Japanese, plus professional business-level English — able to lead in-market in Japanese and collaborate effectively with regional/global stakeholders in English.
  • Deep knowledge of the Japanese market — including the Seller landscape, buying behavior, business etiquette, and consensus-based decision-making — and ideally experience in payments, fintech, SaaS or a related B2B category.
  • An understanding of the Japanese cashless/payments environment and competitive dynamics (e.g. QR-code wallets, card networks and bank-led offerings), and how these shape merchant decisions.
  • Experience hiring, ramping and retaining Account Executives who can run considered, competitive deals — ideally within the Japanese talent market.
  • Experience developing already strong performers into people who win larger and more complex deals.
  • Proven track record in collaborating across different teams, including across a local–global structure, with the ability to inspire change.
  • Leadership and coaching experience and a desire to help others be their best.
  • Expertise in creating structure around sales metrics and managing yourself and others to achieve these metrics, including forecast accuracy on long-cycle deals.
  • An understanding of how to refine decision-making and consider the downstream and upstream effects of potential decisions.
  • Experience localising global sales playbooks and enablement for the Japanese market.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Go-to-Market Systems & AI
locations: New York, NY, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

The Role

The Go-to-Market Engineering team builds the systems, automations, and AI-powered experiences that help our sales teams spend less time on manual work and more time serving customers. As a Staff Software Engineer, you will be the technical owner of our go-to-market technology stack, setting its architecture and long-term direction while leading engineers through complex, high-impact sales problems. You will partner with Sales, Sales Strategy & Operations, Product, Data, and Engineering leaders to deliver reliable, scalable solutions that improve sales productivity and business performance.

You Will

  • Own the technical strategy, architecture, and long-term evolution of our go-to-market technology stack.
  • Design, build, and operate production-grade AI agents and automated workflows that reduce manual sales work, improve decision-making, and give time back to sales teams.
  • Lead technical execution across initiatives of varying sizes by setting direction, breaking down complex problems, reviewing designs, and helping engineers deliver high-quality solutions.
  • Remain hands-on throughout the software lifecycle, from prototyping and architecture through implementation, testing, deployment, and production operations.
  • Partner with Sales and Sales Strategy & Operations to understand workflows, identify high-value opportunities, and translate business problems into scalable technical solutions.
  • Establish the patterns, evaluation methods, and guardrails needed to build AI systems that are reliable, observable, secure, and safe to use with sensitive business data.
  • Define success measures and use data, evaluations, and user feedback to improve the accuracy, adoption, and business impact of new capabilities.
  • Make thoughtful build-versus-buy decisions and guide integrations across internal platforms, customer relationship management systems, data services, and third-party tools.
  • Build alignment with senior technical and business partners, communicate complex tradeoffs clearly, and raise engineering standards through mentorship and design reviews.

You Have

  • A minimum of 12 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 8 years and a Master’s degree; or a PhD with 5 years experience; or equivalent experience.
  • Experience setting technical direction and delivering complex, business-critical systems across multiple teams or functional areas.
  • Experience designing, building, and operating production software that uses large language models, AI agents, tool calling, retrieval, workflow orchestration, or related technologies.
  • A track record of moving AI capabilities from prototype to production, including evaluation, observability, security, reliability, and human oversight.
  • An AI-native approach to engineering, using AI tools throughout development while applying sound judgment about when to use models, deterministic software, or human review.
  • Strong software engineering and system-design skills, with the ability to work hands-on across application, service, integration, and data layers.
  • Experience leading technical execution through influence, mentorship, architecture, and direct contribution, without relying on formal reporting authority.
  • The judgment to navigate ambiguous problems, evaluate technical and business tradeoffs, and influence senior engineering and business partners.
  • Familiarity with sales processes or go-to-market systems—such as lead management, opportunity management, forecasting, account planning, or customer relationship management platforms—is helpful but not required.

title: Creative Director, Tidal
locations: New York, NY, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

Tidal was founded for artists by artists as the next innovative streaming platform to bring value back to the music industry. We empower artists with the products, resources, services, and content required to take control of their careers and connect more deeply with fans. Available in over 60+ countries, Tidal continues to help artists break down economic barriers to continue creating what's next in culture. Tidal is part of Block, Inc. (NYSE: SQ), a global technology company with a focus on financial services.

The Role

Tidal is a small, nimble design team building at the intersection of music, technology, and culture—shipping across uploads, streaming, AI-powered creative tools, and financial services that connect artists directly with their audiences in 60+ countries. We're looking for a Creative Director to help set the vision and quality bar across Tidal's product and brand ecosystem. This is a rare opportunity to be a foundational creative voice on a small team where your work will have outsized impact—shaping not just pixels but the future of how artists build careers. You'll drive complex initiatives from concept to ship, influence cross-functional strategy, and directly elevate the craft of everyone around you.

This is an individual contributor role. You'll lead project teams and set the creative standard.

You Will

  • Originate brand platforms and campaign-level ideas, and own them from concept through 360 activation
  • Reposition, reshape the brand and bring a tapped in culture and keep the platform coherent across brand and product surfaces
  • Hold the idea intact from first cut to final placement
  • Shape the brief alongside an embedded creative-strategy team
  • Design and when needed direct designers, writers, and production partners on the work
  • Work with marketing, product, and partnerships leadership to get campaigns made

You Have

  • A portfolio of work you led as a creative director: brand platforms, repositionings, campaigns, activations
  • An art direction background and the visual judgment to lead the idea in any medium
  • A track record setting creative vision and quality standards for a brand, while staying hands-on with the work
  • Credibility with cross-functional leadership as a peer
  • A history of catching cultural shifts early and putting them in the work
  • Experience carrying brand thinking across multiple products or business lines
  • Experience working in agencies, in-house, or both

How to Apply

Please submit your application along with a link to your portfolio. If your portfolio is password-protected, include the password in your application.

title: Software Engineer, Cash App Taxes
locations: New York, NY, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
It all started with an idea at Block in 2013. Initially built to take the pain out of peer-to-peer payments, Cash App has gone from a simple product with a single purpose to a dynamic ecosystem, developing unique financial products, including Afterpay/Clearpay, to provide a better way to send, spend, invest, borrow and save to our 50+ million monthly active customers. We want to redefine the world's relationship with money to make it more relatable, instantly available, and universally accessible.

Today, Cash App has thousands of employees working globally across office and remote locations, with a culture geared toward innovation, collaboration and impact. We've been a distributed team since day one, and many of our roles can be done remotely from the countries where Cash App operates. No matter the location, we tailor our experience to ensure our employees are creative, productive, and happy.

The Role

Cash App is offering a better way to file your taxes as an alternative to traditional online DIY tax preparation systems. As a Software Engineer on our Tax Engine Server Engineering team, you will build and enhance the codebase that powers our tax filing experience. You will translate complex tax requirements into seamless software solutions that help millions of users confidently navigate and complete their returns with ease.

You will collaborate closely with product managers, tax experts on our Tax Product Specialist team, and other cross-functional teams to ensure our platform remains accurate, reliable, and easy to use. If you are a skilled engineer who thrives on solving complex problems and wants to make a direct impact on a transformative product within a rapidly growing company, this role is for you.

You Will

  • Design, build, and own high-quality features and systems that power the Cash App Taxes filing experience, from federal and state form logic to e-file submission.
  • Translate complex tax rules and requirements into clean, maintainable, and well-tested code in close partnership with Tax Product Specialists.
  • Build tools and guardrails that enable non-technical contributors to make code changes safely that maintain our quality standards.
  • Drive architectural and design decisions, ensuring our tax software remains scalable, secure, and maintainable.
  • Write reliable, well-tested code and establish best practices for coding, testing, deployment, and documentation.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Quality Assurance, Tax Product Specialists, Cloud Platform, Design, Product, Customer Care, and other teams to deliver cohesive solutions.
  • Proactively identify and resolve issues related to accuracy, reliability, and performance, balancing new feature development with ongoing maintenance.
  • Stay informed about emerging technologies and industry best practices to continually refine our development processes.
  • Apply an AI-first mindset in your everyday work, raising the bar of AI application on our team

You Have

  • 4+ years of professional software development experience, preferably in a fast-paced or product-centric environment. Experience in the tax industry is a major plus.
  • Strong technical skills in backend development, including system design, architecture, and object-oriented programming.
  • A track record of delivering reliable, high-quality software solutions on schedule.

title: Territory Account Executive, Atlanta
locations: Atlanta, GA, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

The Role

Square is building a best-in-class, high-impact field sales organization, and we are looking for an exceptional Territory Account Executive — someone who consistently exceeds expectations, takes full ownership of their territory, and brings Square’s mission of economic empowerment directly to the businesses that need it most. 

This is a field-driven, execution-focused role designed for individuals who thrive in dynamic, demanding environments. You will spend most of your week out in the market — meeting businesses, conducting live demos, and closing deals with confidence. The pace is fast, the expectations are high, and your ability to operate strategically and decisively will determine your success.

You will serve as Square’s presence and competitive advantage in one of our highest-opportunity markets — responsible for building pipeline from the ground up, elevating Square’s visibility in your community, establishing high-value partnerships, and helping local businesses grow through our ecosystem of industry-leading software and hardware.

If you are motivated by impactful work, driven to outperform, and eager to join a high-performance team with high standards, this role is built for you.

You will:

Lead your market with disciplined, in-person execution

  • Spend ~80% of your week in the field — walking your territory, engaging local businesses, and driving 50–60 targeted business visits each week.
  • Run a full-cycle, self-sourced sales motion: generate leads, identify needs, deliver compelling demos, and close deals across Square’s full product suite.

Establish yourself as the go-to Square expert in your city

  • Build strong, trust-based relationships with local sellers by being present, reliable, and value-driven.
  • Partner cross-functionally to ensure a seamless onboarding experience and fast time-to-value for new sellers.
  • Implement a disciplined referral strategy to turn every new customer into future opportunities.

Build a high-velocity pipeline from the ground up

  • Develop a repeatable top-of-funnel engine through door-to-door outreach, community engagement, events, networking, and targeted partnerships.
  • Work with channel partners to generate a consistent, high-quality referral stream that grows over time.

Master your verticals and sell with precision

  • Build deep expertise in key verticals — including restaurants, retail, and services — to diagnose challenges and position the right Square solutions.
  • Sell consultatively and competitively, staying proactive and strategic throughout the sales cycle.

Achieve exceptional results in a high-accountability environment

  • Maintain strong operational rigor in Salesforce: track activity, manage pipeline, and forecast accurately.
  • Measure performance frequently and improve continuously.
  • Consistently exceed quota within a culture where high standards are the norm.

You have:

  • 3+ years of sales experience in a full cycle closing role with field sales experience
  • Experience exceeding sales targets, selling a diverse ecosystem of products, and closing complex deals
  • Ability to drive deals independently in a fast-paced, dynamic environment 
  • Business development experience (e.g. hunting and cold calling)
  • Since this is a field position, you must have reliable transportation and live in the market you are serving
  • A collaborative and team player mentality
  • Prior Salesforce experience or equivalent
  • Even better:
    • 2+ years of payment processing OR related technology (i.e. payroll, loyalty, time management)
    • 1+ years of relevant audience experience (experience working in/selling to restaurants, retailers or services based businesses)

descriptionHtml:
It all started with an idea at Block in 2013. Initially built to take the pain out of peer-to-peer payments, Cash App has gone from a simple product with a single purpose to a dynamic ecosystem, developing unique financial products, including Afterpay/Clearpay, to provide a better way to send, spend, invest, borrow and save to our 50+ million monthly active customers. We want to redefine the world’s relationship with money to make it more relatable, instantly available, and universally accessible.

Today, Cash App has thousands of employees working globally across office and remote locations, with a culture geared toward innovation, collaboration and impact. We’ve been a distributed team since day one, and many of our roles can be done remotely from the countries where Cash App operates. No matter the location, we tailor our experience to ensure our employees are creative, productive, and happy.

The Role

At Block, we strive to build the best financial products in the world. The Financial Platform Issuing team owns the card issuing platform that serves every Block brand — powering Cash App Card, the fourth-largest debit card program in the US, alongside Square Card and the new card programs Block launches next.

We run the full lifecycle of a card: issuance, fulfillment, and activation; real-time transaction authorization and processing across card networks; digital wallet provisioning; 3-D Secure authentication; clearing and settlement; and disputes. When a customer taps their card at a register, our systems decide the outcome in milliseconds, around the clock, in partnership with card networks and bank partners.

As a Staff Software Engineer on the Issuing server engineering team, you will bring deep card-network expertise to some of the most complex technical work on our roadmap. You will work alongside technical leads and cross functional teams, going deep where our platform meets the networks: specifications, protocols, certification, mandates, conformance, and production behavior.

This is a hands-on role. You will build systems and tooling, debug at the message level, and turn your network expertise into durable capabilities that other engineers can use. You will also work directly with the networks themselves — not only understanding what they require, but knowing where and how to influence outcomes for Block.

You Will

  • Be a deep technical expert on global card networks, helping Issuing teams interpret network specifications, message flows, certification requirements, mandates, and production behavior — and working directly with the networks to influence requirements, resolve ambiguity, and secure outcomes that matter for Block.
  • Lead complex, ambiguous engineering problems at the network boundary that span multiple teams, systems, or domains.
  • Partner with technical leads, program DRIs, and senior stakeholders to shape solutions where card-network requirements intersect with Block's issuing platform.
  • Stay deeply hands-on: write production code, build certification and conformance tooling, analyze network messages, review designs and code, and debug issues down to the protocol and field level.
  • Drive network certification and mandatory release cycles end to end, and translate network requirements into clear, pragmatic engineering decisions.
  • Establish shared frameworks, standards, tooling, and practices that make network expertise durable and enable teams to operate independently.
  • Raise the technical capability of engineers around you through design guidance, code reviews, mentorship, documentation, and clear technical judgment.
  • Apply AI-powered tools throughout the engineering lifecycle to improve velocity and quality, and help establish effective patterns for broader team use.
  • Share operational ownership of critical financial systems through on-call, incident response, and continuous improvements to reliability and correctness.

You Have

  • Deep, current expertise with at least one major card network, ideally Visa, including direct connectivity, ISO 8583, authorization and clearing flows, stand-in processing, specifications, certification, and mandate cycles.
  • Personally built, certified, or operated a live direct network connection — not only integrated through a processor.
  • Experience working directly with card networks to land concrete outcomes, such as rulings, exceptions, extensions, configuration changes, defect fixes, or certification outcomes.
  • Strong hands-on software engineering experience building and operating highly reliable financial or payments systems at scale.
  • A track record of leading technically complex, ambiguous work across team boundaries and influencing technical direction beyond your immediate area of ownership.
  • Experience creating durable technical leverage — frameworks, standards, tooling, architecture, or practices that other engineers and teams adopt.
  • Broad understanding of the card lifecycle, with depth in areas such as issuance and fulfillment, provisioning and activation, authorization, ledgering, clearing and settlement, reconciliation, disputes, or fraud.
  • Working knowledge of Mastercard and American Express, alongside deep expertise in at least one major network.
  • Fluency with AI-assisted engineering workflows and sound judgment in evaluating and applying AI-generated output.
  • Willingness to participate in an on-call rotation for critical financial systems.

title: Head of SMB Acquisition
locations: Melbourne, Australia
department: 20229 S&M - Sales - Commerce Enterprise and Mid
descriptionHtml:
We started a movement in which everyone can win – shoppers, retailers, society and every person on our team. To play fair, trust people and reward them for doing the right thing. We see and feel the impact of our work as more and more people gain financial freedom and retailers grow across the globe.

Founded in 2014 in Sydney, Australia, Afterpay has over 24 million active customers globally and more than 250,000 of the best retailers around the world including Anthropologie, Revolve, DSW, GOAT, Finish Line, Levi’s, Mac Cosmetics, Ray-Ban and many others.

Afterpay is helping people spend responsibly! We empower customers to access the things they want and need, while still allowing them to maintain financial wellness and control, by splitting payments in four, for both online and in-store purchases. Afterpay is deeply committed to delivering positive outcomes for customers. Now under the Block ecosystem, we are focused on supporting our community of shoppers.

We trust in the next generation and share a vision of a more accessible and sustainable world in which people are rewarded for doing the right thing.

The Role

The Australia and New Zealand SMB & Franchise Sales team at Afterpay is responsible for driving revenue to our core consumer payments business, giving our Merchant partners access to one of the largest and most engaged networks of next generation consumers.

We are looking for a strategic, analytical, high-energy, and experienced Head of SMB Acquisition Sales to lead and scale a high-velocity, playbook-driven sales engine across a broad and growing base of small and medium-sized businesses, while forging and expanding relationships with fast-growing and established Franchise partners. The SMB segment spans multiple motions, including a BDR function that sources and books meetings for Account Executives, an Inbound motion serving smaller, higher-volume businesses, and an Outbound-led motion focused on larger, higher-growth SMB and Premium SMB segments. The Franchise motion adds a higher-touch, more sophisticated sales environment focused on winning and expanding relationships with leading franchise groups and brands from SMB’s through to Mid and Enterprise size prospects. You will be responsible for orchestrating these motions into a cohesive system and for the discipline, tooling, processes, and deal strategies that help generate pipeline, convert opportunities, onboard merchants efficiently, and win business at scale.

A successful candidate exhibits a strong sense of ownership to win new business for Afterpay and a demonstrated ability to navigate ambiguity; think strategically and operationally about business, marketing, product, and technical challenges; and lead cross-functional workstreams ultimately tied to pipeline creation, conversion, and revenue growth. This role requires a strategic problem solver who is a rigorous operator, relentless negotiator, and effective influencer, comfortable balancing data-driven rigor and scalable sales processes with high-touch relationship building, a strong bias for action, and hands-on execution.

Beyond ultimately being responsible for revenue outcomes across our SMB & Franchise merchant pipeline - spanning a broad range of industries across retail, fashion, beauty, travel, QSR, home and more across Australia and New Zealand - you will also be responsible for building and supporting a strong culture of performance. You will develop leaders and individual contributors, create clarity and accountability across the organization, and lead with empathy without ego.

The ideal candidate has demonstrated excellence in building and operating high-velocity sales motions at scale, navigating complex commercial negotiations, leading and managing high-performing teams, and continuously improving how teams sell, operate, and deliver results.

You Will

  • Oversee the A/NZ SMB & Franchise Sales Team: Lead a multi-motion organization spanning BDR, Inbound and Outbound Account Executives, together with the Franchise sales motion. Build and continuously refine the playbooks, processes and tooling that let the team convert and grow merchants efficiently at high volume while also enabling sophisticated, high-touch Franchise deal execution. Craft a segment-wide strategy and hold the team accountable to delivering on OKRs and revenue targets across each motion, in concert with the broader Sales & Account Management function at Afterpay.
  • Build an A-Team: Inherit and further develop a team of strong performers and leaders with relevant experience. Build their skills, knowledge, efficacy, and an overall culture focused on performance and continuous improvement, including coaching frontline managers to drive results through their own teams. Set an energetic and accountable tone for the A/NZ sales organization, rooted in a strong sense of ownership and led with empathy over ego.
  • Develop Meaningful Cross-Functional Partnerships: Work closely with cross-functional teams to better support your team in generating revenue, including Marketing, Finance, Product, Engineering, Risk, Legal, Account Management, Partnerships and more. Influence without authority across teams and build the internal relationships required to navigate a distributed, global and matrixed set of stakeholders.
  • Own Sales Process and Methodology: Build and refine repeatable sales approaches across the full deal lifecycle - from prospecting, discovery and qualification through articulating value, solutioning, negotiating, contracting, closing and onboarding. Balance standardized, scalable SMB motions with the flexibility and commercial judgment required for more complex Franchise opportunities.
  • Craft Deal Strategy: Develop and pitch powerful sales narratives that educate prospective merchants on Afterpay's value proposition. Coach the team through sophisticated deal negotiations, support internal and external advocacy, clear blockers to revenue, and effectively communicate with senior decision makers at high-growth and established brands and franchise groups.
  • Drive Forecasting Rigor and Pipeline Hygiene: Implement and maintain best practices in forecasting accuracy, pipeline coverage, pipeline health, opportunity progression, and conversion. Partner closely with Finance and Sales Strategy / Operations to ensure forecasts are rigorous, risks and upside are understood, and the organization is focused on the activities and opportunities that will drive outcomes.
  • Define Ideal Customer Profile and Value Proposition: Shape and sharpen our ideal customer profiles, priority use cases, and value propositions across SMB and Franchise. Leverage insights, data and market intelligence to centralize and socialize the sales and growth narratives that resonate most with merchants and inform our broader B2B marketing, product and go-to-market strategy.
  • Drive Portfolio and Segment Strategy: Leverage insights across the team's pipeline and merchant portfolio to identify priority industries, franchise networks, growth opportunities and emerging trends. Translate those insights into clear segment strategies, scalable acquisition motions and commercial priorities across Australia and New Zealand.
  • Be the Voice of Afterpay: Represent the business to SMB and Franchise merchants as a thought leader in payments and Buy Now Pay Later, demonstrating Afterpay's value as a growth driver for small, growing and established businesses. Develop and grow Block's relationships with merchant partners, including senior leadership teams where appropriate.
  • Be the Voice of the Merchant: Represent market feedback and sentiment internally, advocating for merchants while balancing the needs and constraints of our business. Aggregate and deliver key insights across the organization in a structured, consistent and proactive manner to influence product, marketing, risk and commercial priorities.

You Have

  • An obsession with our products and a motivation fueled by feeling the impact of your work as more consumers build financial wellness with Afterpay.
  • 12+ years of experience in high-growth environments leading SMB Sales, Franchise Sales, BDR, Mid-Market Sales, or Account Management organizations, preferably in a fast-moving technology, payments, or financial services company, with experience operating across both high-volume sales motions and complex commercial relationships.
  • Excellent leadership skills with the ability to develop talent, motivate high-performing teams, and build strong cross-functional relationships, including a proven track record of coaching and managing frontline managers to results. You put your people in the best position to succeed, and your management style is tailored to each individual to maximize their performance and engagement at work.
  • Experience standing up, scaling, or transforming sales organizations - hiring, onboarding and developing talent across BDRs, AEs, and frontline managers, and designing the structures and operating rhythms required to support growth.
  • Demonstrated ability to build, operate, and continuously improve playbooks that scale across a large and growing team while preserving the judgment and flexibility required for sophisticated deals.
  • A demonstrated track record of leading teams that consistently drive revenue growth and exceed their revenue targets, including experience with sophisticated commercial negotiations and established clients.
  • Proven experience navigating and operating effectively within matrixed global organizations and aligning regional priorities with broader global strategies.
  • Experience working closely with Product and Marketing to drive conversion, including improving merchant acquisition, sign-up, activation and onboarding journeys, and translating merchant needs into product and go-to-market opportunities.
  • A high familiarity and comfort with how product development works, preferably in payments. You can hold your own with stakeholders across technical, marketing, product and commercial disciplines and have credibility with Product and Engineering partners.
  • Strong executive presence, with demonstrated ability to influence and earn trust with senior internal leaders and external decision makers, ask the right questions, and use sound business judgment, including with C-suite stakeholders at larger merchant and franchise partners.
  • An operational mindset as well as a strategic one - you can set a clear vision, implement robust processes, lead teams through complex relationships, and translate strategy into disciplined execution.
  • Comfort working with analytics and tools that support business performance measurement and management, particularly forecasting, funnel, pipeline, conversion, productivity and revenue metrics at scale.
  • Creative storytelling abilities, with the ability to seek out relevant, meaningful data and build compelling business cases and sales narratives that demonstrate Afterpay's value proposition.
  • A scrappy and humble mindset, where toggling between team lead and in-the-weeds work is business as usual. You're equally comfortable writing an annual plan as you are jumping into a pipeline review, supporting a complex negotiation, or unblocking a team member. You get the job done and inspire others to do so as well.

Application Guidelines

Candidates may submit up to 9 active applications within a 60-day period. Reapplications to the same role are accepted 90 days after a previous application has been reviewed.

Use of AI in Our Hiring Process

We may use automated AI tools to evaluate job applications for efficiency and consistency. These tools comply with local regulations, including bias audits, and we handle all personal data in accordance with state and local privacy laws. 

Contact us here with hiring practice or data usage questions.

Every benefit we offer is designed with one goal: empowering you to do the best work of your career while building the life you want. Remote work, medical insurance, flexible time off, retirement savings plans, and modern family planning are just some of our offering. Check out our other benefits at Block.

title: Product Specialist Manager, Square
locations: Bay Area, CA, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

About the Role

Square is looking for a Product Specialist Manager to lead a team of specialists focused on helping sellers understand, adopt, and get more value from Square's growing product ecosystem.

Our Product Specialists combine deep product expertise with strong customer and commercial skills. They partner closely with Account Executives and Account Managers on opportunities where specialized product knowledge can help address complex seller needs, accelerate adoption, and improve outcomes.

As a Product Specialist Manager, you'll lead and develop a team of specialists, deploy their expertise against our highest-priority seller and product opportunities, and help strengthen product knowledge across the broader sales organization. You'll also serve as an important connection between our frontline teams and Product—surfacing seller insights, identifying friction, and helping improve how we bring Square's products to market.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone equally comfortable coaching a team, engaging in complex seller opportunities, building deep product expertise, and partnering cross-functionally to improve seller outcomes.

What You'll Do

Lead a High-Performing Product Specialist Team

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Product Specialists supporting Account Executives, Account Managers, and their sellers.
  • Build deep product expertise alongside strong consultative and customer engagement skills.
  • Establish clear priorities and operating rhythms to ensure specialist resources are deployed against the highest-impact opportunities.
  • Foster a culture of ownership, customer focus, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Manage team performance, development, capacity, and engagement.

Support Strategic Seller Opportunities & Product Adoption

  • Partner with Account Executives and Account Managers on high-value and complex opportunities where specialized product expertise can improve seller outcomes.
  • Coach specialists through discovery, product positioning, solution design, objection handling, and complex product conversations.
  • Engage directly with sellers when additional product expertise or leadership can help advance an opportunity.
  • Help sellers understand how Square's products can address their business needs and unlock greater value from the Square ecosystem.
  • Support GTM and Product priorities by deploying specialist expertise toward strategic and underpenetrated products.

Scale Product Expertise Across Sales

  • Increase product knowledge and confidence across Account Executives, Account Managers, and other frontline teams.
  • Partner with Enablement, Product, and Marketing to develop product guidance, playbooks, messaging, training, and other resources.
  • Identify recurring knowledge gaps and seller objections and translate them into scalable enablement opportunities.
  • Develop repeatable approaches that allow frontline teams to independently navigate more product conversations over time.

Connect Seller Insights to Product & GTM

  • Serve as a strong feedback loop between sellers, frontline sales teams, and Product.
  • Surface recurring seller needs, product gaps, objections, and adoption barriers.
  • Partner across Product, Sales, Marketing, GTM Strategy & Operations, Data Science, and Enablement to improve product commercialization and seller experience.
  • Use seller, product, and performance insights to continuously improve how specialist resources are prioritized and deployed.

Success Metrics

  • Product adoption and attach rate
  • Seller opportunities supported and influenced
  • Conversion and outcomes of specialist-supported opportunities
  • Specialist engagement and utilization
  • Team performance and development
  • Increased product knowledge and self-sufficiency across frontline teams
  • Effectiveness of product enablement and specialist support
  • Quality and impact of seller insights surfaced to Product and GTM teams

What You'll Bring

  • 7+ years of experience in B2B sales, account management, product specialization, solution consulting, fintech, SaaS, payments, or another complex customer-facing environment, including experience leading and developing teams.
  • Experience supporting complex products or solutions that require consultative discovery and deep product expertise.
  • Strong people leadership skills with a track record of coaching and developing high-performing teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to partner effectively with Account Executives and Account Managers in a specialist, overlay, or consultative model.
  • Strong customer and commercial instincts with the ability to connect seller needs to product capabilities and business value.
  • Ability to translate complex product capabilities into clear, compelling customer conversations.
  • Experience partnering cross-functionally across Sales, Product, Marketing, Operations, and Enablement.
  • Strong communication and influencing skills with the ability to turn frontline insights into actionable recommendations.

Why This Role Matters

As Square's ecosystem grows, helping sellers understand and adopt the right combination of products becomes increasingly important.

Product Specialists bring the depth of expertise needed to help sellers navigate that ecosystem, support our frontline teams through complex opportunities, and ensure seller feedback informs how our products and go-to-market approach evolve.

As Product Specialist Manager, you'll lead the team responsible for bringing that expertise to our sellers and sales organization—helping improve seller outcomes, accelerate product adoption, and make Square's broader sales teams more effective.

title: Product Compliance Manager, Square
locations: Bay Area, CA, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
Block is one company built from many blocks, all united by the same purpose of economic empowerment. The blocks that form our foundational teams — People, Finance, Counsel, Hardware, Information Security, Platform Infrastructure Engineering, and more — provide support and guidance at the corporate level. They work across business groups and around the globe, spanning time zones and disciplines to develop inclusive People policies, forecast finances, give legal counsel, safeguard systems, nurture new initiatives, and more. Every challenge creates possibilities, and we need different perspectives to see them all. Bring yours to Block.

The Role

The Business Product Compliance and Partnerships team serves as strategic compliance advisors to Block's business teams, partnering with them to define product launch requirements, identify corresponding controls, and provide ongoing compliance support throughout the product lifecycle. We are seeking a Product Compliance Manager (PCM) to support Square's compliance program. Reporting to Block's Customer Product Compliance Lead, you will drive a strong compliance posture for Square's Core and Audiences product suites - including Square's commerce platform (F&B), workforce tools (Staff & Team Management), and customer engagement products (Loyalty, Gift Cards). The ideal candidate is a collaborative partner who works directly with Product, Engineering, Design, and Legal teams on a day-to-day basis.

You Will

  • Serve as the embedded compliance advisor for Square's Core and Audiences product teams, partnering with Product, Engineering, Design, and Counsel to provide proactive compliance guidance on new products, features, and market expansions
  • Lead product compliance reviews for new launches and feature changes, identifying requirements early in the development lifecycle and closing gaps in existing controls with clear remediation plans
  • Own and maintain the compliance risk and control inventory for your product areas, including ongoing risk assessments and control effectiveness evaluations
  • Drive key compliance program activities including issues management, testing and monitoring, policies and procedures development, and complaints management
  • Support regulatory examinations and audits by coordinating responses, gathering evidence, and managing remediation of findings
  • Monitor regulatory change across relevant domains and assess impact to your product portfolio
  • Translate legal and regulatory requirements into practical, well-documented compliance controls that balance risk mitigation with product usability
  • Develop and report on compliance metrics that provide meaningful visibility into the compliance health of your product areas

You Have

  • 8+ years in the compliance industry, with direct experience in payments, merchant acquiring, or commerce platform compliance
  • Strong regulatory knowledge, specifically in areas pertaining to AML/BSA, Payment Card and Network rules, Consumer Protection, Privacy, and electronic marketing and communication regulations
  • Experience as an embedded compliance partner to Product and Engineering teams - comfortable operating in agile environments and influencing product decisions without slowing velocity
  • Proven ability to translate legal and regulatory requirements into actionable controls, policies, and procedures
  • Experience with core compliance program activities: risk assessments, issues management, testing and monitoring, regulatory exam support, and regulatory change management
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills - able to articulate compliance requirements to technical and non-technical audiences, and document control requirements clearly
  • Ability to work in a matrixed environment, collaborating across Compliance, Legal, Product, Engineering, Design, Risk, and International teams
  • A metrics-driven approach — you use data to measure compliance program effectiveness and substantiate recommendations

locations: Bay Area, CA, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
Block builds simple, powerful tools that make progress towards an economy that’s truly open to all.

Each of our brands unlocks different aspects of the economy for more people. Square makes commerce and financial services accessible to sellers. Cash App is the easy way to spend, send, and store money. Afterpay is transforming the way customers manage their spending over time. TIDAL is a music platform that empowers artists to thrive as entrepreneurs. Bitkey is a simple self-custody wallet built for bitcoin. Proto is a suite of bitcoin mining products and services. Together, we’re helping build a financial system that is open to everyone. Join us.

The Role

The Privacy Engineering team was formed to build tools and provide guidance for engineering teams to collect, store, and analyze data responsibly. Security and privacy are closely linked, but where security focuses on the meta level of protecting data and assets as a whole, privacy zooms in to focus on the type of information collected, stored, and used, and how that information may violate expectations or breach trust. Privacy Engineering provides technology and abstraction layers to enable the employees at Block to do their job while being customer-centric and minimizing risks to  the individual.

Privacy Engineering aims to be a resource and enabler of responsible data use, not a gatekeeper. Our technological solutions are designed to make the most common data use cases easier for the employees at Block, but not to restrict or exclude uncommon data use cases that are responsible and compliant. We promote privacy enhancing technologies. Working with other teams within security, engineering, and legal, we set reasonable expectations for anyone looking to build systems or products at Block.

As a Software Engineer on the team at Block, you will build internal products and infrastructure to protect Block’s customers’ privacy and collaborate with many teams across Block, including product engineering teams, privacy counsel, and teams within security and platform engineering.  You will be fully remote and report to the Data Foundations Engineering Manager.

You Will:

  • Design and develop services or infrastructure that support data privacy initiatives and consumer’s privacy rights across Block’s engineering ecosystem
  • Help define the technological future of privacy at Block
  • Collaborate with other engineering teams incorporating privacy engineering products into their engineered solutions
  • Provide mentorship and reviews for engineering teams working with privacy technologies
  • Contribute to the monitoring and stability of our team’s existing engineering solutions

Qualifications

You Have:

  • Minimum of 5 years of software engineering experience
  • Experience writing quality scalable, robust and testable code
  • Interest in learning new technologies or languages
  • Experience cutting across services, infrastructure, or frameworks in novel ways to achieve security and privacy goals

Even Better:

  • Experience designing novel yet robust security or privacy architectures
  • Experience developing or maintaining services or processes to meet data governance needs
  • Experience designing novel ways to understand and surface data flow, access control, and risk
  • Experience explaining complex technical security or privacy concepts 

We use and teach:

  • Linux, Terraform, AWS, MySQL

title: Senior Manager, Business Development
locations: Bay Area, CA, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
Square is looking for a strategic, hands-on senior leader to lead our US Business Development Representative (BDR) organization. The BDR team is a critical growth engine for Square, responsible for creating high-quality pipeline, identifying new seller opportunities, and developing future sales talent across our go-to-market organization.

As Senior Manager, Business Development Representatives, you will lead the US BDR motion through BDR Managers and frontline teams responsible for outbound prospecting, lead qualification, pipeline generation, and seller engagement. You will own the operating rhythm, performance system, and pipeline generation strategy for the US market, partnering closely with Sales, Marketing, Revenue Operations, Enablement, Analytics, and Strategy to improve how Square identifies, engages, qualifies, and converts high-potential sellers.

You will be responsible for building a predictable, performance-driven BD motion that supports Square’s revenue goals while developing future sales talent. This role requires a leader who can set strategy, drive execution, inspect performance, coach managers, improve systems, and ensure the team consistently delivers high-quality pipeline that converts into meaningful revenue outcomes.

Success in this role will be measured by the team’s ability to consistently generate high-quality pipeline, improve conversion across the funnel, increase BDR-sourced revenue contribution, strengthen AE partnership, improve manager effectiveness, and develop BDR talent into future roles across Square Sales.

You will:

  • Lead the day-to-day execution and long-term improvement of Square’s US BDR motion, ensuring the team consistently delivers high-quality pipeline against sales goals.
  • Own the US BDR pipeline generation strategy, translating revenue goals, territory priorities, AE capacity, and market opportunities into clear outbound and self-sourcing plans.
  • Manage, coach, and develop BDR Managers and frontline contributors, helping them improve performance and prepare for future roles within Square Sales.
  • Build manager capability by coaching frontline leaders on performance management, inspection, difficult conversations, team motivation, rep development, and consistent execution.
  • Own execution against BD performance goals, including sourced opportunities, qualified meetings, conversion rates, pipeline value, AE acceptance, stage progression, and contribution to closed revenue.
  • Establish and manage a consistent operating cadence across the team, including forecasting, pipeline reviews, performance inspection, coaching rhythms, capacity planning, and monthly/quarterly planning.
  • Build scalable systems for hiring, onboarding, ramp, coaching, performance management, and career progression across the BDR organization.
  • Translate BD strategy into clear team priorities, expectations, and actions that drive consistent execution across managers, reps, markets, campaigns, and seller segments.
  • Execute outbound and self-sourcing strategies that help Square reach high-potential sellers across priority verticals, geographies, and segments.
  • Partner closely with Sales leadership to align BD execution with revenue targets, territory strategy, AE capacity, pipeline needs, and market opportunities.
  • Work cross-functionally with Marketing, Revenue Operations, Enablement, Analytics, Product Marketing, and Strategy to improve lead quality, messaging, routing, reporting, tooling, seller engagement, and funnel conversion.
  • Use data to identify performance trends across managers, reps, markets, campaigns, lead sources, and seller segments, then turn those insights into coaching, process improvements, and execution plans.
  • Establish a clear performance management framework that connects activity, meetings, qualified opportunities, pipeline value, AE acceptance, stage progression, and closed revenue contribution.
  • Improve team productivity through effective use of sales technology, automation, prospecting tools, funnel management practices, and coaching workflows.
  • Identify opportunities to use AI, automation, data enrichment, and sales engagement tools to improve account prioritization, prospecting quality, personalization, coaching, and rep productivity.
  • Pilot new outbound plays, cadences, messaging, tools, and workflows; measure results and scale what works across the US BDR organization.
  • Hire, onboard, and retain high-performing BDR talent while supporting clear career progression into Account Executive, Account Management, Sales Leadership, and other roles within Square Sales.
  • Build a culture of accountability, urgency, curiosity, inclusion, high standards, and continuous improvement.
  • Represent the BDR function in Sales leadership forums, providing frontline insights, performance trends, risks, recommendations, and executional feedback that improve Square’s sales development strategy.

You have

  • 8+ years of experience in sales, business development, sales development, or another revenue-focused role in a high-growth environment.
  • 4+ years of experience in Sales Development, Business Development, outbound sales, pipeline generation, or lead qualification.
  • 4+ years of people leadership experience, including experience managing managers, team leads, or large frontline sales/BDR teams.
  • Experience managing managers or leading multi-layered frontline revenue teams.
  • A track record of leading teams that consistently meet or exceed pipeline generation, opportunity creation, activity, or revenue contribution goals.
  • Strong fluency in sales development metrics, including activity, conversion, meeting quality, AE acceptance, pipeline value, stage progression, and closed revenue contribution.
  • Experience managing execution in a metrics-driven sales environment, including forecasting, pacing, KPI inspection, pipeline reviews, capacity planning, and performance coaching.
  • Strong ability to diagnose performance gaps across managers, reps, markets, campaigns, lead sources, territories, or seller segments and translate insights into clear action plans.
  • Experience coaching sales managers and/or frontline reps to improve productivity, quality, consistency, accountability, and career readiness.
  • Experience executing outbound prospecting, self-sourcing, lead qualification, or sales development motions.
  • Strong cross-functional partnership skills, especially with Sales, Marketing, Revenue Operations, Enablement, Analytics, Product Marketing, or Strategy.
  • Ability to communicate performance trends, priorities, risks, and recommendations clearly to senior sales leaders.
  • Strong organizational, communication, and leadership skills, with the ability to drive accountability across teams.
  • Comfort operating in a fast-paced environment where goals, priorities, tools, and processes continue to evolve.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in SaaS, financial services, payments, commerce, or another high-transaction-volume sales environment.
  • Experience managing managers or multi-layered sales development teams.
  • Experience using Salesforce, Outreach/Salesloft, Looker, Gong, or similar CRM, sales engagement, analytics, and coaching tools.
  • Experience using AI, automation, data enrichment, or sales engagement technology to improve prospecting, prioritization, personalization, coaching, or productivity.
  • Experience leading outbound motions across multiple seller segments, regions, verticals, or channels.
  • Experience partnering with Sales and Revenue Operations on capacity planning, territory coverage, lead routing, SLA design, and pipeline quality standards.
  • BA/BS Degree or equivalent.
