title: Staff Software Engineer, Financial Platform - Issuing
locations: Seattle, WA, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
It all started with an idea at Block in 2013. Initially built to take the pain out of peer-to-peer payments, Cash App has gone from a simple product with a single purpose to a dynamic ecosystem, developing unique financial products, including Afterpay/Clearpay, to provide a better way to send, spend, invest, borrow and save to our 50+ million monthly active customers. We want to redefine the world’s relationship with money to make it more relatable, instantly available, and universally accessible.

Today, Cash App has thousands of employees working globally across office and remote locations, with a culture geared toward innovation, collaboration and impact. We’ve been a distributed team since day one, and many of our roles can be done remotely from the countries where Cash App operates. No matter the location, we tailor our experience to ensure our employees are creative, productive, and happy.

The Role

At Block, we strive to build the best financial products in the world. The Financial Platform Issuing team owns the card issuing platform that serves every Block brand — powering Cash App Card, the fourth-largest debit card program in the US, alongside Square Card and the new card programs Block launches next.

We run the full lifecycle of a card: issuance, fulfillment, and activation; real-time transaction authorization and processing across card networks; digital wallet provisioning; 3-D Secure authentication; clearing and settlement; and disputes. When a customer taps their card at a register, our systems decide the outcome in milliseconds, around the clock, in partnership with card networks and bank partners.

As a Staff Software Engineer on the Issuing server engineering team, you will bring deep card-network expertise to some of the most complex technical work on our roadmap. You will work alongside technical leads and cross functional teams, going deep where our platform meets the networks: specifications, protocols, certification, mandates, conformance, and production behavior.

This is a hands-on role. You will build systems and tooling, debug at the message level, and turn your network expertise into durable capabilities that other engineers can use. You will also work directly with the networks themselves — not only understanding what they require, but knowing where and how to influence outcomes for Block.

You Will

  • Be a deep technical expert on global card networks, helping Issuing teams interpret network specifications, message flows, certification requirements, mandates, and production behavior — and working directly with the networks to influence requirements, resolve ambiguity, and secure outcomes that matter for Block.
  • Lead complex, ambiguous engineering problems at the network boundary that span multiple teams, systems, or domains.
  • Partner with technical leads, program DRIs, and senior stakeholders to shape solutions where card-network requirements intersect with Block's issuing platform.
  • Stay deeply hands-on: write production code, build certification and conformance tooling, analyze network messages, review designs and code, and debug issues down to the protocol and field level.
  • Drive network certification and mandatory release cycles end to end, and translate network requirements into clear, pragmatic engineering decisions.
  • Establish shared frameworks, standards, tooling, and practices that make network expertise durable and enable teams to operate independently.
  • Raise the technical capability of engineers around you through design guidance, code reviews, mentorship, documentation, and clear technical judgment.
  • Apply AI-powered tools throughout the engineering lifecycle to improve velocity and quality, and help establish effective patterns for broader team use.
  • Share operational ownership of critical financial systems through on-call, incident response, and continuous improvements to reliability and correctness.

You Have

  • Deep, current expertise with at least one major card network, ideally Visa, including direct connectivity, ISO 8583, authorization and clearing flows, stand-in processing, specifications, certification, and mandate cycles.
  • Personally built, certified, or operated a live direct network connection — not only integrated through a processor.
  • Experience working directly with card networks to land concrete outcomes, such as rulings, exceptions, extensions, configuration changes, defect fixes, or certification outcomes.
  • Strong hands-on software engineering experience building and operating highly reliable financial or payments systems at scale.
  • A track record of leading technically complex, ambiguous work across team boundaries and influencing technical direction beyond your immediate area of ownership.
  • Experience creating durable technical leverage — frameworks, standards, tooling, architecture, or practices that other engineers and teams adopt.
  • Broad understanding of the card lifecycle, with depth in areas such as issuance and fulfillment, provisioning and activation, authorization, ledgering, clearing and settlement, reconciliation, disputes, or fraud.
  • Working knowledge of Mastercard and American Express, alongside deep expertise in at least one major network.
  • Fluency with AI-assisted engineering workflows and sound judgment in evaluating and applying AI-generated output.
  • Willingness to participate in an on-call rotation for critical financial systems.

title: B2B Content Marketing Lead
locations: Bay Area, CA, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

The Role

Square is looking for a B2B Marketing Manager to help build our always-on content engine for our B2B audience.

Square is looking for a B2B Content Marketing Lead to help build our always-on content engine for our B2B audience. This is a senior individual contributor role where you'll take ownership of shaping and executing our B2B content strategy, working closely with teams across Square to bring those stories to life.

Sitting within the Integrated Marketing team, you'll develop content programs that strengthen Square's relevance across priority industries, verticals, and category conversations. This includes social-first content, thought leadership, customer storytelling, product narratives, partner moments, and industry content.

You'll identify opportunities to turn customer insights, business priorities, and industry trends into original content concepts, formats, and campaigns that resonate with our audiences.

We're looking for someone who can balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution, bringing ideas to life through strong storytelling, clear creative briefs, thoughtful production workflows, and effective use of AI tools.

You Will

  • Build and manage an always-on B2B content calendar across priority themes, verticals, campaigns, and moments.
  • Execute social-first content formats and original content franchises for co-marketing programs with sellers 
  • Create content programs that bring Square’s industry POV, customer stories, partner stories, product narratives, and market insights to life.
  • Identify opportunities to tell stronger stories across priority verticals, including restaurants, retail, services, and other key business categories.
  • Develop thought leadership content that helps Square participate in timely industry and business conversations.
  • Support customer storytelling and case study efforts by shaping strong story angles and adapting them into social-first formats.
  • Translate business priorities into clear content concepts, briefs, series, and distribution plans.
  • Use AI tools and workflows to support content development, including research, ideation, content mapping, repurposing, versioning, briefing, and production planning.
  • Build repeatable AI-assisted workflows that help the team move from insight to content more efficiently while maintaining accuracy, brand quality, and human judgment.
  • Manage content production workflows from concept through launch, including briefs, timelines, stakeholder inputs, approvals, and delivery.
  • Work with internal creative teams, external partners, freelancers, or agencies to produce high-quality content efficiently.
  • Track performance across content and social channels, and use insights to refine topics, formats, messaging, and distribution over time.

You Have

  • 6+ years of experience developing B2B content, social content, integrated campaigns, thought leadership, or content marketing programs.
  • A strong understanding of social-first content, especially for LinkedIn and other platforms where business audiences spend time.
  • Experience turning complex business topics into clear, compelling content for professional audiences.
  • Strong instincts for content formats, storytelling, hooks, pacing, and audience relevance.
  • Experience building or managing content calendars, campaigns, series, or always-on programming.
  • Experience using AI tools to improve content workflows, speed up content development, or scale content across formats and channels.
  • Strong judgment around where AI can add leverage and where human strategy, creativity, taste, and review are essential.
  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to move work from idea to brief to execution.
  • Experience working cross-functionally with marketing, creative, communications, sales, product, or external partners.
  • Good judgment around brand voice, accuracy, approvals, and business context.
  • Comfort balancing proactive content development with incoming business needs in a lean, fast-moving environment.

Nice to have

  • Experience in B2B technology, fintech, commerce, SaaS, restaurants, retail, services, or another business-focused category.
  • Experience developing executive thought leadership, industry POV content, category campaigns, or recurring content series.
  • Experience with customer storytelling, case studies, partner marketing, or sales-supporting content.
  • Familiarity with social analytics, content performance reporting, and optimization.
  • Experience producing short-form video, event content, interview-based content, or multi-format social campaigns.
  • Experience managing agencies, freelancers, creators, or production partners.
  • Experience building AI-assisted content systems, prompt libraries, research workflows, repurposing engines, or content operations processes.

title: Staff iOS Software Engineer, Product Platform
locations: Bay Area, CA, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
The team

Product Platform builds the foundations behind Cash App and Square. We own shared systems, abstractions, and tools that help product teams build high-quality iOS experiences with speed, consistency, and confidence, while shaping how AI-native development is adopted across our engineering organizations.

The role

As a Staff iOS Engineer on Product Platform, you will be a hands-on technical leader and a multiplier for iOS engineering.

You will identify important problems that do not yet have clear ownership, prove a direction through hands-on work, and create systems that other teams can adopt. You will influence iOS architecture, developer experience, performance, reliability, security, and product quality across multiple teams.

This is an individual contributor role with organization-level scope. Your goal is not to become a permanent bottleneck. You will create leverage through clear interfaces, strong documentation, sound technical decisions, and new technical leaders.

You will

Build and evolve the iOS platform

  • Own and evolve foundational iOS systems, such as application architecture, navigation, deep linking, dependency management, lifecycle management, and shared user interface foundations.
  • Design shared libraries, frameworks, and developer tools that product teams rely on.
  • Find and frame systemic iOS problems that do not yet have clear ownership.
  • Define technical strategy, architecture, standards, and measures of success across teams and applications.
  • Build prototypes, reference implementations, and critical paths that prove a direction before broader adoption.
  • Lead multi-quarter migrations and foundational initiatives from proposal through adoption.
  • Establish durable practices for testing, observability, performance, release safety, security, and maintainability.
  • Improve developer and AI ergonomics so both engineers and coding agents can work effectively with the platform.
  • Contribute platform technology to open source when it creates value for the broader engineering community.

Lead as an AI-fluent engineer

  • Integrate AI-assisted development tools into daily workflows to drive leverage across product and platform engineering.
  • Evaluate emerging tools and practices, building durable, AI-powered platform capabilities where they add clear value.
  • Verify AI-assisted outputs and ensure high standards for software quality, security, and reliability.

Drive organizational impact

  • Operate beyond your immediate team to identify and address cross-cutting technical problems.
  • Lead architecture and design reviews across team boundaries.
  • Surface systemic risks before they become customer, seller, or engineering problems.
  • Develop senior engineers and create ownership models that distribute expertise.
  • Help set technical standards that improve the quality and velocity of iOS development over time.

Collaborate broadly

  • Partner with engineers, product managers, designers, and engineering leaders to align platform investments with product needs.
  • Work with Android, web, and backend engineers to improve shared product foundations and cross-platform experiences.
  • Represent iOS platform needs in cross-team and company-wide technical discussions.
  • Communicate complex technical decisions clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences.

Qualifications

You have:

  • 12+ years of professional software engineering experience.
  • 8+ years in roles where mobile engineering was a primary responsibility, including 4+ years building native iOS products.
  • Deep expertise across modern and legacy iOS frameworks, Swift, and Objective-C.
  • Experience creating foundational systems, shared frameworks, or developer tooling used across multiple teams.
  • A record of leading strategic, multi-quarter initiatives with broad adoption and durable impact.
  • Experience connecting platform strategy to customer-facing and multi-tenant SaaS products that support business operations.
  • Strong systems thinking, technical communication, mentoring, and organizational influence.
  • A platform builder's mindset. You treat engineers as customers and measure success through adoption and product outcomes.

Ideally, you also have:

  • Experience with large, modular iOS applications maintained by many teams.
  • Experience with build systems, continuous integration and delivery, testing infrastructure, observability, or mobile performance.
  • Experience supporting customer-facing or seller-facing products in financial services, commerce, or another high-trust environment.
  • Experience with experimentation infrastructure, feature flags, or large-scale product delivery.
  • Experience creating developer platforms that support both human engineers and AI coding agents.
  • A record of identifying and leading work that was not already on a team's roadmap.

Technologies we use and teach

  • Swift, Objective-C, SwiftUI, and UIKit
  • Swift Concurrency and Combine
  • Xcode and Instruments
  • Bazel and other build and dependency-management systems
  • Protocol Buffers and shared client-server interfaces
  • Unit, snapshot, integration, and user interface testing
  • Performance, observability, and release-safety tooling
  • AI-assisted development tools

What makes this role distinctive

  • Foundational scope: Your work improves the systems that iOS product teams build on.
  • Hands-on leadership: You will prove technical direction through implementation, not strategy alone.
  • Broad influence: You will shape how teams across Cash App and Square build and maintain iOS software.
  • AI-native development: You will help define how AI changes mobile engineering practices and platform design.
  • Durable leverage: Success means creating systems, standards, and technical leaders that continue producing value without depending on you.

descriptionHtml:
It all started with an idea at Block in 2013. Initially built to take the pain out of peer-to-peer payments, Cash App has gone from a simple product with a single purpose to a dynamic ecosystem, developing unique financial products, including Afterpay/Clearpay, to provide a better way to send, spend, invest, borrow and save to our 50+ million monthly active customers. We want to redefine the world’s relationship with money to make it more relatable, instantly available, and universally accessible.

Today, Cash App has thousands of employees working globally across office and remote locations, with a culture geared toward innovation, collaboration and impact. We’ve been a distributed team since day one, and many of our roles can be done remotely from the countries where Cash App operates. No matter the location, we tailor our experience to ensure our employees are creative, productive, and happy.

The Role

The North American Enterprise team drives growth across our commerce and payments portfolio, including Afterpay and Cash App Pay. We partner with leading global brands to help them reach the next generation of consumers, create more flexible commerce experiences, and deliver measurable business results.
We are looking for an experienced enterprise seller to build and expand Block’s relationships with some of the world’s largest brands. You will identify new revenue opportunities, develop relationships with senior executives, and lead complex, often first-of-their-kind partnerships from initial strategy through negotiation, launch, and growth.

This role sits at the intersection of commerce, payments, technology, and consumer behavior. You will work closely with decision-makers across payments, marketing, digital commerce, finance, and technology while bringing together internal partners across Product, Engineering, Finance, Legal, Risk, Marketing, and Operations.
You will thrive in this role if you combine strong commercial instincts with strategic thinking, disciplined execution, and the ability to navigate ambiguity. Success requires persistence through long, multifaceted sales cycles, sound judgment, and the ability to create alignment across complex organizations.

You Will

  • Own the full enterprise sales cycle, from account strategy and opportunity creation through negotiation, contracting, launch, and expansion.
  • Build trusted relationships with senior executives at leading global brands and position Block as a strategic partner in commerce and payments.
  • Develop compelling, insight-led sales narratives that connect Cash App and Afterpay’s capabilities to each prospective partner’s priorities, customers, and growth strategy.
  • Lead complex and often first-of-their-kind deals using clear milestones, success measures, stakeholder alignment, and disciplined deal management.
  • Create thoughtful commercial strategies and negotiate pragmatic, mutually beneficial agreements informed by data, financial analysis, and business principles.
  • Coordinate cross-functional deal teams across Product, Engineering, Marketing, Finance, Legal, Risk, and Operations.
  • Translate merchant needs and market insights into actionable feedback that helps shape Block’s product and go-to-market strategy.
  • Build Block’s enterprise network by developing relationships across target accounts and representing Cash App and Afterpay at industry events and executive forums.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of the payments and commerce landscape, including emerging technologies, consumer trends, and competitive dynamics.
  • Consistently deliver against ambitious revenue goals while building a durable pipeline of strategic opportunities.

You Have

  • 8+ years of experience in enterprise sales, business development, partnerships, go-to-market strategy, or a related commercial role, ideally within technology, payments, financial services, or another high-growth environment.
  • Experience owning enterprise opportunities from initial prospecting and account planning through negotiation, contracting, launch, and expansion.
  • A demonstrated record of meeting or exceeding individual revenue or sales targets.
  • Experience closing enterprise agreements with extended sales cycles, multiple decision-makers, and cross-functional dependencies.
  • Experience developing account strategies and creating new revenue opportunities within large or global organizations.
  • Experience presenting commercial recommendations, proposals, and business cases to senior executives, including C-suite decision-makers.
  • Experience negotiating pricing, financial terms, commercial contracts, or other complex deal structures in partnership with Finance and Legal teams.
  • Experience using customer, market, revenue, and financial data to develop business cases and inform deal strategy.
  • Experience partnering with Product and Engineering teams during technical discovery, solution development, product scoping, or integration planning.
  • Experience coordinating cross-functional teams across functions such as Product, Engineering, Finance, Legal, Risk, Marketing, and Operations.
  • Experience managing sales forecasts, pipeline activity, and deal progress against defined milestones and performance targets.
  • Experience translating technical and commercial concepts for both technical and nontechnical audiences.
  • Familiarity with payments, financial technology, digital commerce, or consumer technology.
  • Willingness to travel as needed.

descriptionHtml:
It all started with an idea at Block in 2013. Initially built to take the pain out of peer-to-peer payments, Cash App has gone from a simple product with a single purpose to a dynamic ecosystem, developing unique financial products, including Afterpay/Clearpay, to provide a better way to send, spend, invest, borrow and save to our 50+ million monthly active customers. We want to redefine the world’s relationship with money to make it more relatable, instantly available, and universally accessible.

Today, Cash App has thousands of employees working globally across office and remote locations, with a culture geared toward innovation, collaboration and impact. We’ve been a distributed team since day one, and many of our roles can be done remotely from the countries where Cash App operates. No matter the location, we tailor our experience to ensure our employees are creative, productive, and happy.

The Role 

The North American Mid-Market Sales team at Cash App and Afterpay is responsible for driving revenue across our commerce payments products, giving merchant partners access to one of the largest and most engaged networks of next-generation consumers. We partner with high-growth and established brands across retail, fashion, beauty, travel, QSR, home, health and wellness, ticketing, and other commerce categories to help them acquire customers, increase conversion, and grow profitably.

We are looking for an experienced Mid-Market Account Executive to build and expand relationships with high-potential merchants across North America. You will own a portfolio of prospective merchants, create new pipeline, lead a consultative sales process, and close new business across Cash App Pay and Afterpay.

You will work with founders, executives, and leaders across commerce, marketing, payments, finance, and technology. Internally, you will coordinate partners across Product, Engineering, Marketing, Finance, Legal, Risk, Sales Strategy, and Operations.

In this role, you will independently own complex sales workstreams, make informed tradeoffs, and influence deal strategy and execution within your area of responsibility. Success requires balancing high-touch relationship development with a structured and repeatable sales process.

You will:

  • Own a portfolio of mid-market opportunities from initial prospecting and qualification through discovery, negotiation, contracting, launch, and handoff.
  • Develop account plans that identify merchant priorities, key decision-makers, potential blockers, and revenue opportunities.
  • Build pipeline through outbound outreach, market research, internal lead assignments, vertical insights, events, referrals, and partner introductions.
  • Qualify and prioritize opportunities based on merchant fit, revenue potential, product alignment, implementation requirements, and likelihood to close.
  • Lead discovery with business and technical stakeholders to understand merchant priorities, customer needs, payment flows, and implementation requirements.
  • Build merchant-specific business cases and sales narratives that connect Cash App Pay and Afterpay’s capabilities to customer acquisition, conversion, and growth goals.
  • Develop commercial proposals and negotiate pricing, financial terms, contracts, procurement requirements, and implementation dependencies.
  • Coordinate deal teams across Product, Engineering, Marketing, Finance, Legal, Risk, Sales Strategy, and Operations.
  • Manage deal progress using defined milestones, next steps, stakeholder ownership, and internal approval requirements.
  • Maintain accurate opportunity data, pipeline reporting, and sales forecasts in Salesforce and related systems.
  • Bring merchant feedback, competitive intelligence, and market insights back to Product and go-to-market teams.
  • Contribute to sales processes, enablement materials, and operating rhythms that improve pipeline quality, deal velocity, forecast accuracy, and win rates.
  • Deliver against individual revenue and sales targets.
  • Represent Cash App and Afterpay in merchant meetings, industry events, and networking forums.

You have:

  • 5+ years of experience in full-cycle B2B sales, business development, partnerships, or a related go-to-market role, preferably in commerce, payments, fintech, SaaS, retail technology, or another fast-moving technology environment.
  • A demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding quota and closing mid-market or complex commercial deals.
  • Strong prospecting and pipeline-generation skills, including comfort building new business through outbound outreach, market research, partner referrals, events, and executive networking.
  • Executive presence with the ability to earn trust, ask strong questions, influence senior stakeholders, and tailor communication to founders, functional leaders, and cross-functional buying committees.
  • Strong commercial judgment and negotiation skills, including comfort working through pricing, legal terms, procurement, implementation dependencies, and internal approval processes.
  • Comfort using data to build a business case, prioritize opportunities, inspect pipeline quality, and communicate tradeoffs.
  • Product curiosity and technical fluency, especially around payments, commerce, customer acquisition, marketing, and merchant growth.
  • A self-starter mentality and comfort operating through ambiguity, frequent change, and evolving priorities while still delivering results.
  • Excellent cross-functional collaboration skills and the ability to lead workstreams without formal authority.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to build concise, compelling narratives for internal and external audiences.
  • A continuous-improvement mindset and willingness to help build better team processes, enablement materials, and operating rhythms.
  • A willingness to travel for merchant meetings, industry events, and internal team moments.

title: Senior Analytics Engineer, AI & DX Analytics
locations: Bay Area, CA, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
Block builds simple, powerful tools that make progress towards an economy that’s truly open to all.

Each of our brands unlocks different aspects of the economy for more people. Square makes commerce and financial services accessible to sellers. Cash App is the easy way to spend, send, and store money. Afterpay is transforming the way customers manage their spending over time. TIDAL is a music platform that empowers artists to thrive as entrepreneurs. Bitkey is a simple self-custody wallet built for bitcoin. Proto is a suite of bitcoin mining products and services. Together, we’re helping build a financial system that is open to everyone. Join us.

The Role

The AI & DX (Developer Experience) Analytics team exists to measure and improve Block's developer experience and investment in AI. We turn raw engineering signals (agent session data, pull request and CI activity, and AI spend) into reporting and analysis that shape leadership's AI investment decisions, and drive improvement in AI ROI and developer experience. Your work will be the trusted source of truth that engineers and executives use to decide where AI investment is working and where to redirect it.

We're hiring a Senior Analytics Engineer to own parts of that pipeline end to end. This is a broad, high-visibility role with a lot of white space: you will instrument new telemetry at the source and build production pipelines that turn it into governed data, then turn that governed data into executive-facing reporting and the analysis that surfaces concrete opportunities to improve AI ROI and developer experience. You'll also help pioneer one of the most consequential open problems in the industry right now: measuring the productivity impact of an increasingly AI- and agent-augmented engineering workforce, where there is no textbook answer and real room to set the standard. You'll define new metrics and craft the visual narrative — the charts, dashboards, and presentation materials — that make them land with an executive audience. AI-first workflows are central to how this team operates and critical to succeeding in this role: using AI coding agents is a default part of how you build and maintain pipelines and dashboards. You'll excel in this role if you're as comfortable defining and visualizing a brand new executive-facing metric from a messy signal as you are debugging why a pipeline silently stalled overnight.

You Will

Instrumentation & Telemetry:

  • Instrument and extend the raw telemetry captured about AI usage, code changes, CI/CD activity, and spend — building new data capture, not only transforming what already exists. This is core to the role, as evolving AI tools and increased AI adoption constantly creates new signals that need to be captured.
  • Partner with data engineers on production ETL pipelines that land that telemetry into governed tables, with the freshness monitoring, backfills, and alerting that keep it trustworthy, rather than a one-off script.
  • Define new metrics out of ambiguous or evolving signals, and earn stakeholder trust in a new number by validating and reconciling it until it holds up.

Dashboards & analysis:

  • Build and ship the executive-facing dashboards and visualizations that turn governed metrics into decision-ready reporting — with the polish and precision a room of executives will scrutinize.
  • Run the analysis that a new chart or metric needs and anticipate questions that an executive audience will ask, then bring senior stakeholders a recommendation, not just a number, and defend the methodology behind both.
  • Translate complex, technical findings into a clear narrative: the headline chart and the one sentence that makes an executive act on it.

Across both:

  • Use AI coding agents as a default part of how you write, test, and maintain data pipelines, dashboards, and analyses.
  • Partner across data engineering, applied AI, and data science teams to keep telemetry connected end to end — the raw signal you capture directly feeds the session classifiers, not just the dashboards you build.
  • Turn what the data shows into action: flag where AI spend isn't paying off or where developer friction is most costly, and push the tooling, process, or investment changes that address it.
  • Push the industry-frontier work of quantifying AI and agent productivity impact — there's no established playbook, and this team sets one.

Qualifications

You are: 

  • Self-sufficient across the full analytics loop: instrumentation, pipeline building, metric definition, and dashboards — not someone who hands off past the query.
  • At home in messy, evolving telemetry, with the judgment to know when a new number is right and when it needs a second look before an executive sees it.
  • A strong product thinker: you get at what a stakeholder actually needs from a metric or chart, not just what they asked for.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity on a genuinely unsolved problem — measuring AI/agent productivity impact — and motivated to go set the standard rather than wait for one.
  • An exceptional communicator, able to defend a metric's methodology and a chart's framing directly to senior stakeholders.
  • Thoughtful about using AI coding agents in your own craft: fast to build with them, and rigorous about evaluating what they produce rather than taking it on faith.

You have:

  • 8+ years in analytics engineering, data engineering, or business intelligence, owning production data pipelines and insights end to end.
  • Strong SQL and Python, with hands-on experience building and operating data pipelines against a cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake.
  • Experience partnering with engineering teams to instrument new event or telemetry data, not only transforming what's already captured.
  • Experience building dashboards or internal tools that non-technical stakeholders rely on to make decisions.
  • Comfort with git, CI/CD systems, and debugging production pipeline failures such as retries and backfills.

Even better:

  • Experience with a metrics-governance or semantic-layer system, such as a metrics store, dbt semantic layer, or LookML.

Technologies we use and teach:

  • SQL (Snowflake), Python, TypeScript and React, Git, CI/CD pipelines, a governed metrics store, AI coding agents, and LLM-based classification tooling.

title: Head of Sales Development, North America & UK - Cash App & Afterpay
locations: Bay Area, CA, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
Job Description

The Sales Development team at Cash App is responsible for creating and qualifying the demand that drives revenue to our core consumer payments businesses, Afterpay and Cash App Pay, giving our Merchant partners access to the largest and most engaged network of next generation consumers. Sales Development is where many of our best-fit merchants first hear from us, and where we create the pipeline our sales organization converts.

We are looking for an experienced, operationally rigorous, and highly collaborative Head of Sales Development to unify and grow this program in North America & the United Kingdom. This is a newly created role, and the first time we will have led this function across markets. We have real capability in place today, with teams across the US and the UK, generating pipeline our sales organization converts, supported by playbooks and processes that work in their markets. The opportunity in front of us is to bring these teams together into a single global function and scale what is already working: shared standards where they help, one consistent view of performance, and the compounding advantage of teams learning from each other rather than solving the same problems separately. Our core motion today is SMB and there is significant opportunity to extend our more nascent upmarket motions into full-fledged parts of the program.

A successful candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, brings a well-formed point of view on how a modern sales development function should be structured and scaled, and pairs that with the judgment to understand an existing motion deeply before evolving it. You are fluent in the measures that genuinely predict pipeline your sales teams convert rather than the activity metrics that are easiest to report, and you are comfortable building the reporting and inspection rigor that a global function requires. This role requires an effective influencer who can operate across a distributed and matrixed organization and earn the trust of leaders in other teams who do not report to you.

Beyond ultimately being responsible for top-of-funnel performance globally, you will be responsible for building and supporting a strong culture of performance and development. You excel at developing others and leading with empathy but without ego.

The ideal candidate has demonstrated excellence in building repeatable pipeline generation motions at scale, leading high performing teams across multiple markets, and a dedication to continuous improvement.

You will:

  • Lead the NA & UK Sales Development Team: Lead our Sales Development teams across North America and the UK, both directly and through front-line managers. Understand what each region does well and why, then bring the function together around shared standards, a common view of performance, and a consistent bar for quality. Hold the team accountable to delivering on OKRs and contributing to revenue targets, in concert with the broader Sales & Account Management function at Cash App and Afterpay.
  • Own Top-of-Funnel Performance: Carry accountability for pipeline generation across every region, including targeting strategy, channel mix, and conversion through to opportunities the sales organization accepts and closes. Build the reporting and inspection layer that makes performance legible everywhere we operate.
  • Shape How the Motion Evolves: Develop and pressure-test a point of view on how Sales Development should be structured for Cash App and Afterpay as we scale, including how inbound and outbound work is organized and where the function's edges sit relative to sales and marketing. Extend the motion further upmarket, defining what needs to change in research, messaging, and coverage as merchant complexity grows.
  • Develop Meaningful Cross-Functional Partnerships: Work closely with cross-functional teams to better support your team in generating pipeline, including B2B Marketing, Sales, Risk, Compliance, Product, Sales Strategy & Operations, Finance and more. Partner especially closely with B2B Marketing and regional sales leaders on lead flow, routing, qualification standards, and handoffs, bringing rigor and shared definitions to the seams between functions.
  • Build a High-Performance Talent Engine: Stay close to rep development and performance while building managers who are exceptional coaches and talent developers. Set a consistent standard for coaching, accountability, and career development, creating a system that develops top performers and prepares them for quota-carrying roles.
  • Define how technology enables a modern Sales Development organization: Use AI, automation, and data to improve targeting, prioritization, research, personalization, and rep productivity while reducing low-value manual work. We are an AI-forward company and we expect real leverage here.

locations: Bay Area, CA, United States of America
descriptionHtml:

Every challenge creates possibilities, and we need different perspectives to see them all. Bring yours to Block.

The Role

Block is seeking a Senior Manager, IT Internal Audit to help develop and execute our Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) program and to shape how Internal Audit approaches Artificial Intelligence (AI). Partnering with the Internal Audit SOX Lead, other Internal Audit Managers, and process owners, you will own IT audit projects and portions of the SOX program while helping the team build a formal methodology for auditing AI systems and applying AI to make the audit process more effective. You are a subject matter expert in IT SOX compliance, controls design, risk assessment, IT General Controls (ITGCs) and Automated Controls (ITACs), process flow mapping, controls testing, and the evaluation of deficiencies and remediation plans. Additionally, you also have strong project management skills, superior analytical ability, and the business acumen to interact credibly at all levels, including senior members of Accounting, Finance, and Engineering, ideally within a fintech or financial services environment.

You Will

  • Take ownership of assigned audit projects within the Technology Internal Audit team, developing and tracking timelines, partnering with internal and external resources, and reporting on conclusions and observations.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert in SOX technology compliance across multiple systems, environments, and business units.
  • Drive delivery of the internal audit plan in accordance with established methodology and agreed quality standards, while meeting or exceeding key performance indicators.
  • Build strong relationships with internal and external partners (process owners, co-sourcing partners, and external auditors) and proactively anticipate their needs.
  • Help drive consistency, efficiency, and quality excellence across our SOX program, including managing special audit projects on an ad-hoc basis.
  • Partner with the SOX Audit Lead and Business Process Audit Managers to help build a formal methodology for auditing AI systems.
  • Identify areas of the audit process that can benefit from AI, and deliver AI-enabled solutions and efficiencies while maintaining audit quality, independence, and reliability of results.

You Have

  • 8+ years of experience managing and testing SOX controls at a well-disciplined organization with a focus on systems across cloud, SaaS/PaaS, or on-premises environments, including reliance on SOC 1 / SOC 2 reports.
  • A BA/BS in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • Advanced understanding of internal or external SOX/audit methodologies and risk management within a complex technology, financial services, or regulated business.
  • Experience auditing and/or using Large Language Models (LLMs) and other AI systems and tools, including building or contributing to an AI audit or AI governance framework.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, including the ability to summarize complex issues succinctly for a wide range of internal and external executive audiences.
  • Strong project management, cross-functional collaboration, problem-solving, and analytical skills, with the ability to make sound business decisions on complex technology problems.
  • A proactive leadership style with a strong drive for results and unquestionable integrity and discretion in a fast-paced, evolving risk environment.

title: Senior Security Engineer, Detection & Response
locations: Bay Area, CA, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
Block is one company built from many blocks, all united by the same purpose of economic empowerment. The blocks that form our foundational teams — People, Finance, Counsel, Hardware, Information Security, Platform Infrastructure Engineering, and more — provide support and guidance at the corporate level. Every challenge creates possibilities, and we need different perspectives to see them all. Bring yours to Block.

The Role

Block’s Detection and Response Team (DART) investigates and responds to threats across our products and systems. Within DART, the Computer Security Incident Response Team (CSIRT) leads complex investigations and coordinates the response to security incidents across the company. You’ll establish what happened, determine the scope and impact, guide containment and recovery, and keep responders and stakeholders aligned.

You’ll be a trusted resource for your peers, contributing technical judgment and direction to complex investigations and helping the team make sound decisions. You’ll partner closely with engineers, other security teams, Legal, Privacy, and business leaders. Between incidents, you’ll innovate by building the tools, workflows, and procedures that make our response stronger.

You Will

  • Command complex, high-impact security incidents from initial assessment through containment, recovery, and closure.
  • Investigate threats across endpoint, identity, cloud, SaaS, network, and application systems and drive containment and remediation with system owners, weighing urgency, evidence preservation, and business impact.
  • Reconstruct timelines, preserve evidence, and determine the scope and impact of incidents.
  • Coordinate containment and remediation with system owners while balancing urgency and business impact.
  • Keep incident priorities, decisions, owners, and handoffs clear across teams and time zones.
  • Lead post-incident reviews and drive findings, uncertainty, and response decisions to technical teams and business partners.
  • Write code, queries, and automation that accelerate evidence collection, analysis, and response. Partner with triage, detection, threat intelligence, and infrastructure teams to address missing telemetry, improve detections, and remove recurring manual work.
  • Mentor responders and participate in the incident response on-call rotation.

You Have

  • 6+ years of hands-on incident response and digital forensics experience. 
  • Experience commanding major security incidents involving multiple teams and competing priorities.
  • Strong knowledge of attacker behavior and depth in several areas of identity, endpoint, cloud, network, or application security.
  • Strong SQL/database understanding and log-analysis skills, and practical programming or scripting ability, such as Python. You can analyze large, messy datasets and build reliable tools that improve investigations and response, both with and without AI.
  • An established AI-assisted workflow and actively develop AI-based systems and processes that improve incident coordination and case management.
  • Clear communication and sound judgment when working with technical teams, executives, and sensitive information.
  • An engineering mindset and a track record of turning incident response lessons into lasting improvements.
  • A need to build: developing systems and workflows that improve incident response and connect with our broader investigation, automation, and case management capabilities.

title: Software Engineer, Payment Interfaces
locations: Bay Area, CA, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

The Role

Payment Interfaces builds and operates the APIs and services that power payment experiences across Block, including Square, Cash App, and Afterpay. Our systems process payment traffic worldwide, helping sellers accept payments and customers move money reliably and securely.

You’ll design, build, and scale customer-facing payment APIs and the critical systems behind them. You’ll bring experience in payments, lead complex projects from design through production, and help shape the team’s technical direction. You’ll learn the specifics of Block’s products and payment processing on the job.

This is a hands-on engineering role with ongoing operational responsibility. Alongside building new capabilities, you’ll maintain high-volume production systems, participate in on-call and incident response, and make improvements that prevent recurring problems. You’ll use AI throughout your work while remaining accountable for the correctness, security, and reliability of what you ship.

You Will

  • Design, build, maintain, and scale customer-facing payment APIs with clear contracts, predictable behavior, and compatibility that developers can rely on.
  • Lead complex projects end to end: clarify requirements, evaluate trade-offs, plan incremental delivery, and own testing, rollout, and ongoing maintenance.
  • Operate critical payment systems serving worldwide traffic. Participate in the team’s on-call rotation, investigate incidents, and follow through on fixes that improve reliability.
  • Improve performance, observability, fault tolerance, and security. Use automation to reduce repetitive operational work and make systems safer to change.
  • Work with product and engineering partners across Block to turn payment requirements into reusable capabilities.
  • Use AI-assisted tools for design, implementation, testing, and debugging. Critically evaluate their output and help teammates adopt approaches that improve quality and delivery.
  • Shape technical decisions within the team and develop others through design reviews, code reviews, documentation, and mentoring

You Have

  • Experience building, maintaining, and scaling customer-facing financial or payment APIs, together with a strong understanding of payments. This is a requirement for the role.
  • Experience designing and operating high-volume, highly available distributed systems where correctness, security, and reliability matter.
  • An understanding of payment API concerns such as idempotency, retries, asynchronous processing, backward compatibility, and handling partial failures without compromising financial correctness.
  • A record of leading complex engineering projects from unclear requirements through production, making technical trade-offs, and coordinating work with partner teams.
  • Experience diagnosing production issues and improving systems through monitoring, incident response, and preventive engineering.
  • Fluency with AI-assisted engineering tools and the judgment to validate generated code, protect sensitive data, and recognize when deeper investigation is needed.
  • Clear written communication and experience helping other engineers develop their technical skills.
  • A minimum of 8 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 6 years and a Master’s degree; or a PhD with 3 years experience; or equivalent experience

Technologies We Use and Teach

  • Kotlin
  • Go
  • TypeScript
  • AWS
  • Kafka

Square is building a best-in-class, high-impact field sales organization, and we are looking for an exceptional Territory Account Executive — someone who consistently exceeds expectations, takes full ownership of their territory, and brings Square’s mission of economic empowerment directly to the businesses that need it most.

You will spend most of your week out in the market — meeting businesses, conducting live demos, and closing deals with confidence. The pace is fast, the expectations are high, and your ability to operate strategically and decisively will determine your success.

You will serve as Square’s presence and competitive advantage in one of our highest-opportunity markets — responsible for building pipeline from the ground up, elevating Square’s visibility in your community, establishing high-value partnerships, and helping local businesses grow through our ecosystem of industry-leading software and hardware.

If you are motivated by impactful work, driven to outperform, and eager to join a high-performance team with high standards, this role is built for you.

You will:

Lead your market with disciplined, in-person execution

  • Spend ~80% of your week in the field — walking your territory, engaging local businesses, and driving 50–60 targeted business visits each week.
  • Run a full-cycle, self-sourced sales motion: generate leads, identify needs, deliver compelling demos, and close deals across Square’s full product suite.

Establish yourself as the go-to Square expert in your city

  • Build strong, trust-based relationships with local sellers by being present, reliable, and value-driven.
  • Partner cross-functionally to ensure a seamless onboarding experience and fast time-to-value for new sellers.
  • Implement a disciplined referral strategy to turn every new customer into future opportunities.

Build a high-velocity pipeline from the ground up

  • Develop a repeatable top-of-funnel engine through door-to-door outreach, community engagement, events, networking, and targeted partnerships.
  • Work with channel partners to generate a consistent, high-quality referral stream that grows over time.

Master your verticals and sell with precision

  • Build deep expertise in key verticals — including restaurants, retail, and services — to diagnose challenges and position the right Square solutions.
  • Sell consultatively and competitively, staying proactive and strategic throughout the sales cycle.

Achieve exceptional results in a high-accountability environment

  • Maintain strong operational rigor in Salesforce: track activity, manage pipeline, and forecast accurately.
  • Measure performance frequently and improve continuously.
  • Consistently exceed quota within a culture where high standards are the norm.

You have:

  • 3+ years of sales experience in a full cycle closing role with field sales experience
  • Experience exceeding sales targets, selling a diverse ecosystem of products, and closing complex deals
  • Ability to drive deals independently in a fast-paced, dynamic environment 
  • Business development experience (e.g. hunting and cold calling)
  • Since this is a field position, you must have reliable transportation and live in the market you are serving
  • A collaborative and team player mentality
  • Prior Salesforce experience or equivalent
  • Even better:
    • 2+ years of payment processing OR related technology (i.e. payroll, loyalty, time management)
    • 1+ years of relevant audience experience (experience working in/selling to restaurants, retailers or services based businesses)

title: Security Engineer, Business Continuity & Risk
locations: Bay Area, CA, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
Block is one company built from many blocks, all united by the same purpose of economic empowerment. The blocks that form our foundational teams — People, Finance, Counsel, Hardware, Information Security, Platform Infrastructure Engineering, and more — provide support and guidance at the corporate level. They work across business groups and around the globe, spanning time zones and disciplines to develop inclusive People policies, forecast finances, give legal counsel, safeguard systems, nurture new initiatives, and more. Every challenge creates possibilities, and we need different perspectives to see them all. Bring yours to Block.

The Role

Square Financial Services, Inc. (SFS) is Block’s bank. We opened in March 2021 and provide lending and FDIC-insured deposit products to individuals and small businesses on a nationwide basis.

SFS Risk Management is scaling vendor security, third party risk, and business continuity through innovation. Our Risk team designs and promotes the frameworks, standards, and oversight that elevates security considerations among our vendors,  simplifies our regulatory obligations, and ensures resilience in our business operations. The team also operates the agent-first platforms that turn those frameworks into running systems.

Most of governance is a data problem. The risk, control, and asset information needed to answer "are we secure and compliant?" is dispersed across dozens of systems: Security Engineers treat that as an engineering problem. You'll build the data pipelines, integrations, and agentic AI workflows that turn manual governance processes into products that run continuously, produce measurable results, and hold up to audit end to end.

You Will

  • Own and operationalize a SFS third-party risk management and business continuity program program.
  • Define the technical approach for ambiguous, cross-team problem spaces. This is an early-stage program, and you will frame problems as often as you solve them.
  • Build and operate the pipelines and integrations that aggregate, normalize, and join risk, control, and asset signals from systems of record across Block and SFS, including source control, the service registry, identity, ticketing, and data platforms.
  • Translate standards and compliance requirements into policy-as-code: enforceable, testable rules that run continuously. For example, "every production service has an accountable owner" becomes a versioned, tested check instead of a quarterly spreadsheet.
  • Design agentic AI workflows that pair LLM reasoning with deterministic, auditable decision layers for evidence analysis, control monitoring, classification, and assessment.
  • Automate evidence collection and continuous control monitoring to replace point-in-time audit preparation.
  • Partner with Security, Procurement, Resilience and Engineering teams to find the manual processes most worth turning into a product.
  • Contribute to technical design discussions, evaluating the security and reliability properties of the platform itself.

You Have

  • Third-party risk management and business continuity experience.
  • 4+ years building production software in backend, platform, data, or software engineering
  • Multi-year ownership of a production system, including on-call, SLOs, and the maintenance work that starts after launch
  • Proficiency with at least one of Python, Kotlin, Java, or Go, and comfort reading unfamiliar codebases
  • Hands-on experience building with LLMs (prompting, tool use, agents, or LLM-backed features) and opinions about where model judgment belongs and where it doesn't. Judgment matters more here than volume
  • Experience with integration patterns: REST APIs, webhooks, authentication flows, event-driven architectures
  • Experience pulling, normalizing, and joining data from multiple imperfect sources, and handling the edge cases gracefully
  • Experience defining technical direction where the problem was ambiguous, and carrying it across team boundaries
  • Attention to detail balanced with pragmatism about risk-based prioritization
  • Curiosity, persistence, and comfort operating with minimal structure in an early-stage program

Nice to have:

  • Working knowledge of a security or compliance framework such as PCI DSS, SOX, SOC 2, ISO 27001, or NIST. Prior GRC experience is not required; we can teach the governance side
  • Production-scale LLM or agentic systems experience

You Know

Ideal candidates will have familiarity with some of the technologies in our environment:

  • Languages & Frameworks: Python, Java, Kotlin, Go
  • AI: LLM APIs (we build on Claude), agent frameworks and tool-use patterns such as Model Context Protocol, eval harnesses
  • APIs & Data: HTTP, JSON, gRPC, Protocol Buffers, SQL, Snowflake
  • Infrastructure: AWS, GCP, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD (Buildkite), event-driven architecture

title: Senior Creative Strategist, Performance Marketing
locations: Bay Area, CA, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

The Role

Square is looking for a Senior Creative Strategist to independently lead creative and content strategy for a defined growth portfolio within Demand Generation. You’ll own initiatives from audience insight and strategic planning through development, launch, experimentation, and optimization across paid and unpaid experiences.

This senior individual contributor role combines marketing, creative strategy, content development, and experimentation. You’ll translate business priorities, audience insights, product messaging, and performance data into programs that drive consideration, acquisition, and conversion. Your scope will connect mid- and lower-funnel creative with corresponding landing pages and content experiences.

Our creative model is increasingly self-serve and AI-enabled. You’ll identify what we should build and test, develop messaging and creative hypotheses, and choose the right approach to delivery—creating directly with self-serve tools or leading creative and technical partners. Your work may include ads, SEO-informed website content, educational resources, and interactive tools such as calculators that help sellers evaluate Square and take action.

You’ll co-develop the broader DG creative and content tactical plan with the Creative & Optimization Strategy Lead and cross-functional partners, then take independent ownership of agreed portfolios and initiatives. You’ll become a subject matter expert on your audiences and acquisition journey, working across channels and influencing partners without relying on formal reporting authority.

You Will

  • Own creative and content strategy for an assigned growth portfolio, connecting business objectives, audience needs, product value propositions, and channel behavior across mid- and lower-funnel experiences. Lead initiatives from strategy through delivery and optimization.
  • Build audience-specific and audience-agnostic messaging frameworks and hierarchies that establish what we need to communicate and how it should flex across paid and unpaid channels, funnel stages, formats, and corresponding landing pages.
  • Identify unmet audience needs and opportunities for creative, content, and experience experimentation. Use performance data, customer research, channel trends, and business priorities to develop hypotheses and make a clear recommendation on what to build or test next.
  • Co-develop quarterly tactical plans with the Creative & Optimization Strategy Lead and channel partners. Own the testing roadmap for your portfolio, defining hypotheses, isolated variables, success measures, resource needs, and tradeoffs.
  • Lead net-new creative and content development from insight and concept through launch. Write strategic briefs, develop messaging and content, provide actionable feedback, and coordinate creative, agency, and technical partners. Use self-serve tools to produce and iterate directly when appropriate.
  • Own performance reviews for your initiatives with channel and analytics partners. Use quantitative and qualitative evidence to understand what performed and why, distinguish creative signals from media delivery and audience effects, and recommend the next action.
  • Synthesize learnings across experiments and channels, identifying patterns beyond individual test results and using them to inform future messaging, creative, audience, and channel strategies.
  • Scale winning messages and concepts across paid social, display, native, online video, streaming/CTV, mobile, digital out-of-home, direct mail, and emerging channels. Extend relevant learnings into unpaid content, website experiences, and other seller touchpoints.
  • Identify, prioritize, and execute landing page experiments to improve conversion, translating audience insights and creative learnings into tests of messaging, content, and page experiences. Make updates directly through self-serve tools or work with cross-functional partners to launch tests, evaluate results, and iterate.
  • Develop and improve self-serve, AI-enabled frameworks, templates, tools, and workflows that increase creative and content quality, testing speed, and scale. Apply AI across research, ideation, briefing, development, experimentation, and analysis, evaluating output for accuracy, brand alignment, and usefulness.
  • Connect creative and content decisions to business outcomes. Prioritize opportunities and resources based on likely impact, effort, and evidence, and communicate recommendations, progress, and results clearly to stakeholders and leadership.
  • Bring structure to ambiguous, complex initiatives: define the problem, develop a point of view, align stakeholders, resolve dependencies, and drive delivery independently. Build trusted partnerships across channel marketing, creative, agencies, analytics, CRO, Web, SEO, and other teams.

You Have

  • 6+ years of relevant experience across creative strategy, performance marketing, growth marketing, integrated marketing, content strategy, advertising, or a related discipline, with demonstrated ownership of complex programs and measurable business outcomes.
  • A marketer’s mindset with strong creative judgment and business acumen. You can develop strategy across distinct audiences and acquisition journeys, connect mid- and lower-funnel experiences, and turn business needs into effective creative and content.
  • Advanced fluency with AI-powered tools and workflows, with a demonstrated ability to use AI as an integral part of creative strategy. You regularly apply AI across research, ideation, briefing, creative development, analysis, and optimization; build repeatable workflows that improve speed, quality, and scale; and bring a critical, experimental mindset to emerging tools and capabilities.
  • Strong analytical and experimentation skills, with experience forming hypotheses, designing or evaluating creative tests, interpreting performance data, and translating results into clear recommendations for what to test next.
  • Experience developing messaging strategies, value propositions, creative territories, or messaging hierarchies and translating them across audiences, funnel stages, channels, and formats.
  • Experience independently leading complex creative or content initiatives from audience insight and strategic planning through launch and iteration, including writing clear briefs, developing messaging, and guiding creative and production partners.
  • A strong understanding of performance marketing and the relationship between creative, media, content, and the post-click experience. You can identify how messaging and experience changes may improve conversion and partner with specialists to test them.
  • The ability to synthesize learnings across multiple experiments and channels, identify meaningful patterns, and develop a clear point of view on where the greatest opportunities lie.
  • Strong cross-functional influence, prioritization, and communication skills. You can navigate ambiguity, align stakeholders without formal authority, make sound tradeoffs, and drive work to completion with limited direction.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience in an agency environment, particularly working across strategy, media, creative, and campaign execution.
  • Experience developing unpaid content, SEO-informed website experiences, educational resources, or interactive decision tools such as calculators, in partnership with content, SEO, Web, or technical teams.
  • Experience building creative testing programs or experimentation frameworks at scale.
  • Experience with conversion rate optimization, landing page experimentation, or other forms of digital experience optimization.
  • Experience developing self-serve creative systems, templates, playbooks, or AI-enabled workflows.
  • Experience marketing products to small businesses, merchants, or B2B audiences.

title: Business Systems Analyst, IT Vendor Operations
locations: Bay Area, CA, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
It all started with an idea at Block in 2013. Initially built to take the pain out of peer-to-peer payments, Cash App has gone from a simple product with a single purpose to a dynamic ecosystem, developing unique financial products, including Afterpay/Clearpay, to provide a better way to send, spend, invest, borrow and save to our 50+ million monthly active customers. We want to redefine the world’s relationship with money to make it more relatable, instantly available, and universally accessible.

Today, Cash App has thousands of employees working globally across office and remote locations, with a culture geared toward innovation, collaboration and impact. We’ve been a distributed team since day one, and many of our roles can be done remotely from the countries where Cash App operates. No matter the location, we tailor our experience to ensure our employees are creative, productive, and happy.

The Role

The IT Vendor Operations team sits at the intersection of business and technology — triaging, troubleshooting, and resolving technical issues across the tools and systems that thousands of Block advocates rely on every day. As Business Systems Analyst you will be the first line of defense when something breaks, the investigator when something behaves unexpectedly, and the bridge between our business teams and engineering partners.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, loves solving technical puzzles, and wants cross-functional exposure across Block's support organization. You'll work across Salesforce (CF1), Amazon Connect, Okta, internal tooling, and more — ensuring advocates can focus on helping customers instead of fighting their tools.

You Will

  • Support identity and access management administration for an entire suite of applications, balancing routine operational tasks (~40%) with complex, non-routine requests requiring investigation and specialized attention (~60%)
  • Triage and resolve technical support tickets spanning Salesforce, Amazon Connect, Toolbox, Regulator, Registry, internal tax tools, and other internal & external systems
  • Troubleshoot bugs, system errors, and unexpected behaviors reported by internal team members and escalate to engineering when needed
  • Process and validate access requests for various systems and roles
  • Perform system validation to ensure tools work as intended for support teams and customers
  • Manage technical escalations through Jira, coordinating with engineering and product teams to drive resolution
  • Support SEV management as a liaison between support teams and engineers during critical system incidents
  • Automate and improve operational workflows to reduce manual effort and improve response times
  • Document troubleshooting steps, known issues, and resolution paths to build a shared knowledge base
  • Partner cross-functionally with teams across Block to identify recurring pain points and advocate for systemic fixes

You Have

  • Experience in IT support, business systems, or technical operations — ideally in a support or customer care environment
  • Familiarity with Salesforce administration or configuration (flows, queues, skills, user management)
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills — you can break down a vague bug report into a clear, reproducible issue
  • Effective and clear communication (written and verbal) — you'll be translating between technical and non-technical audiences daily
  • Comfort working in Jira or similar ticketing systems for tracking and managing work
  • Ability to read and interpret code, logs, and system configurations
  • Methodical, highly organized, and detail-oriented with a high level of accuracy
  • A bias toward action — you'd rather dig in and figure it out than wait for someone else to
  • Experience with Amazon Connect, telephony systems, or contact center platforms is a plus
  • Familiarity with Okta, IAM, or access management workflows is a plus
  • Scripting or automation experience (Python, JavaScript, or similar) is a plus

Technologies We Use and Teach

  • Salesforce (CF1)
  • Amazon Connect
  • Jira
  • Okta
  • GitHub
  • Google Workspace
  • AI-assisted development tools

title: Security Engineer - Network Edge Security
locations: Bay Area, CA, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
Block is one company built from many blocks, all united by the same purpose: economic empowerment. We build technology that increases access and independence for sellers, individuals, and artists around the world. Working at Block means working on and across our brands—Square, Cash App, Afterpay, TIDAL, Spiral, and Proto— in roles that connect, enable, and push all of them forward faster.

We’re remote-first by design and operate with intelligence at the center of everything we do. At Block, you'll be challenged by some of the brightest, most creative minds in the industry and have the tools and autonomy to do the most meaningful work of your career

The Role

The Network Edge Security team builds the tools that provide important insights to our API Security posture and trustworthiness of traffic flowing into our systems. Our capabilities use machine learning, streaming analytics, and significant data analysis to provide insights into understanding our network edge risk exposure and the true sources of our request flows. The team’s primary focus is up-leveling our API security posture for downstream products and services. However, there is also a need at times to respond quickly to emerging threats to take action at the edge to provide immediate relief. The team is small, requiring nimbleness and flexibility to stay ahead of threat actors. You should have a strong passion for the problem space – needing to understand a significant range of knowledge around Content Distribution Networks (CDN), analytical tools, network protocols and behavior, as well as authentication and authorization systems. You will work closely with many teams across the organization both engineering and operational to gain the insights required to understand the problem space as well as monitor the effectiveness of our solutions.

You Will

  • Respond and mitigate emerging threats and attacks at our network edge by leveraging WAF rules, bot vendors, and other CDN-native technologies 
  • Help build out infrastructure that gives us better inventory of our network edge security posture
  • Build out and maintain a near-real time streaming analytics data pipeline and application
  • Contribute to the evolution of our labeling and ML model development.
  • Help manage and maintain our systems across build, deploy, and production monitoring,
  • Be flexible with respect to computer languages as we use Java, Kotlin, Python, TypeScript, PySpark and others as needed or appropriate
  • Evaluate and build integrations with vendor systems that may be used in addition to in-house solutions
  • Develop and implement AI-driven capabilities to automatically classify and mitigate abusive traffic patterns
  • Significant experience with bot/fraud identification and mitigation systems is a strong plus

You Have

  • 5+ years of software or security engineering experience developing scalable production software incorporating testing, evaluation, and monitoring
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience
  • Proficient in Java, Kotlin, Typescript, and Python
  • Proficient in data analysis using SQL and Spark
  • Experience implementing and maintaining applications in both a CDN (Cloudflare and Fastly) and Amazon Web Services (AWS) ecosystems
  • Familiarity with Snowflake, Databricks, and Datadog are a strong plus

Technologies We Use and Teach

  • Java/Kotlin, Javascript/Typescript, Python 
  • CDN (Cloudflare and Fastly)
  • Snowflake, MySQL, DynamoDB, Databricks
  • AWS
  • Kafka
  • Datadog, Terraform
