title: Software Engineer, Program Engineering
locations: Bay Area, CA, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
Block is one company built from many blocks, all united by the same purpose of economic empowerment. The blocks that form our foundational teams — People, Finance, Counsel, Hardware, Information Security, Platform Infrastructure Engineering, and more — provide support and guidance at the corporate level. They work across business groups and around the globe, spanning time zones and disciplines to develop inclusive People policies, forecast finances, give legal counsel, safeguard systems, nurture new initiatives, and more. Every challenge creates possibilities, and we need different perspectives to see them all. Bring yours to Block.

The Role

At Block, we strive to build the best products in the world, including the ones our customers never see. The Compliance Program Engineering team builds the core infrastructure that supports Block's compliance program and the product teams that depend on it. When Block needs to meet a regulatory obligation, the investigators, analysts, and automated systems doing that work rely on our platforms to understand what is happening across Block's ecosystem and act on it.

We focus on two areas:

1) Unified transaction store and search. Transactions are one of the most important building blocks at Block. We bring transaction data from across Block's products into one place and make it easy to understand, search, and use. This helps the business stay compliant and supports new product use cases. We're investing in data coverage, quality, and usability, and in self-serve tools that make it simple for new product types to onboard.

2) Entity labeling, ingestion, and workflow. We give teams a flexible way to label any entity at Block, such as a customer, account, or transaction, without cluttering core data models. Those labels can trigger downstream effects, so teams can build complex workflows on top of them. Labels can be applied through simple self-serve tools or through high-volume bulk ingestion at scale, which makes automation possible.

As a full stack software engineer on Compliance Program Engineering, you'll design, build, and operate these platforms. We work with an incubator mindset: we start small, prove value quickly, scale what works, and hand mature solutions to a dedicated team. You'll balance delivering value today with building foundations that last. Where business units have similar needs, you'll help them share the same systems so every team can move faster.

You Will

  • Partner closely with your team to design, develop, test, ship, and maintain features across our transaction and labeling platforms
  • Write high-quality, well-tested code, and participate actively in design reviews and code reviews
  • Design and implement systems that work within our microservice and event-driven architectures and handle sensitive customer and financial data with care and correctness
  • Improve the coverage, quality, and usability of transaction data so investigators, analysts, and automated systems can trust and act on it
  • Build self-serve tools and high-volume ingestion pipelines that let teams across Block onboard new products and label entities without waiting on us
  • Partner directly with Compliance, Risk, and product teams to turn regulatory and business requirements into durable, reusable platform capabilities
  • Participate in operational ownership of engineering systems, including on-call, incident response, and postmortems
  • Demonstrate AI fluency by using AI-powered tools throughout the development lifecycle to improve velocity and quality, while applying sound judgment in their use
  • Hold your teammates, and yourself, to high engineering standards
  • Learn from and support other engineers through code reviews and technical discussion

You Have

  • 3+ years of software development or equivalent experience
  • Experience building and maintaining production software systems, and delivering well-scoped projects or features end-to-end (design, build, test, ship, operate) with guidance from more experienced engineers
  • Worked across the stack, on backend services and on the interfaces people use to operate them
  • Drive to find flaws in a system with many moving parts and take whatever steps are necessary to fix them
  • Curiosity about problems that arrive only partly specified, and a habit of asking the questions that make them concrete
  • A track record of explaining technical tradeoffs in writing and in person, to engineers and non-engineers alike
  • Demonstrated AI fluency, including experience using AI-powered developer tools and the ability to critically evaluate and responsibly apply their outputs
  • Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience

Even better:

  • Experience building platforms or self-serve tools that other engineering teams build on
  • Experience with search systems, data modeling, or bulk data ingestion at scale
  • Experience working with sensitive data (PII, PCI) or building to privacy, security, or regulatory requirements
  • Experience integrating LLMs or agents into production workflows
  • Interest in compliance or financial technology is a plus. Deep domain expertise isn't required; we'll teach you.

Technologies We Use and Teach

  • Ruby on Rails, Sidekiq
  • Java, Kotlin
  • React, TypeScript
  • AWS
  • HTTP, JSON, gRPC, Protocol Buffers
  • MySQL, Aurora, DynamoDB, Redis
  • Kafka, event-driven architecture, microservices
  • Datadog
  • Buildkite, Gradle
  • LLMs, AI agents and tooling (Goose, Claude, MCP

title: Mid-Market Account Excutive
locations: Melbourne, Australia
descriptionHtml:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality,  book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

The Role

At Square, we’re re-imagining how mid-market businesses grow. As an Account Executive on our Mid-Market Team, you’ll bring Square’s ecosystem to new sellers across diverse industries by building, shaping, and closing your own pipeline. You’ll run sophisticated, multi-product deals from the first touch to final close — blending hunter instincts, consultative depth, and strategic execution.

If you’re an experienced closer who thrives in outbound environments, loves solving meaningful business challenges, and consistently delivers against ambitious targets — this is your role.

You Will

  • Own the full outbound sales cycle — from prospecting to negotiation to close — with mid-market merchants.
  • Build and manage a high-quality pipeline through cold outreach, social selling, targeted campaigns, and creative outbound strategies.
  • Develop multi-product solutions across Square’s ecosystem and tailor them to each merchant’s unique needs.
  • Partner with Business Development on lead flow while independently driving net-new logo acquisition.
  • Conduct high-impact discovery, demos, and negotiations with decisiveness across multi-stakeholder deals.
  • Act as a consultant and trusted advisor — seamlessly flexing across BDR, AE, and AM responsibilities when needed.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Marketing, Implementation, and Operations to deliver cohesive solutions.
  • Maintain disciplined pipeline management and forecasting accuracy in Salesforce.
  • Consistently hit and exceed revenue goals — monthly and quarterly.

You Have

  • 6+ years of full-cycle B2B sales experience with consistent quota achievement.
  • Proven success in outbound prospecting and net-new business creation (SaaS or fintech preferred).
  • Experience closing complex, multi-threaded deals with longer sales cycles.
  • Ability to build pipeline from scratch using targeted, strategic outreach.
  • Exceptional communication, presentation, and negotiation skills across phone, video, and written channels.
  • Strong consultative selling skills — diagnose business challenges and map tailored solutions.
  • A hunter’s mindset — resilient, creative, and driven to win.
  • Ability to work independently while contributing to a team-first environment.
  • Advanced proficiency with Salesforce and modern sales tools.
  • BA/BS degree or equivalent experience.

Square is building a best-in-class, high-impact field sales organization, and we are looking for an exceptional Field Sales Account Executive — someone who consistently exceeds expectations, takes full ownership of their territory, and brings Square's mission of economic empowerment directly to the businesses that need it most.

This is a field-driven, execution-focused role designed for individuals who thrive in dynamic, demanding environments. You will spend most of your week out in the market — meeting businesses, conducting live demos, and closing deals with confidence. The pace is fast, the expectations are high, and your ability to operate strategically and decisively will determine your success.

You will serve as Square's presence and competitive advantage in one of our highest-opportunity markets — responsible for building pipeline from the ground up, elevating Square's visibility in your community, establishing high-value partnerships, and helping local businesses grow through our ecosystem of industry-leading software and hardware.

Lead your market with disciplined, in-person execution

Establish yourself as the go-to Square expert in your city

  • Implement a disciplined referral strategy to turn every new customer into future opportunities.

Build a high-velocity pipeline from the ground up

  • Develop a repeatable top-of-funnel engine through door-to-door outreach, community engagement, events, networking, and targeted partnerships.
  • Work with channel partners to generate a consistent, high-quality referral stream that grows over time.

Master your verticals and sell with precision

  • Build deep expertise in key verticals — including restaurants, retail, and services — to diagnose challenges and position the right Square solutions.
  • Sell consultatively and competitively, staying proactive and strategic throughout the sales cycle.

Achieve exceptional results in a high-accountability environment

  • Maintain strong operational rigor in Salesforce: track activity, manage pipeline, and forecast accurately.
  • Measure performance frequently and improve continuously.
  • Consistently exceed quota within a culture where high standards are the norm.

You Have

  • 3+ years of sales experience in a full cycle closing role with field sales experience
  • Experience exceeding sales targets, selling a diverse ecosystem of products, and closing complex deals
  • Ability to drive deals independently in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
  • Business development experience (e.g. hunting and cold calling)
  • Since this is a field position, you must have reliable transportation and live in the market you are serving
  • A collaborative and team player mentality
  • Prior Salesforce experience or equivalent
  • Even better:
    • 2+ years of payment processing OR related technology (i.e. payroll, loyalty, time management)
    • 1+ years of relevant audience experience (experience working in/selling to restaurants, retailers or services based businesses)

The Role

At Square, we’re re-imagining how small and midsize businesses grow. As an Inside Sales Account Executive, you’ll convert high-quality inbound leads into long-term customers — while also sourcing your own opportunities to keep your pipeline full. You’ll be at the heart of our growth engine: fast-paced, metrics-obsessed, and built for people who hold themselves to a higher bar than anyone else will. This is a role for people who don’t wait for direction, don’t make excuses, and don’t settle for “good enough”. 

If you’re a closer who thrives on momentum, loves solving problems for real businesses, and wants to work hard in a high-energy environment where effort translates directly into success — this is your role.

Square offers the opportunity to operate in a fast-paced environment where your outreach brings Square’s tools to more sellers - and your success becomes part of our mission to level the playing field for entrepreneurs. We move fast, learn continuously, and reward grit and results by offering uncapped earning potential.

You Will

  • Own the full sales cycle — from first conversation to close — with SMB merchants across a variety of industries.
  • Engage and convert a steady flow of warm inbound leads from marketing, partnerships, and product interest.
  • Generate a meaningful portion of your pipeline through outbound. You relentlessly build your pipeline through outbound prospecting — you don’t rely on inbound, you outwork it. You know how to identify new opportunities, craft personalized outreach, and create demand where none existed.
  • Operate with urgency across every stage  — you manage time and priorities effectively in a high-volume environment. You move fast, and don’t let deals stall.
  • Understand customer pain points and deliver value-based, consultative solutions that drive measurable impact. You diagnose real business problems and take ownership of solving them. 
  • Collaborate across teams (Onboarding, Product, Marketing, and Support) to ensure a seamless customer experience and continuous feedback loop.
  • Track and forecast your pipeline accurately in Salesforce — you’re data-driven and use metrics to improve performance.
  • Consistently hit and exceed monthly and quarterly revenue goals.

You Have

  • Raise your own bar every quarter - improving conversion rates, deal size, and activity without being asked.
  • 2-4 years of inside sales or full-cycle closing experience, ideally in a fast-paced SaaS, payments, or SMB-focused environment.
  • Proven ability to exceed quota and close business in a high-volume, short-cycle motion.
  • Strong phone, video, and written communication skills — you build trust fast and move deals forward decisively.
  • A true hunter mentality -  A hunter’s mindset focused on disciplined outbound outreach, allowing you to build and accelerate pipeline independent of inbound demand.
  • Curiosity and empathy: you dig into the customer’s business, uncover real needs, and position the right solution with confidence.
  • Ability to thrive in ambiguity — you’re self-motivated, coachable, and hungry to grow.
  • CRM fluency (Salesforce or similar) and a data-driven approach to activity management.
  • High standards for yourself and your team -  — you celebrate wins together, share what works, and raise the bar for those around you.

title: Territory Account Executive, Oakland
locations: Oakland, CA, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

The Role

Square is building a best-in-class, high-impact field sales organization, and we are looking for an exceptional Territory Account Executive — someone who consistently exceeds expectations, takes full ownership of their territory, and brings Square’s mission of economic empowerment directly to the businesses that need it most.

This is a field-driven, execution-focused role designed for individuals who thrive in dynamic, demanding environments. You will spend most of your week out in the market — meeting businesses, conducting live demos, and closing deals with confidence. The pace is fast, the expectations are high, and your ability to operate strategically and decisively will determine your success.

You will serve as Square’s presence and competitive advantage in one of our highest-opportunity markets — responsible for building pipeline from the ground up, elevating Square’s visibility in your community, establishing high-value partnerships, and helping local businesses grow through our ecosystem of industry-leading software and hardware.

If you are motivated by impactful work, driven to outperform, and eager to join a high-performance team with high standards, this role is built for you.

You will:

Lead your market with disciplined, in-person execution

  • Spend ~80% of your week in the field — walking your territory, engaging local businesses, and driving 50–60 targeted business visits each week.
  • Run a full-cycle, self-sourced sales motion: generate leads, identify needs, deliver compelling demos, and close deals across Square’s full product suite.

Establish yourself as the go-to Square expert in your city

  • Build strong, trust-based relationships with local sellers by being present, reliable, and value-driven.
  • Partner cross-functionally to ensure a seamless onboarding experience and fast time-to-value for new sellers.
  • Implement a disciplined referral strategy to turn every new customer into future opportunities.

Build a high-velocity pipeline from the ground up

  • Develop a repeatable top-of-funnel engine through door-to-door outreach, community engagement, events, networking, and targeted partnerships.
  • Work with channel partners to generate a consistent, high-quality referral stream that grows over time.

Master your verticals and sell with precision

  • Build deep expertise in key verticals — including restaurants, retail, and services — to diagnose challenges and position the right Square solutions.
  • Sell consultatively and competitively, staying proactive and strategic throughout the sales cycle.

Achieve exceptional results in a high-accountability environment

  • Maintain strong operational rigor in Salesforce: track activity, manage pipeline, and forecast accurately.
  • Measure performance frequently and improve continuously.
  • Consistently exceed quota within a culture where high standards are the norm.

You have:

  • 3+ years of sales experience in a full cycle closing role with field sales experience
  • Experience exceeding sales targets, selling a diverse ecosystem of products, and closing complex deals
  • Ability to drive deals independently in a fast-paced, dynamic environment 
  • Business development experience (e.g. hunting and cold calling)
  • Since this is a field position, you must have reliable transportation and live in the market you are serving
  • A collaborative and team player mentality
  • Prior Salesforce experience or equivalent
  • Even better:
    • 2+ years of payment processing OR related technology (i.e. payroll, loyalty, time management)
    • 1+ years of relevant audience experience (experience working in/selling to restaurants, retailers or services based businesses)

title: Creative Director, Experiential
locations: New York, NY, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
Block is one company built from many blocks, all united by the same purpose: economic empowerment. We build technology that increases access and independence for sellers, individuals, and artists around the world. Working at Block means working on and across our brands—Square, Cash App, Afterpay, TIDAL, Spiral, and Proto— in roles that connect, enable, and push all of them forward faster.

We’re remote-first by design and operate with intelligence at the center of everything we do. At Block, you'll be challenged by some of the brightest, most creative minds in the industry and have the tools and autonomy to do the most meaningful work of your career. 

The Role

Block’s in-house creative team builds the brand platforms and campaigns behind Cash App, Square, and Afterpay. We’re hiring a creative director for experiential, spatial design, and activations to originate ideas that bring our brands into the world and lead them from concept through production and execution. This is a hands-on individual contributor role: you’ll shape the brief alongside creative strategy, lead project teams, and set the creative standard for experiences that connect with people and culture.

You will

  • Originate distinctive experiential, spatial design, and activation ideas across Block brands, creating new ways for people to encounter and connect with them.
  • Own complex projects independently, from the first concept through production and execution. Stay hands-on and protect the idea through the details of the finished experience.
  • Shape briefs with creative strategy and cross-functional partners, connecting creative ambition to audience needs and business goals.
  • Present creative work to senior stakeholders, explain your decisions, and navigate feedback while preserving what makes the work distinctive.
  • Work with agencies as an extension of the team, developing ideas and shaping the work together rather than handing off a brief.
  • Partner closely with production teams and vendors to bring ideas to life. Make thoughtful tradeoffs, solve problems, and maintain creative quality as constraints change.
  • Raise the creative standard across teams through your own work, constructive critique, and shared references and learning. Lead collaborators without stepping away from making.
  • Build and share better ways of working, including using AI for exploration, prototyping, and reducing repetitive production. Apply your own taste and judgment to what moves forward.

You have

  • A portfolio of experiential, spatial design, or activation work you led from concept through execution, showing original ideas, strong creative taste, and attention to the experience people actually have.
  • Senior creative experience with a hands-on approach and a track record of setting direction and quality standards across a complex body of work.
  • Deep knowledge of experiential production, vendor capabilities, and how to get complex work made without losing the creative intent.
  • Experience independently leading cross-functional projects and presenting creative work to senior stakeholders.
  • Sound judgment in ambiguous situations, with examples of solving problems, adapting to setbacks, and moving work forward.
  • A collaborative, direct communication style. You challenge ideas respectfully and build trust with colleagues, agencies, production teams, and vendors.
  • A connection to culture that informs your work, and experience helping others produce more original, thoughtful creative work through critique and shared learning.
  • A minimum of 12 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 8 years and a Master’s degree; or a PhD with 5 years experience; or equivalent experience.

Submit your application with a link to your portfolio. If your portfolio is password-protected, include the password.

title: Chief Compliance Officer, Cash App Investing
locations: Bay Area, CA, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
It all started with an idea at Block in 2013. Initially built to take the pain out of peer-to-peer payments, Cash App has gone from a simple product with a single purpose to a dynamic ecosystem, developing unique financial products, including Afterpay/Clearpay, to provide a better way to send, spend, invest, borrow and save to our 50+ million monthly active customers. We want to redefine the world’s relationship with money to make it more relatable, instantly available, and universally accessible.

Today, Cash App has thousands of employees working globally across office and remote locations, with a culture geared toward innovation, collaboration and impact. We’ve been a distributed team since day one, and many of our roles can be done remotely from the countries where Cash App operates. No matter the location, we tailor our experience to ensure our employees are creative, productive, and happy.

The Role

Cash App Investing is seeking a Compliance Officer to lead and mature the compliance program for its FINRA/SEC-regulated investing business. Reporting to the Head of Global Regulated Entities at Block, you will provide senior compliance leadership across broker-dealer obligations, product advisory, regulatory engagement, governance, and team execution. This role will partner closely with Cash App Investing leadership, Product, Engineering, Legal, Risk, Financial Crimes, Operations, and Internal Audit to support responsible growth and strong regulatory outcomes.

You Will

  • Lead the Cash App Investing compliance program, including policies, procedures, controls, monitoring, testing, reporting, and governance.
  • Maintain and enhance written supervisory procedures, supervisory controls, escalation routines, and compliance operating processes.
  • Advise Product, Engineering, Operations, Marketing, Legal, and business leaders on investing product development, customer communications, and regulated activities.
  • Oversee core broker-dealer compliance obligations, including communications review, complaints, regulatory filings, books and records, employee supervision, product reviews, and issue management.
  • Lead or support FINRA, SEC, state, and other regulatory exams, inquiries, responses, remediation plans, and regulator engagement.
  • Partner with Financial Crimes Compliance on AML, suspicious activity monitoring, investigations, fraud, identity theft, and related regulatory expectations.
  • Oversee compliance considerations for third-party and outsourced functions, including clearing broker and vendor relationships.
  • Develop clear reporting for senior leadership, governance forums, and the Board on risks, issues, exams, remediation, and program maturity.
  • Lead and develop a compliance team with clear ownership, sustainable coverage, and strong accountability.

You Have

  • 10+ years of compliance experience, including significant experience in broker-dealer, securities, fintech, financial services, or similarly regulated environments.
  • Deep knowledge of FINRA and SEC requirements applicable to retail broker-dealers and digital investing platforms.
  • Experience serving in a senior compliance, chief compliance officer, deputy CCO, or comparable compliance leadership role.
  • Experience managing regulatory exams, regulatory inquiries, remediation plans, and regulator communications.
  • Strong understanding of supervisory controls, written supervisory procedures, communications review, complaints, books and records, regulatory filings, and product compliance.
  • Experience advising product, engineering, operations, legal, and business teams on regulated financial products.
  • Strong judgment, communication skills, and ability to make risk-based decisions in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead, coach, and develop compliance professionals.

Even Better

  • FINRA principal registration, such as Series 24, or ability to obtain required registrations promptly.
  • Series 7, Series 14, Series 63/65/66, or other relevant securities registrations.
  • Experience with mobile-first investing products, embedded financial services, clearing broker oversight, or fintech broker-dealer models.
  • Experience supporting Board-level governance and regulated-entity reporting.

title: Senior Technical Account Manager
locations: Sydney, Australia
descriptionHtml:
Afterpay is transforming the way people shop and pay, giving consumers greater flexibility and control over their finances while helping merchants connect with customers and grow their businesses. Founded in Australia in 2014, Afterpay has grown into a globally recognized leader in Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL), empowering millions of consumers to shop with confidence through a simple, transparent payment experience.

As part of Block’s global ecosystem, Afterpay works alongside Cash App, Square, and other financial products to make commerce and financial services more accessible. Together, we're building innovative solutions that connect consumers and businesses, creating more opportunities for people to participate in the economy.

The Role

Block is looking for a Senior Technical Account Manager to support Afterpay merchants across Australia. This team keeps merchants healthy and growing through post-sales technical partnership that protects performance, surfaces opportunity, and drives commercial outcomes.

You will serve as a trusted technical partner to our largest merchants, sitting at the intersection of product, engineering, solutions engineering, GTM, and merchant success. You will combine deep product and technical expertise with commercial acumen to proactively enable merchants - not just resolve issues - ensuring they are healthy, growing, and fully leveraging Cash App Pay and Afterpay capabilities.

This is a hands-on technical role. You will use HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to analyze and creatively solve integration issues on merchant websites and in-store terminals, while partnering cross-functionally to support feature and product adoption at scale. You will translate merchant business needs into technical solutions that deliver measurable commercial outcomes.

In this role, you will report to Block's Global Technical Account Management Lead.

You Will

  • Identify and act on post-sales growth opportunities within your merchant portfolio, partnering with Account Management to grow GPV and feature adoption to deliver measurable commercial outcomes
  • Provide education to merchants, partners, and internal teams on Cash App Pay and Afterpay features, and deliver quarterly technical reviews connecting integration health to commercial performance
  • Partner with Solutions Engineering to ensure seamless pre-sales to post-sales handoffs and collaborate on expansion opportunities
  • Work cross-functionally with Account Management, Sales, Solutions Engineering, Product, and Engineering to provide technical and operational solutions that improve the merchant experience
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to represent the merchant voice and frame feature requests with commercial impact
  • Proactively manage new product life cycles in conjunction with Product and Engineering teams to facilitate merchant adoption
  • Lead integration health monitoring - conduct regular health checks using defined KPIs, perform root-cause analysis, implement preventative measures, and promote standardization across merchant implementations

Qualifications

We know that no single candidate will meet every qualification listed below. If this role excites you and you see yourself in most of these, we encourage you to apply.

  • Senior-level experience in account management, customer success, or a client-facing technical role within payments, fintech, or e-commerce
  • Prior hands-on technical experience in Solutions Engineering, Partner Engineering, Technical Consulting, or software development

  • Solid understanding of payments infrastructure, APIs, integrations, and e-commerce platforms, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences

locations: Bay Area, CA, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

The Role

Ordering directly from a restaurant or retail shop should be intuitive and feel dependable. Customers should know where their order is, hear about and easily follow updates, and get help quickly when something goes wrong.

We’re hiring a Product Manager to own that experience at Square, across food ordering and retail ecommerce. You’ll build customer experiences and seller tools for pickup, delivery, and shipping, helping businesses earn trust and bring customers back.

The problems are concrete: How do you follow an order’s progress? What should happen when a delivery runs late or an item goes missing? How do you make a refund clear, or give a seller an easy way to make things right? You’ll own the experience from the moment an order is placed through its arrival and any help needed afterward.

We’re looking for someone with a strong product sense who notices where people get confused, knows when to simplify, and cares about the details that build confidence. You’ll spend time with customers and sellers, work closely with design and engineering, and turn those insights into products that customers trust and repeatedly come back to for their next purchase.

You Will

  • Own the strategy and priorities. Set the direction for Square’s post-checkout customer experience across food ordering and retail. Use customer needs and business goals to decide which problems matter most, where to invest, and what can wait.
  • Bring the work together. At Block, engineers and people across teams also lead individual product improvements. You will connect those efforts across Square and external partners, spot gaps, resolve competing priorities, and make sure the pieces form a clear, consistent customer experience as more people prototype and ship.
  • Design and define user experiences. Work closely with design and engineering to shape key customer journeys, from tracking an order to getting help when something goes wrong. Bring personal taste and attention to detail to the flows, interactions, and communications that build trust.
  • Help the team scale through automation. Use AI and other tools to connect and automate repeatable work across customer research, analysis, prototyping, product development, and launch. Build reusable workflows, share what works, and give teams the context and tools to make good decisions independently.
  • Set the quality bar and guide important decisions. Define what good looks like and evaluate product ideas and AI-generated work against real customer scenarios. Test assumptions, give specific feedback, and keep refining until the experience is useful, clear, and dependable. Decide where AI and automation improve the experience and where human judgment matters.
  • Prototype and ship improvements yourself. Use AI tools to turn ideas into working prototypes, test them with customers, and learn quickly. Use GitHub and other developer tools to contribute changes through pull requests and work with engineers to ship improvements to production.
  • Own the outcomes. Follow work through launch and use customer feedback and data to guide improvements. Measure whether customers feel informed, get problems resolved quickly, and choose to order again, using signals like order-status inquiries, resolution time, satisfaction, and repeat purchases.

You Have

  • 6+ years of product management experience.
  • Consumer product judgment. You’ve shipped customer-facing products at scale that make complicated things feel simple. You can explain your decisions and what you learned from customer behavior.
  • Hands-on building with AI. You use AI to build working prototypes, automate recurring work, and test ideas. You can use GitHub and other tools to make a change and submit a PR. You can show what you’ve built and what you learned.
  • Taste and craft. You work closely with design and bring personal taste and a high bar for quality. You recognize generic or weak output, give specific feedback, and iterate until the experience feels thoughtful and useful.
  • Strategy and prioritization. You’ve set product direction and turned it into clear priorities. You make thoughtful tradeoffs and can explain what deserves investment and what can wait.
  • Customer research and analytical judgment. You use customer conversations, research, and behavioral data to guide decisions. You’re comfortable moving forward when the problem is ambiguous or the data is incomplete.
  • Leadership across teams. You bring people together around a clear direction, resolve disagreements, and get work shipped. You give others the context to make good decisions and keep moving.
  • Relevant experience. Experience with consumer products, ecommerce, marketplaces, or customer support is a plus, but not required. You’re curious about how businesses operate and what makes customers trust them.

title: Strategic Pricing & Monetization Lead
locations: Bay Area, CA, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
Block is one company built from many blocks, all united by the same purpose of economic empowerment. The blocks that form our foundational teams — People, Finance, Counsel, Hardware, Information Security, Platform Infrastructure Engineering, and more — provide support and guidance at the corporate level. They work across business groups and around the globe, spanning time zones and disciplines to develop inclusive People policies, forecast finances, give legal counsel, safeguard systems, nurture new initiatives, and more. Every challenge creates possibilities, and we need different perspectives to see them all. Bring yours to Block.

The Role

We are looking for a Strategic Pricing & Monetization Lead to shape how Block creates, captures, and grows value across its sales-driven channels. This role will lead a team of strategic pricing partners who support complex commercial decisions and help Sales achieve strong outcomes for Block and our customers.

The role sits within Strategic Finance and partners closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Legal, Risk, and Revenue Operations. You will provide thoughtful commercial guidance while establishing the frameworks, tools, and guardrails needed to support consistent, well-informed pricing and deal decisions.

This leader will build on Block’s existing Deal Desk capabilities by expanding the use of automation, AI, data, and scalable processes. The role will also extend the team’s impact beyond individual opportunities by using insights from complex upmarket deals to inform broader pricing, packaging, monetization, and portfolio-level initiatives.

You Will

  • Lead and develop a team of strategic pricing partners who support complex commercial decisions across Block’s sales-driven channels.
  • Partner with Sales on the most complex and strategically important opportunities, helping teams structure deals that balance customer value, revenue quality, profitability, ROI, risk, and growth.
  • Build trusted relationships with Sales leadership and cross-functional partners to evaluate revenue, margin, customer economics, and long-term business impact, while informing packaging, offers, launches, and commercial models.
  • Establish clear, thoughtful frameworks for pricing, deal structuring, approvals, exceptions, and commercial risk that enable timely, well-informed decisions while maintaining appropriate financial and commercial guardrails.
  • Build on Block’s existing Deal Desk capabilities by increasing the team’s leverage through automation, AI, data, and scalable processes.
  • Use insights from individual opportunities and customer negotiations to identify broader pricing, packaging, monetization, and portfolio-level opportunities.
  • Establish reporting and operating rhythms that improve visibility into pricing performance, discounting, deal economics, and commercial outcomes.
  • Create practical tools, playbooks, and guidance that help Sales navigate pricing and negotiations with confidence.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify and scale commercial processes while preserving the judgment required for complex deals.

You Have

  • 12+ years of experience in strategic pricing, monetization, Deal Desk, commercial strategy, revenue operations, finance, consulting, or a related field, with a track record of translating transaction-level insights into broader commercial strategy.
  • Experience leading and developing a high-performing team in a complex, cross-functional environment.
  • Experience supporting enterprise or upmarket sales motions, including complex pricing negotiations.
  • Experience developing pricing frameworks, discounting approaches, approval processes, commercial policies, or related governance.
  • Strong financial acumen and an analytical and data-informed approach, with the ability to turn complex analysis into clear recommendations and evaluate trade-offs across different business outcomes.
  • Experience using technology, automation, AI, or data to increase the scale and effectiveness of commercial work.
  • Comfort operating at both the strategic and tactical levels—from advising on individual opportunities to shaping broader commercial initiatives.
  • Excellent judgment and the ability to make principled decisions in ambiguous or high-stakes situations.
  • Clear, concise communication and strong executive presence.

title: Senior Analytics Engineer, AI & DX Analytics
locations: New York, NY, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
Block builds simple, powerful tools that make progress towards an economy that’s truly open to all.

Each of our brands unlocks different aspects of the economy for more people. Square makes commerce and financial services accessible to sellers. Cash App is the easy way to spend, send, and store money. Afterpay is transforming the way customers manage their spending over time. TIDAL is a music platform that empowers artists to thrive as entrepreneurs. Bitkey is a simple self-custody wallet built for bitcoin. Proto is a suite of bitcoin mining products and services. Together, we’re helping build a financial system that is open to everyone. Join us.

The Role

The AI & DX (Developer Experience) Analytics team exists to measure and improve Block's developer experience and investment in AI. We turn raw engineering signals (agent session data, pull request and CI activity, and AI spend) into reporting and analysis that shape leadership's AI investment decisions, and drive improvement in AI ROI and developer experience. Your work will be the trusted source of truth that engineers and executives use to decide where AI investment is working and where to redirect it.

We're hiring a Senior Analytics Engineer to own parts of that pipeline end to end. This is a broad, high-visibility role with a lot of white space: you will instrument new telemetry at the source and build production pipelines that turn it into governed data, then turn that governed data into executive-facing reporting and the analysis that surfaces concrete opportunities to improve AI ROI and developer experience. You'll also help pioneer one of the most consequential open problems in the industry right now: measuring the productivity impact of an increasingly AI- and agent-augmented engineering workforce, where there is no textbook answer and real room to set the standard. You'll define new metrics and craft the visual narrative — the charts, dashboards, and presentation materials — that make them land with an executive audience. AI-first workflows are central to how this team operates and critical to succeeding in this role: using AI coding agents is a default part of how you build and maintain pipelines and dashboards. You'll excel in this role if you're as comfortable defining and visualizing a brand new executive-facing metric from a messy signal as you are debugging why a pipeline silently stalled overnight.

You Will

Instrumentation & Telemetry:

  • Instrument and extend the raw telemetry captured about AI usage, code changes, CI/CD activity, and spend — building new data capture, not only transforming what already exists. This is core to the role, as evolving AI tools and increased AI adoption constantly creates new signals that need to be captured.
  • Partner with data engineers on production ETL pipelines that land that telemetry into governed tables, with the freshness monitoring, backfills, and alerting that keep it trustworthy, rather than a one-off script.
  • Define new metrics out of ambiguous or evolving signals, and earn stakeholder trust in a new number by validating and reconciling it until it holds up.

Dashboards & analysis:

  • Build and ship the executive-facing dashboards and visualizations that turn governed metrics into decision-ready reporting — with the polish and precision a room of executives will scrutinize.
  • Run the analysis that a new chart or metric needs and anticipate questions that an executive audience will ask, then bring senior stakeholders a recommendation, not just a number, and defend the methodology behind both.
  • Translate complex, technical findings into a clear narrative: the headline chart and the one sentence that makes an executive act on it.

Across both:

  • Use AI coding agents as a default part of how you write, test, and maintain data pipelines, dashboards, and analyses.
  • Partner across data engineering, applied AI, and data science teams to keep telemetry connected end to end — the raw signal you capture directly feeds the session classifiers, not just the dashboards you build.
  • Turn what the data shows into action: flag where AI spend isn't paying off or where developer friction is most costly, and push the tooling, process, or investment changes that address it.
  • Push the industry-frontier work of quantifying AI and agent productivity impact — there's no established playbook, and this team sets one.

Qualifications

You are: 

  • Self-sufficient across the full analytics loop: instrumentation, pipeline building, metric definition, and dashboards — not someone who hands off past the query.
  • At home in messy, evolving telemetry, with the judgment to know when a new number is right and when it needs a second look before an executive sees it.
  • A strong product thinker: you get at what a stakeholder actually needs from a metric or chart, not just what they asked for.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity on a genuinely unsolved problem — measuring AI/agent productivity impact — and motivated to go set the standard rather than wait for one.
  • An exceptional communicator, able to defend a metric's methodology and a chart's framing directly to senior stakeholders.
  • Thoughtful about using AI coding agents in your own craft: fast to build with them, and rigorous about evaluating what they produce rather than taking it on faith.

You have:

  • 8+ years in analytics engineering, data engineering, or business intelligence, owning production data pipelines and insights end to end.
  • Strong SQL and Python, with hands-on experience building and operating data pipelines against a cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake.
  • Experience partnering with engineering teams to instrument new event or telemetry data, not only transforming what's already captured.
  • Experience building dashboards or internal tools that non-technical stakeholders rely on to make decisions.
  • Comfort with git, CI/CD systems, and debugging production pipeline failures such as retries and backfills.

Even better:

  • Experience with a metrics-governance or semantic-layer system, such as a metrics store, dbt semantic layer, or LookML.

Technologies we use and teach:

  • SQL (Snowflake), Python, TypeScript and React, Git, CI/CD pipelines, a governed metrics store, AI coding agents, and LLM-based classification tooling.

title: Senior Business Resilience Program Manager
locations: Bay Area, CA, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
Block is one company built from many blocks, all united by the same purpose of economic empowerment. The blocks that form our foundational teams — People, Finance, Counsel, Hardware, Information Security, Platform Infrastructure Engineering, and more — provide support and guidance at the corporate level. They work across business groups and around the globe, spanning time zones and disciplines to develop inclusive People policies, forecast finances, give legal counsel, safeguard systems, nurture new initiatives, and more. Every challenge creates possibilities, and we need different perspectives to see them all. Bring yours to Block.

The Role

Block’s Business Resilience is part of the Security Governance Risk and Compliance team. The Business Resilience helps ensure that critical products, services, operations, and supporting technology can continue through disruption and recover within expected timeframes. The team partners across business, technology, risk, compliance, legal, regional entities, and third-party teams to identify resilience risks, validate recovery capabilities, support governance expectations, and drive practical remediation.

This role will help operate and mature Block’s resilience program across business continuity, disaster recovery, crisis management, operational resilience, third-party resilience, testing, reporting, and regulatory compliance support. The role requires someone who can translate resilience requirements into clear business and technology actions, communicate risk in a practical way, and support accountable owners through testing, remediation, and governance.

The ideal candidate is also comfortable improving how resilience work gets done. They should be able to identify manual or repeatable workflows, support AI-enabled and automation opportunities, improve reporting and dashboards, help administer resilience tooling, and build scalable templates, evidence processes, and self-service mechanisms that reduce friction while improving quality, auditability, and regulatory confidence.

You Will

  • Identify resilience risks across critical services, business functions, technology, and dependencies, including risks introduced by business, regulatory, or industry changes.
  • Develop and maintain current, testable business continuity, disaster recovery, and crisis management plans aligned with recovery objectives, strategies, and resource needs.
  • Coordinate resilience exercises and recovery tests, report findings, and partner with accountable owners to track remediation through completion.
  • Assess third-party continuity and recovery capabilities, identify gaps, and support remediation.
  • Communicate resilience posture, open risks, and decisions needed to governance forums, senior leaders, and Boards, and support audit, regulatory, customer, and RFP requests.
  • Partner with regional entities, including the UK, EU, and Canada, to align global practices with local requirements and reduce duplication through shared controls, evidence, and reporting.
  • Improve resilience workflows through AI, automation, dashboards, templates, and self-service tools, supporting requirements, testing, adoption, and troubleshooting with appropriate data, access, auditability, and human review controls.

You Have

  • 6+ years of experience operating or improving global resilience, business continuity, disaster recovery, crisis management, or related risk programs, ideally in financial services or regulated technology.
  • Strong knowledge of impact analysis, dependency mapping, recovery strategies, testing, remediation, and governance, with experience applying relevant standards or regulatory expectations (i.e. ISO22301, BS11200, FFIEC, EBA, FCI, CBI, or RPAA).
  • Strong project management, organizational, and partnership skills, with the ability to manage deadlines and dependencies and drive cross-functional follow-through without direct authority.
  • Excellent communication and analytical judgment, with the ability to translate complex risks and requirements into practical actions for technical, business, executive, and Board-level audiences.
  • Comfort using AI, automation, data analysis, and reporting tools, with the ability to learn and administer new platforms, document processes, and translate stakeholder needs into workflow improvements.
  • A relevant professional certification, such as those from DRI International or the Business Continuity Institute, or equivalent practical experience.

title: Territory Account Executive, Burlington County, NJ
locations: Newark, NJ, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

The Role

Square is building a best-in-class, high-impact field sales organization, and we are looking for an exceptional Territory Account Executive — someone who consistently exceeds expectations, takes full ownership of their territory, and brings Square's mission of economic empowerment directly to the businesses that need it most.

This is a field-driven, execution-focused role designed for individuals who thrive in dynamic, demanding environments. You will spend most of your week out in the market — meeting businesses, conducting live demos, and closing deals with confidence. The pace is fast, the expectations are high, and your ability to operate strategically and decisively will determine your success.

You will serve as Square's presence and competitive advantage in one of our highest-opportunity markets — responsible for building pipeline from the ground up, elevating Square's visibility in your community, establishing high-value partnerships, and helping local businesses grow through our ecosystem of industry-leading software and hardware.

If you are motivated by impactful work, driven to outperform, and eager to join a high-performance team with high standards, this role is built for you.

You will:

Lead your market with disciplined, in-person execution

  • Spend ~80% of your week in the field — walking your territory, engaging local businesses, and driving 50–60 targeted business visits each week.
  • Run a full-cycle, self-sourced sales motion: generate leads, identify needs, deliver compelling demos, and close deals across Square's full product suite.

Establish yourself as the go-to Square expert in your city

  • Build strong, trust-based relationships with local sellers by being present, reliable, and value-driven.
  • Partner cross-functionally to ensure a seamless onboarding experience and fast time-to-value for new sellers.
  • Implement a disciplined referral strategy to turn every new customer into future opportunities.

Build a high-velocity pipeline from the ground up

  • Develop a repeatable top-of-funnel engine through door-to-door outreach, community engagement, events, networking, and targeted partnerships.
  • Work with channel partners to generate a consistent, high-quality referral stream that grows over time.

Master your verticals and sell with precision

  • Build deep expertise in key verticals — including restaurants, retail, and services — to diagnose challenges and position the right Square solutions.
  • Sell consultatively and competitively, staying proactive and strategic throughout the sales cycle.

Achieve exceptional results in a high-accountability environment

  • Maintain strong operational rigor in Salesforce: track activity, manage pipeline, and forecast accurately.
  • Measure performance frequently and improve continuously.
  • Consistently exceed quota within a culture where high standards are the norm.

You have:

  • 3+ years of sales experience in a full cycle closing role with field sales experience
  • Experience exceeding sales targets, selling a diverse ecosystem of products, and closing complex deals
  • Ability to drive deals independently in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
  • Business development experience (e.g. hunting and cold calling)
  • Since this is a field position, you must have reliable transportation and live in the market you are serving
  • A collaborative and team player mentality
  • Prior Salesforce experience or equivalent
  • Even better:
    • 2+ years of payment processing OR related technology (i.e. payroll, loyalty, time management)
    • 1+ years of relevant audience experience (experience working in/selling to restaurants, retailers or services based businesses)

title: Senior Software Engineer, Product Platform
locations: Bay Area, CA, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
Block builds simple, powerful tools that make progress towards an economy that’s truly open to all.

Each of our brands unlocks different aspects of the economy for more people. Square makes commerce and financial services accessible to sellers. Cash App is the easy way to spend, send, and store money. Afterpay is transforming the way customers manage their spending over time. TIDAL is a music platform that empowers artists to thrive as entrepreneurs. Bitkey is a simple self-custody wallet built for bitcoin. Proto is a suite of bitcoin mining products and services. Together, we’re helping build a financial system that is open to everyone. Join us.

The Role

Product Platform Engineering builds and unifies the foundational systems Block engineers use to create, ship, and operate products. Within Product Platform Engineering, the Data Stores team builds the database and storage platforms that help engineering teams manage data safely, reliably, and efficiently.

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer with experience in databases and a generalist mindset. You will build new database platform capabilities, improve the systems engineers depend on every day, and work across backend services, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and developer tooling. This is a software engineering role for someone who enjoys going deep on database problems without being limited to one technical domain. You will ask good questions, make sound technical bets, and use AI as a native part of how you explore, build, test, and learn

You Will

  • Design, build, and operate database and storage platform software that helps Block engineers build reliable products.
  • Build services, APIs, and developer tools that automate database provisioning, schema changes, data migrations, upgrades, and other lifecycle operations.
  • Solve database scaling and performance problems while protecting data correctness, durability, and availability.
  • Work across database behavior, application code, distributed systems, networking, and cloud infrastructure to understand problems and deliver pragmatic solutions.
  • Partner with engineering teams on schema design, query patterns, and platform adoption, turning recurring challenges into reusable capabilities.
  • Help unify and modernize existing data store platforms, reducing operational toil and making safe practices the default.
  • Lead technical projects from problem framing through implementation, testing, rollout, and operational ownership, including on-call participation and incident response.
  • Make thoughtful tradeoffs between performance, reliability, cost, maintainability, and developer experience.
  • Use AI tools to accelerate development and system understanding, while applying careful review, testing, and engineering judgment.
  • Contribute to a culture that values curiosity, direct communication, early ownership, and learning through shipping.

You Have

  • A minimum of 5 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 3 years and a Master’s degree; or equivalent work experience.
  • Experience building and operating backend, infrastructure, or distributed systems, with meaningful experience working with relational databases in production.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals and the ability to work across unfamiliar systems, codebases, and technical domains.
  • A practical understanding of database concepts such as transactions, indexing, replication, schema evolution, and query performance.
  • Experience in one or more areas such as database infrastructure, distributed storage, online migrations, cloud services, Kubernetes, observability, or developer tooling. You do not need prior experience with every technology we use.
  • A track record of turning ambiguous technical problems into clear plans and working solutions.
  • Comfort debugging production systems, explaining technical tradeoffs, and partnering with engineers and technical leaders across teams.
  • Interest in using AI as part of your engineering workflow and helping others apply it thoughtfully.
  • Curiosity, judgment, and a willingness to ask questions early, go deep when needed, and take ownership beyond a single component.

Technologies We Use and Teach

  • MySQL, AWS Aurora, Vitess, DynamoDB, Redis and ElastiCache, OpenSearch, AWS infrastructure, Kubernetes, backend services and APIs, observability tooling, Go, Java, Ruby, and AI-assisted engineering tools.

locations: Bay Area, CA, United States of America
descriptionHtml:

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

About the Role

Square is looking for a senior operations leader to define and manage the global external workforce and partner strategy for seller onboarding. Reporting to the Head of Global Onboarding Operations, this leader will own the operating model for third-party service providers, vendors, and BPO partners, ensuring that external delivery capacity improves seller outcomes while scaling efficiently and responsibly.

This role sits at the intersection of operations, workforce strategy, vendor governance, finance, procurement, legal, and regional execution. The right candidate can evaluate complex build-vs-buy tradeoffs, establish global partner standards, influence senior stakeholders, and create governance mechanisms that improve quality, cost, consistency, and scalability across markets.

What You Will Own

External Workforce Strategy

  • Develop and maintain the global strategy for vendors, third-party service providers, and BPO partners supporting seller onboarding.
  • Partner with regional operations leaders to determine the right labor mix by market, seller segment, service tier, and business need.
  • Lead build-vs-buy analyses and recommend when work should be handled by first-party teams, vendors, BPO, partners, or self-serve models.
  • Create scalable frameworks for external workforce footprint, capacity, quality, cost, and market coverage.

Partner Governance and Performance

  • Establish global SLA frameworks, scorecards, quality standards, business review cadences, and escalation mechanisms for external partners.
  • Hold vendors and BPO partners accountable for operational performance, seller experience, compliance with standards, and continuous improvement.
  • Partner with Procurement, Legal, Finance, and regional teams on contracts, renewals, pricing structures, and commercial terms.

BPO and Vendor Operating Model

  • Oversee the operating model for BPO and vendor-supported onboarding work, including role clarity, performance expectations, enablement, quality assurance, and escalation paths.
  • Ensure partner operations are integrated with Square’s broader onboarding workflows, data, tooling, and seller experience standards.
  • Identify opportunities to improve partner productivity, reduce cost-to-serve, and increase consistency across geographies.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Influence senior leaders across Sales, Finance, Procurement, Legal, and regional teams.
  • Translate external workforce performance and market needs into strategic recommendations for investment, partner selection, and operating model changes.
  • Navigate sensitive partner and stakeholder situations while maintaining strong internal and external relationships.

Team Leadership

  • Manage partner operations managers, BPO leaders, vendor managers, or related teams as the organization evolves.
  • Develop leaders and build a culture of accountability, commercial rigor, operational discipline, and seller-focused execution.

What We Are Looking For

  • 12+ years of progressive operations, vendor management, partner operations, BPO, procurement-adjacent, or workforce strategy experience.
  • Deep experience managing third-party providers, BPOs, vendors, or outsourced service delivery at scale.
  • Strong understanding of SLAs, partner governance, quality assurance, operational scorecards, and business review mechanisms.
  • Experience making build-vs-buy recommendations and managing tradeoffs across quality, cost, speed, scalability, and risk.
  • Strong financial and analytical acumen, including cost modeling, vendor spend management, ROI analysis, and capacity planning.
  • Ability to influence senior stakeholders across several functional areas and gain alignment in complex or sensitive situations.
  • Experience in fintech, commerce, SaaS implementation, customer operations, field services, or scaled services delivery preferred.
  • Clear communication, strong judgment, and comfort operating independently on significant strategic assignments.
  • Experience improving workflows and customer outcomes using AI

Why This Role Matters

Seller onboarding is one of the most important moments in the Square journey. The speed, quality, and consistency of a seller’s first experience directly shape activation, retention, satisfaction, and long-term value. This role helps ensure Square can scale onboarding globally while improving seller outcomes and operating efficiency.

Operating Cadence and Business Management

  • Build and run the core operating cadence for global onboarding, including weekly, monthly, and quarterly business reviews.

title: Head of US Onboarding Operations
locations: Bay Area, CA, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

About the Role

Square is looking for a senior operations leader to own US seller onboarding operations across first-party and vendor-supported delivery motions. Reporting to the Head of Global Onboarding Operations, this leader will translate global onboarding strategy into US operating plans, manage multiple teams and workstreams, and drive measurable improvements in seller activation, time-to-value, service quality, workforce productivity, and cost-to-serve.

This role requires broad operational expertise, strong cross-functional influence, and the ability to make high-quality decisions in ambiguous situations. The right candidate can operate independently on significant assignments, build scalable operating mechanisms, and manage leaders responsible for day-to-day execution across a large and complex market.

What You Will Own

US Onboarding Operations

  • Own US onboarding execution from post-sale handoff through go-live across applicable seller segments, channels, and delivery models.
  • Establish operational objectives, work plans, staffing models, and performance requirements for US first-party and vendor-supported teams.
  • Manage coverage, scheduling, routing, utilization, quality, escalations, and service-level adherence across US operations.
  • Drive accountability for US market performance while implementing global onboarding standards and operating cadences.

Operational Excellence and Performance

  • Improve key metrics including activation, time-to-value, CSAT, SLA adherence, utilization, and cost-to-serve.
  • Use data, frontline insights, and business reviews to identify risks, root causes, and improvement opportunities.
  • Lead process redesign, tooling improvements, automation opportunities, and playbook development for US onboarding workflows.
  • Utilize AI to enhance seller outcomes and improve internal workflows

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner with Sales, Product, Finance, and regional GTM teams to improve seller onboarding outcomes.
  • Influence senior stakeholders on priorities, tradeoffs, resource needs, and operational changes affecting US onboarding.
  • Represent US onboarding operations in cross-functional forums and translate operational data into clear recommendations.

Team Leadership

  • Manage multiple teams, managers, or workstreams within US onboarding operations.
  • Coach and develop operational leaders, raising the bar for judgment, execution, accountability, and seller empathy.
  • Build a culture of ownership, continuous improvement, and high-quality service delivery across distributed teams.

What We Are Looking For

  • 12+ years of progressive operations leadership experience, ideally in technology, fintech, commerce, SaaS implementation, customer success operations, field operations, or scaled services delivery.
  • Experience managing multiple teams or departments with responsibility for staffing, quality, cost, and performance.
  • Strong understanding of workforce planning, capacity management, service delivery operations, and performance management.
  • Experience leading through subordinate managers and influencing senior cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical and financial acumen, including KPI management, budget inputs, forecasting, and cost-to-serve improvement.
  • Ability to operate independently in ambiguous situations while aligning with senior leadership on objectives and outcomes.
  • Experience with vendor-supported operations, field teams, remote onboarding, or blended delivery models preferred.
  • Clear communication, strong judgment, and the ability to gain alignment in sensitive or complex situations.
  • Experience improving workflows and customer outcomes using AI

Why This Role Matters

Seller onboarding is one of the most important moments in the Square journey. The speed, quality, and consistency of a seller’s first experience directly shape activation, retention, satisfaction, and long-term value. This role helps ensure Square can scale onboarding globally while improving seller outcomes and operating efficiency.
