locations: Bay Area, CA, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

About the role

We’re looking for an expert in customer education and digital onboarding to build self-service learning programs that help sellers start transacting with confidence on Square. 

You’ll develop the content, learning modules, and programs that support a high-velocity sales organization serving sellers with different needs, experience levels, and business types. You’ll also guide the development of a new self-service onboarding portal, shaping product and operational decisions alongside Product, Design, and Engineering.

We’re looking for someone who combines deep instructional design expertise with strong product judgment and execution skills. You know how to turn complex setup tasks into useful learning experiences, build content programs that scale, and measure whether customers can apply what they’ve learned.

Reporting to the Head of Global Onboarding Operations, this is a senior individual contributor role. You’ll lead through expertise and influence, working across teams to take programs from concept through launch and ongoing improvement.

What you’ll do

Build self-service learning programs

  • Define the learning strategy for seller onboarding, connecting seller needs with clear learning objectives, content, and measures of success.
  • Design and launch modular learning paths, short-form videos, interactive tutorials, setup guides, webinars, and on-demand courses.
  • Adapt learning paths to different business types, products, roles, and levels of technical experience.
  • Stay close to the work: develop outlines, scripts, storyboards, and sample modules while guiding contributors and production partners.

Shape the self-service onboarding portal

  • Guide product and operational decisions for a portal that brings onboarding guidance, learning resources, and progress tracking into one experience.
  • Translate seller research and learning needs into requirements for navigation, content discovery, guided setup, and personalized recommendations.
  • Partner with Product, Design, and Engineering to prioritize features, evaluate tradeoffs, test prototypes, and launch improvements.
  • Define how sellers move between independent learning, live education, and assisted onboarding when they need additional help.
  • Establish ownership for publishing, maintaining, and improving the portal after launch.

Connect learning to the sales and onboarding journey

  • Design programs for a high-volume sales environment, where sellers need timely guidance without relying on one-to-one training.
  • Partner with Sales and Onboarding to introduce relevant learning at the right moments, from purchase through setup and first use.
  • Develop recommendations, communications, and reminders that help sellers start learning, complete key tasks, and stay on track.
  • Build scalable live training programs, including webinars and group sessions that complement on-demand content.

Measure and improve outcomes

  • Define success beyond content views and course completion: measure setup progress, time to first use, product adoption, seller confidence, and demand for assisted support.
  • Use learning analytics, seller research, support questions, and experiments to identify where sellers get stuck.
  • Test and improve content formats, learning paths, and portal experiences based on evidence.
  • Evaluate AI-assisted guidance and content tools that improve learning and production efficiency, with clear standards for accuracy, privacy, and human review.

What you’ll bring

  • Extensive experience building customer education, digital learning, or self-service onboarding programs at scale, ideally supporting a high-velocity sales organization.
  • A track record of taking customer-facing learning programs from concept to launch and demonstrating improvements in onboarding or product adoption.
  • Deep expertise in instructional design, adult learning, curriculum development, and task-based learning.
  • Hands-on experience producing modular courses, video tutorials, interactive learning, webinars, and written guidance.
  • Experience with learning management systems, digital authoring tools, content management platforms, and learning analytics.
  • Strong product judgment and experience partnering with Product, Design, and Engineering on customer-facing portals or digital learning experiences.
  • Experience building content production and maintenance processes, including quality review, accessibility, localization, and version control.
  • Analytical skills and the ability to connect learning engagement with customer behavior and business outcomes.
  • Strong writing and storytelling skills, with the ability to make complex concepts clear and actionable.
  • The ability to lead complex programs across teams without direct reporting authority, make decisions independently, and align senior stakeholders.

title: Business Intelligence Analyst
locations: San Francisco, CA, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
It all started with an idea at Block in 2013. Initially built to take the pain out of peer-to-peer payments, Cash App has gone from a simple product with a single purpose to a dynamic ecosystem, developing unique financial products, including Afterpay/Clearpay, to provide a better way to send, spend, invest, borrow and save to our 50+ million monthly active customers. We want to redefine the world’s relationship with money to make it more relatable, instantly available, and universally accessible.

Today, Cash App has thousands of employees working globally across office and remote locations, with a culture geared toward innovation, collaboration and impact. We’ve been a distributed team since day one, and many of our roles can be done remotely from the countries where Cash App operates. No matter the location, we tailor our experience to ensure our employees are creative, productive, and happy.

The Role

You will join the Recon and Reporting team, which owns our post-transaction systems: the platform responsible for reconciling money, tracing the end-to-end flow of funds, and meeting our tax and regulatory reporting obligations to merchants, customers, and authorities worldwide. Reconciliation and financial reporting are essential to running a payments business, and given our transaction volume, this role has direct, measurable impact on financial accuracy and trust.

As a Senior Analyst on the team, you will independently own reconciliation and reporting workstreams end to end. You will be the subject matter expert who ensures the numbers tie out: reconciling card-network settlement and report files (Visa, Mastercard, and equivalents), along with data from acquirers, processors, and banks, against our internal payment and ledger data. You will translate ambiguous reconciliation and reporting needs into concrete metrics, controls, and automated solutions, drive discrepancies to root cause and resolution, and directly influence the team's roadmap and the priorities of our finance, accounting, and engineering partners. Our mantra: all funds in the right place, at the right time, for the right purpose.

You Will

  • Independently prioritize, design, develop, and deploy end-to-end reconciliation and reporting solutions: matching logic, break dashboards, exception queues, settlement summaries, and standardized journals that feed downstream accounting, audit, and regulatory processes.
  • Own time-sensitive daily, weekly, and monthly reconciliations across card networks, banking partners, processors, and internal transaction and ledger data, including full ownership of discrepancy management from detection through root cause, corrective action, and control improvement.
  • Translate ambiguous business, finance, and regulatory needs into concrete measurement systems: define and roll out key metrics for the reconciliation and reporting domain (match rates, break aging, time-to-resolution, funding compliance, reporting SLAs) and ensure stakeholders interpret them in the correct context.
  • Serve as the subject matter expert on settlement, funding, and money-movement flows; field questions on transaction lifecycles, data models, and the reconciliation tech stack from stakeholders and leadership.
  • Own the design, development, and documentation of automated SQL-based reporting using best practices, navigating new and unfamiliar datasets to answer complex questions about the flow of funds.
  • Work independently or partner with data engineering to design, build, validate, troubleshoot, and maintain the datasets and pipelines that power reconciliation and reporting, making sound trade-offs between accuracy, implementation effort, and complexity.
  • Proactively identify control gaps, revenue leakage, manual toil, and upstream data-quality issues; drive the automation and process improvements that fix them, and monitor daily settlement and banking activity for irregularities.
  • Own relationships with technical and non-technical stakeholders across Engineering, Product, Accounting, Treasury, Tax, and Compliance; directly influence the priorities, decisions, and roadmap of the team and its partners.
  • Lead month-end close support for the domain: reconciliation reporting, standardized summaries, and audit-ready documentation, including supporting internal and external audits.
  • Define business requirements and test plans for system changes, validate new processes and reconciliation capabilities before deployment, and partner with Engineering and Data teams to resolve bugs and ship enhancements.
  • Help onboard and mentor other analysts, including reviewing code and evangelizing reconciliation and reporting best practices.
  • Apply an AI-first mindset to improve the speed, quality, and insight of analytical work, and guide responsible AI use on the team.

You Have

  • 5+ years of related experience in reconciliation, settlement, payment operations, accounting, or finance analytics with a Bachelor's degree (Finance, Accounting, Economics, a quantitative field, or similar); or 3+ years with a Master's degree; or equivalent work experience.
  • Expert-level SQL, including owning the design, development, and documentation of automated SQL-based reporting, and the ability to navigate new datasets and answer complex questions independently.
  • Demonstrated experience independently owning reconciliation, settlement, or financial reporting workstreams end to end, including defining metrics and driving them to adoption.
  • Strong knowledge of accounting principles, double-entry concepts, and the mechanics of money movement, with the judgment to question the correctness and completeness of financial data.
  • Experience partnering with data engineering (or working independently) to design, build, validate, and maintain data pipelines, with the ability to make sound technical trade-offs.
  • Advanced Excel proficiency (complex formulas, pivot tables) and experience with reconciliation tooling and banking portals.
  • Excellent communication skills: able to own senior stakeholder relationships, present findings and recommendations, and drive clear next steps in areas without clear ownership.
  • Track record of proactively identifying and delivering process improvements and automation in a deadline-driven, high-accuracy environment.

Preferred Experience

  • Deep experience with card-network reconciliation and settlement (Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover), including network settlement, clearing, and report file formats.
  • Strong familiarity with funds-transfer processes and rails (ACH, wire, SWIFT, RTP/FedNow) and the payments ecosystem: merchants, acquirers, issuers, processors, and program banks.
  • Scripting skills (Python or similar) for data analysis and process automation.
  • Experience with cloud data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery) and BI platforms (e.g., Looker, Tableau), including building governed reporting layers with SLAs.
  • Exposure to interchange and fee/cost reconciliation, revenue-leakage detection, and tax or regulatory reporting regimes.
  • Experience supporting audits, internal controls, or SOX-adjacent processes, and mentoring junior analysts.
  • Curiosity about payments products and financial markets.

title: Compliance Technology Program Lead
locations: Bay Area, CA, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
Block is one company built from many blocks, all united by the same purpose of economic empowerment. The blocks that form our foundational teams — People, Finance, Counsel, Hardware, Information Security, Platform Infrastructure Engineering, and more — provide support and guidance at the corporate level. They work across business groups and around the globe, spanning time zones and disciplines to develop inclusive People policies, forecast finances, give legal counsel, safeguard systems, nurture new initiatives, and more. Every challenge creates possibilities, and we need different perspectives to see them all. Bring yours to Block.

The Role

Block is seeking a Compliance Technology Program Lead to ensure our Machine Learning and Heuristic detection models — and the data infrastructure that feeds them — are fit for purpose, for our fiat and virtual currency products. This role sits at the intersection of compliance, machine learning, and AI tooling: you will use modern intelligence tools, including Claude and other LLM-based agents, to automate significant portions of oversight, monitoring, and documentation work — turning a traditionally manual, documentation-heavy function into a scalable, defensible program. You will partner with Machine Learning, Engineering and BSA/AML Policy Teams to provide end-to-end technical oversight, effective challenge and ongoing monitoring throughout the model development lifecycle.

You Will

  • Build with Modern AI Tools: Use AI agents (Claude and similar LLM-based tools) to build automation that scales oversight, monitoring, and documentation work — including drafting requirements, exam-ready documentation, data quality monitoring and ongoing model performance reporting.
  • Design human-in-the-loop checkpoints so that automated outputs remain defensible to regulators and independent monitors.
  • Establish and maintain model and data governance frameworks aligned with SR 11-7, SR 26-2, and OCC 2011-12 so engineering teams can ship defensible models at pace. Provide effective challenge throughout the model development lifecycle and partner with the BSA/AML Policy Team and CAX stakeholders to ensure documentation is exam-ready.
  • Lead Ongoing Monitoring: Lead the design and development of real-time dashboards to monitor model health, including input data monitoring and ongoing model performance.
  • Set standards for threshold tuning and ongoing Below the Line (BTL) testing controls.
  • Establish frameworks and triggers for identifying when model performance is degrading and requires tuning or deprecation. Partner during subsequent tuning exercises and ensure changes are within risk appetite and documented defensibly.
  • Provide End-to-End Oversight of Model Development: Oversee Transaction Monitoring models, including heuristic and rules-based detection logic, threshold settings (below the line testing), and the data pipelines that feed alerts.
  • Oversee blockchain analytics and screening tools (TRM, Chainalysis), with attention to typology coverage, alert quality, and integration with downstream investigations.
  • Oversee Sanctions Screening models (LexisNexis), including list management, fuzzy-match tuning, and false-positive reduction.
  • Oversee Customer Risk Scoring models, including segmentation logic, periodic recalibration, and effective challenge of risk drivers.
  • Oversee the design and validation of AI-driven case resolution — LLM-based and ML-based models that triage, enrich, or disposition alerts — ensuring decisions are explainable, auditable, and defensible to regulators.

You Have

  • 7+ years of experience in compliance technology at regulated financial institutions, or as a consultant working with FIs.
  • Hands-on experience building with modern AI tools — including Claude, GPT, or comparable LLM-based agents — and a track record of using them to automate work in production. This includes prompt engineering, designing agentic workflows, and integrating AI into operational processes.
  • Experience with both Machine Learning and Heuristic models across Transaction Monitoring, Sanctions Screening, and Customer Risk Scoring.
  • Experience with input data quality monitoring.
  • Experience with model performance monitoring.
  • Experience conducting AML model validations aligned with SR 11-7 and OCC 2011-12.
  • Experience responding to examinations and consent orders, and working with regulators and independent monitors.
  • Experience with virtual currencies, including the unique transaction monitoring and sanctions screening considerations they present.
  • Familiarity with blockchain analytics and screening tools such as Chainalysis and TRM Labs.
  • A track record of driving cross-functional initiatives.
  • A working understanding of regulated financial services and corresponding compliance obligations.
  • Familiarity with statistical concepts related to machine learning
  • Expertise in data analytics and visualization

title: Senior Software Engineer, Product Platform
locations: New York, NY, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
Block builds simple, powerful tools that make progress towards an economy that’s truly open to all.

Each of our brands unlocks different aspects of the economy for more people. Square makes commerce and financial services accessible to sellers. Cash App is the easy way to spend, send, and store money. Afterpay is transforming the way customers manage their spending over time. TIDAL is a music platform that empowers artists to thrive as entrepreneurs. Bitkey is a simple self-custody wallet built for bitcoin. Proto is a suite of bitcoin mining products and services. Together, we’re helping build a financial system that is open to everyone. Join us.

The Role

Product Platform Engineering builds and unifies the foundational systems Block engineers use to create, ship, and operate products. Within Product Platform Engineering, the Data Stores team builds the database and storage platforms that help engineering teams manage data safely, reliably, and efficiently.

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer with experience in databases and a generalist mindset. You will build new database platform capabilities, improve the systems engineers depend on every day, and work across backend services, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and developer tooling. This is a software engineering role for someone who enjoys going deep on database problems without being limited to one technical domain. You will ask good questions, make sound technical bets, and use AI as a native part of how you explore, build, test, and learn

You Will

  • Design, build, and operate database and storage platform software that helps Block engineers build reliable products.
  • Build services, APIs, and developer tools that automate database provisioning, schema changes, data migrations, upgrades, and other lifecycle operations.
  • Solve database scaling and performance problems while protecting data correctness, durability, and availability.
  • Work across database behavior, application code, distributed systems, networking, and cloud infrastructure to understand problems and deliver pragmatic solutions.
  • Partner with engineering teams on schema design, query patterns, and platform adoption, turning recurring challenges into reusable capabilities.
  • Help unify and modernize existing data store platforms, reducing operational toil and making safe practices the default.
  • Lead technical projects from problem framing through implementation, testing, rollout, and operational ownership, including on-call participation and incident response.
  • Make thoughtful tradeoffs between performance, reliability, cost, maintainability, and developer experience.
  • Use AI tools to accelerate development and system understanding, while applying careful review, testing, and engineering judgment.
  • Contribute to a culture that values curiosity, direct communication, early ownership, and learning through shipping.

You Have

  • A minimum of 5 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 3 years and a Master’s degree; or equivalent work experience.
  • Experience building and operating backend, infrastructure, or distributed systems, with meaningful experience working with relational databases in production.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals and the ability to work across unfamiliar systems, codebases, and technical domains.
  • A practical understanding of database concepts such as transactions, indexing, replication, schema evolution, and query performance.
  • Experience in one or more areas such as database infrastructure, distributed storage, online migrations, cloud services, Kubernetes, observability, or developer tooling. You do not need prior experience with every technology we use.
  • A track record of turning ambiguous technical problems into clear plans and working solutions.
  • Comfort debugging production systems, explaining technical tradeoffs, and partnering with engineers and technical leaders across teams.
  • Interest in using AI as part of your engineering workflow and helping others apply it thoughtfully.
  • Curiosity, judgment, and a willingness to ask questions early, go deep when needed, and take ownership beyond a single component.

Technologies We Use and Teach

  • MySQL, AWS Aurora, Vitess, DynamoDB, Redis and ElastiCache, OpenSearch, AWS infrastructure, Kubernetes, backend services and APIs, observability tooling, Go, Java, Ruby, and AI-assisted engineering tools.

title: Compliance QA Program Manager
locations: Bay Area, CA, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

The Role

Operating as an independent function, the Compliance Quality Oversight team evaluates and assures the health and effectiveness of AML/CFT and Sanctions Program execution across Compliance Operations. The team is seeking two Program Managers with deep expertise in cryptocurrency and sanctions to focus on these two unique areas to ensure appropriate oversight, sampling, review and coverage of specific typologies, risks and themes, error-rate reporting, and corrective action frameworks are in place for cryptocurrency and sanctions risks and drive continuous improvement in these programs.

You Will

  • Own the end-to-end quality assurance framework application to cryptocurrency and sanctions compliance decisions
  • Partner with key BSA/CFT and Sanctions Program Owners to provide comprehensive, action-oriented reporting on the implementation of their programs
  • Monitor key metrics, raise key insights, risks and themes and drive forward accountability of these areas to improve metrics
  • Ensure that quality standards keep pace with Block's expanding product roadmap and evolving regulatory requirements
  • Work alongside Quality Program Managers and leadership to maintain the quality assurance framework, uphold the standards of the quality program and represent the team to our partners.

You Have

  • 8+ years in BSA/AML/KYC compliance and compliance operations at a financial services firm, preferably payments or fintech
  • A track record of influencing enterprise-wide compliance programs and advising executive leadership on complex matters
  • Strong knowledge of compliance regulations, risks, and typologies, paired with an analytical, metrics-driven approach to building substantiated solutions
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills and the organizational skills to manage competing priorities in an agile, fast-paced environment
  • The ability to execute independently and at a high level while working effectively with team members at all levels
  • Demonstrated AI fluency: framing ambiguous compliance problems for AI, critically evaluating outputs for gaps, bias, or risk, and using AI to accelerate execution without compromising quality or compliance standards
  • Relevant certifications (CAMS, CFE, CFCS, CRCM), and exposure to AI/ML-driven compliance or risk-decisioning tools

locations: Moncton, New Brunswick, Canada
descriptionHtml:
Job title: Territory Account Executive - New Brunswick (Moncton OR Fredericton) 

Square is building a best-in-class, high-impact field sales organization, and we are looking for an exceptional Territory Account Executive — someone who consistently exceeds expectations, takes full ownership of their territory, and brings Square’s mission of economic empowerment directly to the businesses that need it most.

This is a field-driven, execution-focused role designed for individuals who thrive in dynamic, demanding environments. You will spend most of your week out in the market — meeting businesses, conducting live demos, and closing deals with confidence. The pace is fast, the expectations are high, and your ability to operate strategically and decisively will determine your success.

You will serve as Square’s presence and competitive advantage in one of our highest-opportunity markets — responsible for building pipeline from the ground up, elevating Square’s visibility in your community, establishing high-value partnerships, and helping local businesses grow through our ecosystem of industry-leading software and hardware.

If you are motivated by impactful work, driven to outperform, and eager to join a high-performance team with high standards, this role is built for you.

You will:

Lead your market with disciplined, in-person execution

  • Spend ~80% of your week in the field — walking your territory, engaging local businesses, and driving 50–60 targeted business visits each week.
  • Run a full-cycle, self-sourced sales motion: generate leads, identify needs, deliver compelling demos, and close deals across Square’s full product suite.

Establish yourself as the go-to Square expert in your city

  • Build strong, trust-based relationships with local sellers by being present, reliable, and value-driven.
  • Partner cross-functionally to ensure a seamless onboarding experience and fast time-to-value for new sellers.
  • Implement a disciplined referral strategy to turn every new customer into future opportunities.

Build a high-velocity pipeline from the ground up

  • Develop a repeatable top-of-funnel engine through door-to-door outreach, community engagement, events, networking, and targeted partnerships.
  • Work with channel partners to generate a consistent, high-quality referral stream that grows over time.

Master your verticals and sell with precision

  • Build deep expertise in key verticals — including restaurants, retail, and services — to diagnose challenges and position the right Square solutions.
  • Sell consultatively and competitively, staying proactive and strategic throughout the sales cycle.

Achieve exceptional results in a high-accountability environment

  • Maintain strong operational rigor in Salesforce: track activity, manage pipeline, and forecast accurately.
  • Measure performance frequently and improve continuously.
  • Consistently exceed quota within a culture where high standards are the norm.

You have:

  • 3+ years of sales experience in a full cycle closing role with field sales experience
  • Experience exceeding sales targets, selling a diverse ecosystem of products, and closing complex deals
  • Ability to drive deals independently in a fast-paced, dynamic environment 
  • Business development experience (e.g. hunting and cold calling)
  • Since this is a field position, you must have reliable transportation and live in the market you are serving
  • A collaborative and team player mentality
  • Prior Salesforce experience or equivalent
  • Even better:
    • 2+ years of payment processing OR related technology (i.e. payroll, loyalty, time management)
    • 1+ years of relevant audience experience (experience working in/selling to restaurants, retailers or services based businesses)

title: Revenue Content Governance Manager
locations: Los Angeles, CA, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

The Role

The Global Revenue Content team builds the narratives, content, and systems that help sales teams communicate Square and Block’s value to customers. Working across global markets, products, and sales organizations, we develop compelling sales materials—including pitch decks, email templates, one-pagers, and competitive resources—and ensure they are accessible, relevant, and effectively used throughout the sales lifecycle.

As a Revenue Content Governance Manager you will build and manage the systems, processes, and automated workflows that keep critical sales information accurate, current, and accessible. You’ll own our global information governance roadmap, partner with subject-matter experts across the business, and leverage AI and automation to streamline how sales content—including email templates and outreach sequences—is reviewed, updated, approved, and maintained. Working closely with Revenue Content, Information Design, and cross-functional partners, you’ll help create a scalable, intelligent knowledge ecosystem that Sales can trust.

You Will

  • Own the global information governance roadmap, establishing review schedules, maintenance priorities, and scalable processes that ensure sales content and knowledge remain accurate, relevant, and up to date.Design and implement automated governance workflows that streamline content reviews, approval routing, version control, expiration tracking, and archiving, reducing manual effort and improving consistency.
  • Build AI-powered processes to identify outdated, duplicated, or inconsistent information across sales knowledge platforms, helping proactively surface content that requires review or updates.Develop automated review and notification systems that alert content owners and subject-matter experts when information requires validation, approval, or replacement.
  • Oversee governance of sales email content, including approved outreach templates, nurture sequences, competitive emails, and account management communications, ensuring messaging, claims, and product information remain accurate and current.
  • Coordinate cross-functional information reviews, partnering with subject-matter experts across Product Marketing, Product, Competitive Intelligence, Partnerships, Legal, and other teams to validate and maintain critical sales information.
  • Establish clear content ownership and accountability, identifying the appropriate stakeholders responsible for reviewing, approving, and maintaining different types of sales knowledge.
  • Manage governance workflows and timelines, tracking dependencies, review status, approvals, and outstanding updates to ensure information is maintained on schedule.Conduct regular content audits to identify outdated, duplicated, inconsistent, or missing information across sales knowledge platforms and email content libraries.
  • Maintain governance standards across Flockjay, email template repositories, and other knowledge channels, ensuring information follows established taxonomy, metadata, version-control, and publishing requirements.Partner with Enablement Information Design to operationalize information architecture, content organization, and knowledge management standards across global sales teams.
  • Support the governance of competitive and partner integration information, coordinating with the appropriate subject-matter experts to ensure these resources reflect current products, capabilities, and positioning.Develop automated reporting and dashboards that provide visibility into content freshness, review completion, governance compliance, and outstanding risks or gaps.
  • Identify opportunities to integrate AI and automation into existing knowledge management systems, improving the speed, accuracy, and efficiency of information maintenance.
  • Partner with the Global Narrative & AI Lead to develop and test tools that automate repetitive content management tasks and support reliable AI-powered knowledge retrieval.
  • Continuously improve governance processes, using data, feedback, and emerging technologies to reduce duplication, eliminate manual bottlenecks, and scale information management globally.

You Have

  • 6+ years of experience in content operations, knowledge management, information governance, sales enablement, program management, or a related field.Experience designing and managing automated workflows for content operations, knowledge management, or business processes.
  • Hands-on experience with workflow automation tools, AI-powered platforms, or low-code/no-code solutions.Strong understanding of content governance, including review schedules, approval workflows, version control, metadata, and information lifecycle management.Experience managing knowledge platforms such as Flockjay, Highspot, Seismic, or similar tools
  • .Familiarity with sales email templates, outreach sequences, and the systems used to organize and distribute sales communications.Strong project and program management skills, with experience independently managing complex, cross-functional initiatives.
  • Experience building dashboards, tracking operational metrics, and using data to identify inefficiencies and improve processes.Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with an ability to translate operational challenges into scalable, technology-enabled solutions.Experience partnering with Product Marketing, Product, Competitive Intelligence, Partnerships, Legal, and other subject-matter experts to maintain accurate business information.
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams and competing priorities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to drive accountability and follow-through across cross-functional teams.
  • A systems mindset and a proactive approach to identifying opportunities for automation and process improvement.Familiarity with AI-powered search, knowledge retrieval, and content management technologies.Experience supporting global teams or managing content across multiple markets, products, or business segments.

title: Senior Finance Systems Engineer: Oracle Fusion
locations: Bay Area, CA, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
Block is one company built from many blocks, all united by the same purpose of economic empowerment. The blocks that form our foundational teams — People, Finance, Counsel, Hardware, Information Security, Platform Infrastructure Engineering, and more — provide support and guidance at the corporate level. They work across business groups and around the globe, spanning time zones and disciplines to develop inclusive People policies, forecast finances, give legal counsel, safeguard systems, nurture new initiatives, and more. Every challenge creates possibilities, and we need different perspectives to see them all. Bring yours to Block.

About the Role We are looking for a strategic, hands-on Systems Engineer to lead the next wave of finance technology transformation at Block. This role owns the architecture and scaling of the technology stack that powers our core financial engine across Accounting, Tax, Treasury, Procurement, and FP&A.

We operate with an AI-first engineering mindset. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in financial systems architecture (Oracle Fusion) combined with a product-thinking approach, utilizing AI-assisted development to automate financial workflows and compress delivery cycles. You will partner closely with business leaders, product managers, and data engineers to drive high-impact transformation across Oracle Fusion, in-house applications, integration platforms, and enterprise LLMs.

You will:

  • Drive AI-First Development: Embed AI-assisted development tools (Cursor, Claude, GitHub Copilot) into your daily workflow to accelerate delivery velocity.
  • Architect Scalable Financial Solutions: Design and maintain robust data models and solution architectures across Oracle FAH, GL, SLA, and BIP to support complex accounting operations and downstream reporting.
  • Build Intelligent Integrations: Architect, build, and support seamless integrations between accounting systems, data lakes, and internal applications using SQL, PL/SQL and integration technologies (REST, SOAP, JSON).
  • Operational Excellence: Actively identify system inefficiencies and deploy automation to scale financial workflows, decoupling business growth from manual operational overhead.
  • Own Technical Execution: Translate complex accounting principles and business requirements into concrete, scalable technical designs and comprehensive documentation.

Qualifications:

  • Oracle Fusion Expertise: Proven hands-on experience configuring, customizing, and supporting Oracle FAH, GL, SLA, and BIP.
  • Data Engineering Skills: Strong proficiency in relational databases, advanced SQL/PL/SQL, and web services (SOAP, REST, JSON, XML).
  • Systems Architecture: Demonstrated experience in accounting process transformations, financial data modeling, and end-to-end solution architecture.
  • Pragmatic Problem Solver: Ability to navigate complex organizational dependencies, breaking down technical debt into streamlined, automated processes.

Nice to haves:

  • Proficiency in at least one modern programming language (e.g., Python, Go, Java).
  • Experience navigating peripheral financial modules intersecting with accounting data (Tax, FCCS).
  • Previous experience in fintech, banking, or cryptocurrency platforms.

What will make you successful at Block:

  • The Player-Coach Mindset: You are as comfortable advising senior leaders on the art of the possible leveraging a combination of off the shelf platforms like Oracle and in-house built solutions.
  • Holistic Systems Thinking: Ability to collaborate cross-functionally with Accounting, Data Engineering, Product management and Integration teams to deliver unified, automated enterprise solutions.
  • Focus on Business Velocity: A relentless drive to leverage AI and platform automation to compress financial close cycles and expand operating margins.

title: Senior Data Engineer, Product
locations: Bay Area, CA, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
It all started with an idea at Block in 2013. Initially built to take the pain out of peer-to-peer payments, Cash App has gone from a simple product with a single purpose to a dynamic ecosystem, developing unique financial products, including Afterpay/Clearpay, to provide a better way to send, spend, invest, borrow and save to our 50+ million monthly active customers. We want to redefine the world’s relationship with money to make it more relatable, instantly available, and universally accessible.

Today, Cash App has thousands of employees working globally across office and remote locations, with a culture geared toward innovation, collaboration and impact. We’ve been a distributed team since day one, and many of our roles can be done remotely from the countries where Cash App operates. No matter the location, we tailor our experience to ensure our employees are creative, productive, and happy.

The Role

As a Data Engineer, you will handle everything from data architecture and modeling to data pipeline tooling and dashboarding. You will enable a range of other engineering and business teams to make impactful business decisions by laying the foundation of our large and unique datasets that span across multiple products. This role will support the product data engineering team.


The Product Data Engineering Team at Block builds and maintains the curated data foundation that powers all of Block's product lines — Cash App, Square, Afterpay, and Tidal. We transform raw event streams, transactional systems, and operational data into governed, tested, and reliable analytical assets across domains including banking, lending, commerce, investing, checkout, and AI assistants. We partner with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Machine Learning, and Applied AI teams to deliver the metrics, experimentation frameworks, and ML-ready datasets that enable Block's products to grow, improve, and serve customers at scale.

You Will

  • Lead the creation and optimization of data models across eventing, customer-level, and process-level data, leveraging AI-assisted development tools to accelerate delivery.
  • Take shared or independent technical ownership of critical data pipelines across Block — including foundational customer datasets, money transfer and movement pipelines, and the data infrastructure powering Block's experimentation platform.
  • Build monitoring to assess data quality and lineage and further, build AI agents for false positive reduction and automated resolution. 
  • Participate in on-call rotation, monitor daily execution, diagnose and log issues, and fix business critical pipelines to ensure SLAs are met with internal stakeholders. Automate this process through AI agents to focus human effort on highest priority tasks.
  • Work with non-technical partners and product teams to understand their needs, translate business requirements into applicable data requirements, and develop automated end-to-end solutions.

You Have

  • A minimum of 10 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 8 years and a Master’s degree; or equivalent experience.
  • High proficiency in SQL, Python, and Dbt
  • Experience designing medium-to-large data engineering solutions and responsible for the entire lifecycle of projects including scoping, design, development, testing, deployment, and documentation
  • Experience with ETL scheduling technologies with dependency checking, such as Airflow or Prefect, as well as 
  • Experience in schema design and dimensional data modeling
  • Experience with setting up data quality and data lineage monitoring
  • Experience with data driven decisions through AI and agentic automation

Technologies We Use and Teach

  • Snowflake
  • Databricks
  • Dbt
  • Github
  • Airflow
  • Prefect
  • Omni
  • Terraform

title: Foundry Interface Engineer
locations: Singapore, Singapore
descriptionHtml:
Proto is accelerating the world's transition to an open economy with products that increase access and independence for everyone. We're building Bitkey, a simple and safe self-custody bitcoin wallet that will put customers in control, as well as hardware and software that will help decentralize bitcoin mining and enable new and innovative use cases for bitcoin mining. We're developing these products in the open - you can read more about them at bitkey.build and mining.build. Within Proto, our Bitcoin Products team delivers the product and go-to-market strategy, software, firmware, and custom silicon needed to make Bitkey and our ambitious mining initiatives a reality. Come build the future of money with us!
The Role
The Foundry Interface Engineer will engage with Foundry partners/third-party vendors as well as internal teams to continuously improve the design of our ASICs. This work will include partnering with OSAT to continuously monitor and review production wafer test data, and work with standard cell level circuit designers to analyze the results. Based on the analysis the engineer will make requests to the foundry for process fine tuning.
You Will
  • Review and assess Foundry silicon data against SPICE/design goals and compile SPICE to Silicon gap analysis. Drive foundry partners on CIPs to improve foundry process to meet technology entitlement and product goals.
  • Work with foundry to identify potential device parameter changes to enable efficient low-voltage operation
  • Work closely with circuit designers to determine what device improvements could improve circuit performance and energy efficiency
  • Engage with Foundry partners/third-party vendors to manage foundry PDK/DK and design library collaterals
  • Guide internal IP/design teams on appropriate usage of technology attributes/offerings in accordance with product requirements (e.g., performance, power, area, and cost).
  • Collaborate with internal third-party infrastructure, customization, test-chip, methodology, and packaging and product test engineering teams for seamless execution of product bring-up and productization.
  • Work with test engineers to analyze and validate production wafer data
  • Contribute to binning strategy to maximize parametric yield
You Have
  • 10 + years of post-education experience in FAB/Fabless environments, technology definition and bring-up, device/process architecture, and NPI
  • Experience with foundry design kit, SPICE, DR/DRC evaluation, SPICE to Si assessment
  • Experience with advanced node device physics (e.g. FinFET/GAA), backside power, product design phases
  • Experience with product KPIs, DTCO, and parametric, DLY/PLY analysis/gap closure
  • Understanding of low power design techniques (e.g., Vmin reduction, power gating, multi-voltage design, chip power, clock network and optimization)
  • Understanding of layout effects and impact to circuit design
Preferred:
  • Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Physics, or other related Engineering field with emphasis on semiconductor materials/devices and device physics (not a substitute for professional experience)
  • Production test development experience
  • Familiar with advanced FinFET technology nodes (3nm and 2nm)
  • Familiar with PDK and device models
  • Previous work experience at semiconductor foundries
  • Familiar with standard cell design and layout

title: Staff Software Engineer, Payments Acquiring
locations: Seattle, WA, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

The Role

At Block, we strive to build the best financial products in the world. The Financial Platform Acquiring team owns the acquiring side of card payments for Square, Cash App, and Afterpay. When someone pays with a card at a Square seller, through Afterpay, or uses a card to move money in or out of Cash App, our systems make sure that payment happens correctly, every time.

We take in and tokenize card data from chip, tap, digital wallets, and online checkout, route each payment, and get it authorized over our direct network connections and acquiring partners. Then we capture, clear, and settle it, in the US and internationally. Across Square and Cash App, Block processed nearly $260 billion in payment volume in 2025, and we run our own direct connections to card networks in several countries alongside our acquiring partners. When a customer taps their card at a register, our systems route the authorization and bring back the issuer's answer in under a second, around the clock, in partnership with card networks and bank partners.

As a Staff Software Engineer on the Acquiring team, you will bring deep card payments experience to some of the most complex technical work on our roadmap. That work includes expanding our direct network and acquirer connections, delivering network mandates, and making it cheaper and more reliable to accept cards. You will lead one or two of these projects at a time. If you have worked deep in the card payment stack, at a payments company, a card network, or a large merchant, and want to own hard problems at Block's scale, this role is built for you.

This is a hands-on role. You will build systems and tooling, debug at the message level, and turn your payments expertise into durable capabilities that other engineers can use. Much of the team built its payments depth here at Block. You will bring a view of how other companies solve the same problems, and learn our systems from a team that knows them deeply.

In your first year, you will ship at least one of those projects to production, leave behind standards and tooling that make the next one easier, and share what you learned elsewhere so the whole team goes deeper. You will report to the engineering manager for Acquiring.

This role works US West Coast hours, from our Bay Area or Seattle offices or remotely within the Pacific time zone. The team is mostly in US Eastern and Australian time zones, and Pacific hours overlap with US Eastern in the morning and with Melbourne in the late afternoon.

You Will

  • Bring deep card acceptance expertise to the team, reading network specifications, ISO 8583 messages, mandates, and interchange rules, and turning them into sound engineering decisions.
  • Own the technical direction of your projects from design through production rollout, and lead the engineers working on them.
  • Partner with our technical leads, product and finance operations partners, and stakeholders across Square, Cash App, and Afterpay to shape solutions where card-network requirements intersect with Block's acquiring platform.
  • Stay deeply hands-on: write production code, build testing and certification tooling, analyze network messages, review designs and code, and debug issues down to the protocol and field level.
  • Make and defend the technical calls on routing, retries, and processing cost, backed by data on authorization rates and fees.
  • Establish shared frameworks, standards, tooling, and practices that make payments expertise durable so the team makes good payments decisions without routing every question through you.
  • Raise the technical capability of engineers around you through design guidance, code reviews, mentorship, documentation, and clear technical judgment. Help grow the next staff engineers on the team.
  • Build with AI agents across the engineering lifecycle, and help set the patterns for using them safely on systems that move money.
  • Share operational ownership of critical financial systems through on-call, incident response, and continuous improvements to reliability and correctness

You Have

  • Deep card payments experience at the message level: you have built or run the integrations that talk to networks, acquirers, or processors (ISO 8583 or an acquirer's host format), not only called a payment provider's API. Acquiring or merchant-side experience is ideal, and a direct network connection is a strong plus. ISO 20022 is a plus.
  • Experience with the hard cases in real card transactions, such as partial and incremental authorizations, reversals, tips, currency conversion, and interchange qualification.
  • Strong hands-on software engineering experience building and operating highly reliable financial or payments systems at scale, with solid habits in design review, automated testing, and safe, observable rollouts.
  • A track record of leading technically complex projects from design through delivery and setting technical direction for the engineers working on them.
  • Experience creating durable technical leverage — frameworks, standards, tooling, architecture, or practices that other engineers and teams adopt.
  • Broad understanding of how a card payment moves end to end, with depth in areas such as card data security and tokenization, routing, authorization, capture, clearing and settlement, reconciliation, interchange and processing costs, or chargebacks.
  • Solid understanding of card network rules (Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, and US debit networks), and of how acquirers, processors, payment facilitators, and sponsor banks fit between sellers and the networks.
  • Daily experience building with AI coding agents, and good judgment about when their output is right.
  • Willingness to participate in an on-call rotation for critical financial systems.

title: Engineering Manager - Finance & Supply Chain Engineering
locations: Bay Area, CA, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
Block is one company built from many blocks, all united by the same purpose of economic empowerment. The blocks that form our foundational teams — People, Finance, Counsel, Hardware, Information Security, Platform Infrastructure Engineering, and more — provide support and guidance at the corporate level. They work across business groups and around the globe, spanning time zones and disciplines to develop inclusive People policies, forecast finances, give legal counsel, safeguard systems, nurture new initiatives, and more. Every challenge creates possibilities, and we need different perspectives to see them all. Bring yours to Block.

The Role

Block’s Business Platform Engineering organization powers the foundational systems that support financial operations across Square, Cash App, TIDAL, and Proto. We are building the next generation of financial and supply chain infrastructure that enables accurate reporting, operational efficiency, regulatory compliance, and strategic decision-making across Block.

As an Engineering Manager in Finance & Supply Chain Engineering, you will lead a team of engineers building mission-critical systems across areas such as Record-to-Report automation, financial planning and forecasting, tax and regulatory reporting, and supply chain planning and execution.

This is a unique opportunity to help shape a mostly greenfield team and platform from the ground up. You will help build agentic systems that run the business — systems that automate workflows, reason across financial and operational data, assist decision-making, and make critical business processes more efficient, reliable, and scalable.

You will have influence across the full spectrum: team culture, engineering practices, technical strategy, product direction, architecture, and implementation. You will be responsible for building and supporting a high-performing engineering team, shaping technical strategy, partnering closely with Finance, Accounting, Tax, Compliance, Product, and Operations stakeholders, and ensuring the team delivers reliable, scalable, and well-governed systems.

You Will

  • Lead and grow an engineering team: Manage, coach, and develop engineers across a range of experience levels; create clarity, accountability, and growth opportunities for the team.
  • Shape a greenfield platform: Help define the foundations for a new generation of financial and supply chain systems, including the team’s operating model, technical patterns, delivery practices, and long-term architecture.
  • Build agentic systems that run the business: Lead the development of intelligent, automated systems that streamline financial operations, coordinate business workflows, improve decision-making, and reduce manual operational burden.
  • Set technical direction: Partner with engineering leads and cross-functional stakeholders to define architecture, roadmap, and execution plans for financial and supply chain systems.
  • Drive execution: Translate ambiguous business needs into clear technical priorities, delivery plans, and measurable outcomes.
  • Partner cross-functionally: Work closely with Finance, Accounting, Tax, Compliance, Product, and Operations teams to understand business processes and build systems that support critical workflows.
  • Ensure reliability and operational excellence: Hold the team accountable for building well-tested, observable, secure, and resilient systems that support high-stakes financial operations.
  • Navigate complexity: Help the team make pragmatic decisions across legacy systems, integrations, data pipelines, regulatory requirements, agentic workflows, and evolving business needs.
  • Build engineering culture: Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and high-ownership team environment with strong engineering practices, healthy code review, documentation, and incident learning.
  • Develop people and leaders: Provide coaching, feedback, performance management, and career development for engineers; identify and grow future technical leaders

You Have

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience, including 4+ years of experience leading or managing engineers.
  • Experience serving in a technical leadership role with responsibility for delivery, execution, and team health.
  • Strong technical judgment and the ability to guide architecture and design decisions across distributed systems, data-intensive applications, automation platforms, or business-critical systems.
  • Interest in building intelligent or agentic systems that automate complex workflows, improve decision-making, and help teams operate more effectively.
  • Experience partnering with non-technical stakeholders and translating complex business requirements into clear engineering priorities.
  • A track record of delivering reliable, well-tested, and maintainable systems in production.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to create alignment across engineering, product, finance, compliance, and operations teams.
  • Comfort operating in ambiguous domains where business process, regulatory requirements, and technical systems intersect.
  • A strong desire to build healthy teams, grow engineers, influence culture, and shape strategy from early-stage ideas through implementation

Technologies We Use and Teach

You do not need to have experience with every technology listed below, but familiarity with modern application, data, automation, and infrastructure patterns will help you be successful.

  • Languages: Go, Ruby, JavaScript / TypeScript
  • Frameworks: Ruby on Rails, React
  • Databases: MySQL, Snowflake
  • Infrastructure: AWS, S3, Aurora, Docker
  • Orchestration: Temporal, Prefect
  • Testing: Unit tests, integration tests, RSpec, Vitest
  • Monitoring: Datadog, Sentry
  • Protocols: HTTP, JSON, gRPC
  • Emerging systems: Agentic workflows, AI-assisted automation, business process orchestration

locations: Bay Area, CA, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
Block is one company built from many blocks, all united by the same purpose of economic empowerment. The blocks that form our foundational teams — People, Finance, Counsel, Hardware, Information Security, Platform Infrastructure Engineering, and more — provide support and guidance at the corporate level. They work across business groups and around the globe, spanning time zones and disciplines to develop inclusive People policies, forecast finances, give legal counsel, safeguard systems, nurture new initiatives, and more. Every challenge creates possibilities, and we need different perspectives to see them all. Bring yours to Block.

The Role

Employee Experience Engineering (EXE) is part of Block's Corporate Engineering organization, responsible for building and operating the engineering platforms, services, and integrations that improve the employee experience. Our work supports the employee journey from hiring and onboarding through ongoing access to corporate services. We develop internal applications, automate employee workflows, and integrate enterprise systems to deliver seamless, reliable, and scalable experiences. We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer who enjoys solving complex engineering challenges, building reliable systems, and developing thoughtful solutions that make employees' lives easier.

You Will

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable, secure, and reliable internal applications, platforms, and backend services.
  • Develop features and automated workflows that improve the employee experience across hiring, onboarding, and ongoing access to corporate services.
  • Build and maintain APIs and integrations connecting internal platforms, enterprise applications, and third-party services.
  • Own software solutions end-to-end, from technical design and implementation through deployment, monitoring, and ongoing support.
  • Collaborate with Product, Design, Corporate Engineering, People Technology, Security, and other cross-functional teams to translate business needs into technical solutions.
  • Provide technical leadership through architecture discussions, code reviews, mentoring, and engineering best practices.
  • Improve application performance, reliability, observability, and maintainability.
  • Contribute to technical roadmaps, architectural decisions, and long-term platform improvements.
  • Explore emerging technologies, including AI-powered capabilities, to improve employee workflows and engineering productivity.

You Have

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience building and operating production applications.
  • Strong full-stack development experience, including modern frontend and backend technologies.
  • Experience with React, Ruby on Rails, or comparable frameworks.
  • Experience designing, developing, and integrating RESTful APIs and backend services.
  • Experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL.
  • Strong understanding of software architecture, system design, data structures, and engineering fundamentals.
  • Experience with distributed systems, service reliability, and observability.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and production monitoring.
  • Ability to independently drive complex technical projects and collaborate across engineering teams.
  • Strong communication skills, customer empathy, and a passion for delivering excellent employee experiences.

Nice to Have

  • Experience building internal enterprise applications or employee-facing platforms.
  • Experience integrating HR, identity, access management, or other enterprise systems.
  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, particularly AWS.
  • Experience with authentication, authorization, and secure API integrations.
  • Experience automating employee lifecycle workflows, including hiring, onboarding, and access provisioning.
  • Experience with AI-assisted development or integrating AI capabilities into applications.

You'll have the opportunity to build software that directly improves how employees experience Block, from their first interaction with the company through their everyday work. locations: Bay Area, CA, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
Block is one company built from many blocks, all united by the same purpose of economic empowerment. The blocks that form our foundational teams — People, Finance, Counsel, Hardware, Information Security, Platform Infrastructure Engineering, and more — provide support and guidance at the corporate level. They work across business groups and around the globe, spanning time zones and disciplines to develop inclusive People policies, forecast finances, give legal counsel, safeguard systems, nurture new initiatives, and more. Every challenge creates possibilities, and we need different perspectives to see them all. Bring yours to Block.

The Role

Our engineers are only as effective as the tools, codebase, and workflows around them. As a Developer Experience Engineer, you’ll make our large, evolving codebase easier to build, change, and reason about, for both human developers and AI agents.

You will be responsible for the developer experience in our largest monorepos: building tools for and driving framework and language migrations, keeping dependencies healthy, improving build and test infrastructure, and shaping how agentic workflows operate in our development process. This is a high-leverage role. Every improvement you ship multiplies across the whole engineering organization.

What you’ll do

  • Lead and execute large-scale changes across the codebase, including framework upgrades, language migrations, and dependency updates, with minimal disruption to product teams
  • Design and evolve agentic loops: the plan, act, verify, and iterate cycles that let AI agents do real engineering work safely and reliably
  • Identify friction in the developer workflow (slow builds, flaky tests, confusing abstractions) and fix the root causes
  • Improve build tooling and CI performance, including work with Bazel or a comparable build system
  • Build the guardrails, tests, and automation that make large, automated changes safe to land
  • Partner with product engineering teams to understand their pain points and measure the impact of your work
  • Set technical direction and mentor other engineers on migration strategy, tooling, and codebase health

What we’re looking for

Required

  • Significant experience (typically 7+ years for Senior, 10+ for Staff) working in large, complex codebases
  • Deep experience with application or platform frameworks, including upgrading them and managing their evolution over time
  • Track record of leading migrations or large refactors, from planning through rollout
  • Comfort navigating unfamiliar code quickly and making sound changes across many teams’ areas
  • A solid understanding of agentic loops (tool use, context management, verification, failure handling) and a genuine willingness to keep investing in and evolving them as the field changes
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to build trust with teams whose code you’re changing

Nice to have

  • Hands-on experience with Bazel or similar build systems (Buck, Pants, Nx, Gradle, etc.)
  • Experience with codemods, AST-based tooling, or automated refactoring at scale
  • Background in CI/CD, test infrastructure, or developer productivity metrics
  • Experience building or integrating LLM-based coding tools into engineering workflows
  • Open source contributions to build tools, frameworks, or developer tooling

title: Sales Manager, Mid-Market
locations: Toronto, Ontario, Canada
descriptionHtml:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

The Role

We’re building a team of elite sales leaders who raise the performance of everyone around them.

As a Senior Sales Manager, you'll lead a team of approximately 10 Senior Account Executives while owning one of our most important growth levers: developing talent that consistently outperforms expectations. This role isn't about managing activity, it's about building a high-performance sales organization where every hire strengthens the team, every coaching conversation improves execution, and every business decision is grounded in data.

You'll lead our most experienced Account Executives, AEs with 5+ years of full-cycle closing experience, on a fully outbound team where pipeline is strategic and self-sourced across executive networks, partnerships, trade shows, intent data, and more. Your reps own the execution. You sharpen the strategy behind it, and you coach in the work rather than after it. That means diagnosing pipeline health before it becomes a forecasting problem, developing future leaders before promotions become necessary, and building playbooks and an operating rhythm that makes growth predictable.

You'll partner cross-functionally to improve how we sell, challenge the status quo, and continuously raise the talent bar across the organization. Success is measured not only by quota attainment, but by the strength of your team, the quality of your pipeline, and the leaders you develop.

You Will

  • Build a High-Performance Team
    • Hire exceptional Account Executives and raise the talent bar with every addition to your team. 
    • Develop a culture of ownership, accountability, continuous learning and high standards. 
    • Identify future top performers early and create development plans that accelerate their growth. 
  • Coach Through Data & Business Intelligence
    • Lead your business through rigorous pipeline inspection, forecasting and performance diagnostics. 
    • Use leading indicators to identify performance gaps early and coach reps toward sustainable improvement. 
    • Turn data into action by identifying trends, diagnosing root causes and driving measurable improvements across your team. 
  • Drive Operational Excellence 
    • Establish predictable operating rhythms around forecasting, pipeline management and business reviews. 
    • Build disciplined education that creates consistent, repeatable revenue outcomes. 
    • Continuously improve how your team sells by refining processes, simplifying execution and eliminating friction. 
  • Lead Through Influence 
    • Partner closing with sales Leadership, Marketing, Enablement, Operations and Product to improve the customer journey and strengthen commercial execution. 
    • Use customer insights and field intelligence to shape strategy and influence product evolution. 
    • Lead through change by helping your team adapt quickly while maintaining high performance. 

You Have

  • 7+ years experience as a sales manager. 
  • 3 years of documented sales success as an individual contributor exceeding target. 
  • A proven track record leading high-performing sales teams in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
  • Experience leading an outbound-led team, with the ability to coach outbound as a strategy: ICP targeting, multi-channel approach, and pipeline quality over sheer volume, rather than as an activity metric.
  • Success developing Account Executives into top performers through structured coaching and clear performance expectations.
  • Deep expertise in pipeline management, forecasting, and using data to improve business outcomes.
  • Demonstrated experience hiring exceptional talent and building teams that consistently outperform.
  • Strong business judgment with the ability to balance short-term execution and long-term organizational health.
