title: Lifecycle Marketing Manager
locations: Bay Area, CA, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
It all started with an idea at Block in 2013. Initially built to take the pain out of peer-to-peer payments, Cash App has gone from a simple product with a single purpose to a dynamic ecosystem, developing unique financial products, including Afterpay/Clearpay, to provide a better way to send, spend, invest, borrow and save to our 50+ million monthly active customers. We want to redefine the world’s relationship with money to make it more relatable, instantly available, and universally accessible.

Today, Cash App has thousands of employees working globally across office and remote locations, with a culture geared toward innovation, collaboration and impact. We’ve been a distributed team since day one, and many of our roles can be done remotely from the countries where Cash App operates. No matter the location, we tailor our experience to ensure our employees are creative, productive, and happy.

The Role

We’re looking for a Lifecycle Marketing Manager to shape how businesses experience Afterpay and Cash App, from their first touch with us to becoming long-term partners. You’ll build and own our global B2B lifecycle and email strategy, including the plan, the personalized journeys and the test roadmap. Your programs will turn prospects into merchants, get new merchants set up and transacting quickly, and give established merchants what they need to grow. You’ll also use AI to personalize at scale and to learn faster than any single campaign could teach us.

This is a global role focused on North America, the UK and APAC. You’ll build strategies globally but think regionally, so each market gets programs that reflect how its merchants buy, sell and grow. You might start your day in merchant insights and lost-deal notes from Sales, looking for the moment new merchants stall during setup. By the afternoon, you’ve turned that insight into a personalized onboarding journey that gets them transacting faster. You’ll report to the Global B2B Commerce Growth Lead and work closely with Sales, Marketing & Revenue Operations, Account-Based Marketing, Content, Partnerships, Product and Compliance.

You Will

You will develop a global lifecycle and email marketing strategy that:

  • Thinks like a customer, using merchant insights to help prospects solve their problems, improve their business and see the value of Afterpay and Cash App.
  • Grows net new merchants through personalized nurture journeys that move prospects to opportunities and signed merchants.
  • Gets new merchants set up and transacting as quickly as possible, then helps them adopt more of our products.
  • Helps established merchants grow at scale, increasing transaction volume and engagement with Block.
  • Delivers thought leadership, product releases, events and growth opportunities that increase merchant engagement, retention and lifetime value.
  • Keeps merchants with us through churn prevention and winback programs.
  • Sets lifecycle best practices so prospects and merchants are happy and succeed with Block.
  • Uses AI to personalize content, sharpen segmentation, and speed up production and learning.

Day-to-day:

  • Own the full prospect and merchant lifecycle across every segment, from small businesses to enterprise.
  • Build global strategies but think regionally: get to know the needs of each market and adapt one global framework to fit them.
  • Work with regional sales leaders to understand their needs, find gaps in the customer journey, and turn those insights into new journeys and improvements.
  • Lead email for product go-to-market and thought leadership, partnering with Product Marketing, Content and regional teams.
  • Own the email test roadmap: write hypotheses, run A/B and multivariate tests, and share what you learn across the team.
  • Test and grow lifecycle channels and tactics beyond email.
  • Set up regular reporting and feedback loops with sales and regional teams, showing how lifecycle programs affect pipeline, merchant transaction volume and retention.

You Have

  • Minimum 5 years experience owning B2B lifecycle, email or CRM marketing, ideally for global, sales-led products serving businesses of all sizes.
  • Experience measuring lifecycle impact on attributed, influenced and incremental revenue, retention and merchant engagement, and presenting results to leadership.
  • Hands-on Marketo experience building emails, nurture programs, dynamic content and audience segments.
  • Working knowledge of Figma or similar software for designing and building email creative.
  • Experience designing, running and measuring lifecycle growth and testing strategies.
  • AI fluency, with a track record of using AI tools to scale marketing programs.
  • Experience managing programs from idea to launch across multiple teams and time zones.
  • Experience partnering with sales and regional leaders to understand their needs and turn them into lifecycle programs that drive results.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality,  book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

The Role

Join the Square Account Management team and help merchants thrive within our ecosystem! As a Retention Account Manager, you'll partner with SMB business owners across all verticals to help them rediscover the value of our platform. In this role, you'll engage with merchants at critical moments in their journey, leveraging retention strategies to reduce churn and fuel long-term partnership. You'll support clients as a trusted advisor, using product knowledge and negotiation to turn challenging moments into growth opportunities.

This is your chance to be a pivotal force for SMBs across the United States—guiding entrepreneurs to a path of stability, growth and scale. You’ll join a team that values curiosity, resilience and mutual success for clients & stakeholders. If you're energized by the power of small business and excited to shape the future of how we serve them, we’d love to have you with us.

You will thrive in this role if you love thinking on your feet, refining talk tracts/playbooks, a strong history of story telling/post-mortem write ups and love having the hard conversations that leave customers saying “if it wasn’t for you, I wouldn’t be here today.”

You Will

  • Be responsible for retaining a multi-million dollar client base
  • Understand SMB customer needs across all verticals 
  • Deploy retention strategies to mitigate churn and increase contract adoption
  • Strategically address customer concerns and competitive threats
  • Help evolve our retention motion through insights on product, operational, and competitive gaps
  • Work with our Sales, Support, Product and Analytics, teams to future proof our retention strategies 

You Have

  • 5+ years experience in Sales, Account Management, or related field
  • Experience discovering and closing both retention & growth opportunities
  • Experience successfully managing a pipeline to achieve revenue targets
  • Excellent negotiation & financial literacy skills
  • Excellent storytelling & vision setting skills
  • Excellent organizational, analytical, written, and verbal communication skills
  • Passion and knowledge about how new technologies can help better serve small and medium size businesses

descriptionHtml:
We started a movement in which everyone can win – shoppers, retailers, society and every person on our team. To play fair, trust people and reward them for doing the right thing. We see and feel the impact of our work as more and more people gain financial freedom and retailers grow across the globe.

Founded in 2014 in Sydney, Australia, Afterpay has over 24 million active customers globally and more than 250,000 of the best retailers around the world including  DSW, Finish Line, Levi’s, Primark, and M&S,and many others.

Afterpay, and now Clearpay in the UK, are helping people spend responsibly! We empower customers to access the things they want and need, while still allowing them to maintain financial wellness and control, by splitting payments in four, for both online and in-store purchases. Clearpay is deeply committed to delivering positive outcomes for customers. Now under the Block ecosystem, we are focused on supporting our community of shoppers.

We trust in the next generation and share a vision of a more accessible and sustainable world in which people are rewarded for doing the right thing. Join a movement in which everyone can win. 

Job Description

Reporting to the Head of Mid Market and Enterprise Sales, you will join a successful dynamic team. We are looking for a passionate, and committed outbound Account Executive to engage and sell Clearpay to Mid Market merchants across the UK.

You Will:

  • Outbound prospect via email and phone to generate new opportunities
  • Manage the entire sales funnel 
  • Facilitate conversations with senior executives and business owners at target accounts
  • Develop a strong pipeline of opportunity
  • Identify the metrics and key value propositions that will drive mutually beneficial contracts
  • Clearly demonstrate our USP's over and above our competitors
  • Negotiate and close long term contracts that benefit both Clearpay and our partners
  • Be accountable to your target and demonstrate control of your opportunities through pipeline management and CRM
  • Use defined sales methodology to progress opportunities
  • Work with internal stakeholders from sales leadership to marketing through to finance to define contracts

You have:

  • 5+ years of full cycle sales and closing experience
  • Proven track record of delivering or exceeding targets
  • Can demonstrate success in a 360 sales role
  • Proven experience of selling at senior executive level and above
  • Experience of working with e-commerce, payments, fintech or retail verticals
  • A level of formal sales and negotiation training
  • Genuine curiosity about people, business, and can inspire this passion in others
  • Interest in seeking out and implementing feedback, and dedication to the improvement of your craft
  • Tenacity and an ability to adapt to new situations quickly and think on your feet
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills that help you connect with customers by email and phone to establish trust and credibility
  • The ability to drive deals independently in a fast-paced, dynamic environment Business development experience (e.g. hunting and cold calling)
  • A collaborative and team player mentality

Build and own trusted relationships with C-level decision-makers, and make the case for Square yourself when the deal demands it.
  • Partner cross-functionally to win: Work closely with Solutions Engineering, Product, Partnerships, Legal, Finance, Marketing, Customer Success, implementation, and sales leadership to align internal teams around strategic opportunities, and move deals forward.
  • Turn market insight into business impact: Bring customer, competitor, partner, and market feedback back into Square to influence product, pricing, packaging, partnerships, and go-to-market strategy.

You Have

  • 10+ years of enterprise or strategic sales experience, including a strong track record of exceeding targets and closing complex, high-value deals
  • 3+ years of people leadership experience, with a demonstrated record of leading enterprise teams to hit revenue targets and of hiring, ramping, and developing Account Executives who perform
  • Experience leading enterprise teams in complex platform, SaaS, fintech, payments, data, or commerce environments
  • Experience building pipeline-generation motions, including outbound prospecting, account-based programs, and partner-sourced opportunities
  • Proven ability to build territory, segmentation, and coverage strategies in a developing or high-growth market
  • Deep experience leading teams through complex, multi-threaded sales cycles involving executive, technical, procurement, legal, and finance stakeholders
  • Commercial acumen to coach teams on pricing, negotiation, business case development, deal structure, and deal economics
  • Operating and analytical discipline across pipeline management, forecasting, account planning, and deal inspection, with comfort using data to improve conversion and make resource decisions
  • Executive presence and credibility—you communicate with precision, challenge constructively, and earn trust with senior decision-makers
  • Technical curiosity and the ability to sell business value across APIs, integrations, data, automation, and emerging AI use cases
  • A customer outcomes mindset, with experience partnering across pre-sales, implementation, customer success, product, and support to set newly won enterprise sellers up for a successful launch
  • A builder mentality—you create clarity in ambiguity, take ownership of outcomes, and are energized by building the playbook, not just running an existing one

title: Head of Workforce Optimization
locations: Bay Area, CA, United States of America
department: 30122 Risk - Customer Operations - Cash App Foundation
descriptionHtml:
Block is one company built from many blocks, all united by the same purpose: economic empowerment. We build technology that increases access and independence for sellers, individuals, and artists around the world. Working at Block means working on and across our brands—Square, Cash App, Afterpay, TIDAL, Spiral, and Proto - in roles that connect, enable, and push all of them forward faster.

We’re remote-first by design and operate with intelligence at the center of everything we do. At Block, you'll be challenged by some of the brightest, most creative minds in the industry and have the tools and autonomy to do the most meaningful work of your career. 

The Role

Workforce Optimization sits within Block Operations and connects planning, operations, finance, product, engineering, and our global partner network. Reporting to the Head of Operations, you will lead the combined Workforce Optimization function supporting customer-facing operations and regulated Risk & Compliance work across thousands of internal and external analysts / customer advocates, and multiple vendors around the world. You will create one operating model for forecasting, staffing, real-time management, vendor governance, analytics, and automation. This will give Block the capacity and specialist skills it needs while balancing service, quality, regulatory obligations, and cost. This is an opportunity to shape how a global workforce of employees, partners, and AI systems works together and to move the function from automated visibility toward predictive, increasingly self-optimizing decisions.

You Will

  • Set the strategy and operating model for the combined Workforce Management function, establishing clear ownership, common methods, decision rights, and a measurable maturity roadmap.
  • Own long-range forecasting and capacity planning across a 12–36 month horizon, translating customer demand, regulatory cycles, audits, incidents, product changes, and automation into hiring, partner, and financial plans.
  • Connect long-range plans to 1–8 week staffing commitments, schedules, and intraday actions so operations can address coverage and capacity risks before service or regulatory commitments are affected.
  • Define service and staffing strategies across customer support and back-office work, balancing response times, backlog, quality, specialist skills, employee experience, occupancy, resilience, and cost.
  • Establish consistent governance for global business process outsourcing partners, including capacity locks, performance measures, business reviews, corrective actions, and 24/7 escalation protocols.
  • Build a trusted analytics foundation with shared metric definitions, live performance visibility, forecast-accuracy tracking, scenario planning, and clear narratives that help leaders act.
  • Partner with product, engineering, data science, and operations teams to prioritize automation by measurable value, incorporate expected automation benefits into plans, and create effective ways of working across people and AI systems.
  • Embed regulatory capacity planning and quality feedback loops into the broader model while preserving the controls and domain expertise required for Risk & Compliance operations.
  • Lead workforce incidents and capacity escalations with clear response standards, after-action reviews, near-miss tracking, and durable improvements to processes and tools.
  • Align operations, finance, compliance, vendor, product, and executive leaders on assumptions, tradeoffs, commitments, and emerging risks.
  • Build, develop, and organize a multidisciplinary team spanning planning, real-time management, analytics, tooling, and vendor governance, while creating clear development paths and reducing key-person dependencies.

You Have

  • A minimum of 15 years of related experience within Workforce Management, Operations, Data Science or related functions.
  • Experience leading and transforming a global Workforce Management function with responsibility for forecasting, capacity planning, scheduling, real-time management, workforce analytics, and vendor governance.
  • Experience supporting both high-volume customer operations and back-office or regulated operations, with an understanding of how their demand patterns, service measures, skills, and controls differ.
  • Demonstrated success building operating models and teams across regions, internal employees, and outsourced partners while maintaining service, quality, resilience, and financial discipline.
  • Experience moving workforce decisions from manual reporting toward automated and predictive systems using data, statistical or machine-learning models, scenario planning, and clear human guardrails.
  • The ability to translate complex operational and financial data into decisions, influence senior leaders across functions, and create alignment when priorities or incentives compete.
  • Experience partnering with product, engineering, data science, finance, operations, and compliance teams to turn business changes and automation roadmaps into credible workforce plans.
  • Experience establishing controls for regulated capacity, vendor quality, incidents, and corrective actions, with sound judgment about when efficiency gains introduce unacceptable risk.
  • A record of developing leaders and specialists, clarifying accountability, and leading teams through significant organizational and technological change.

Technologies We Use and Teach

  • Assembled, Snowflake, SQL, Google Workspace, Block-built planning and reporting applications, and AI and automation tools. We do not expect you to arrive knowing every tool; we value the ability to choose and govern the right systems for the work.

title: Territory Account Executive, Toronto
locations: Toronto, Ontario, Canada
descriptionHtml:
Territory Account Executive, Toronto

Square is building a best-in-class, high-impact field sales organization, and we are looking for an exceptional Territory Account Executive — someone who consistently exceeds expectations, takes full ownership of their territory, and brings Square’s mission of economic empowerment directly to the businesses that need it most.

This is a field-driven, execution-focused role designed for individuals who thrive in dynamic, demanding environments. You will spend most of your week out in the market — meeting businesses, conducting live demos, and closing deals with confidence. The pace is fast, the expectations are high, and your ability to operate strategically and decisively will determine your success.

You will serve as Square’s presence and competitive advantage in one of our highest-opportunity markets — responsible for building pipeline from the ground up, elevating Square’s visibility in your community, establishing high-value partnerships, and helping local businesses grow through our ecosystem of industry-leading software and hardware.

If you are motivated by impactful work, driven to outperform, and eager to join a high-performance team with high standards, this role is built for you.

You will:

Lead your market with disciplined, in-person execution

  • Spend ~80% of your week in the field — walking your territory, engaging local businesses, and driving 50–60 targeted business visits each week.
  • Run a full-cycle, self-sourced sales motion: generate leads, identify needs, deliver compelling demos, and close deals across Square’s full product suite.

Establish yourself as the go-to Square expert in your city

  • Build strong, trust-based relationships with local sellers by being present, reliable, and value-driven.
  • Partner cross-functionally to ensure a seamless onboarding experience and fast time-to-value for new sellers.
  • Implement a disciplined referral strategy to turn every new customer into future opportunities.

Build a high-velocity pipeline from the ground up

  • Develop a repeatable top-of-funnel engine through door-to-door outreach, community engagement, events, networking, and targeted partnerships.
  • Work with channel partners to generate a consistent, high-quality referral stream that grows over time.

Master your verticals and sell with precision

  • Build deep expertise in key verticals — including restaurants, retail, and services — to diagnose challenges and position the right Square solutions.
  • Sell consultatively and competitively, staying proactive and strategic throughout the sales cycle.

Achieve exceptional results in a high-accountability environment

  • Maintain strong operational rigor in Salesforce: track activity, manage pipeline, and forecast accurately.
  • Measure performance frequently and improve continuously.
  • Consistently exceed quota within a culture where high standards are the norm.

You have:

  • 3+ years of sales experience in a full cycle closing role with field sales experience
  • Experience exceeding sales targets, selling a diverse ecosystem of products, and closing complex deals
  • Ability to drive deals independently in a fast-paced, dynamic environment 
  • Business development experience (e.g. hunting and cold calling)
  • Since this is a field position, you must have reliable transportation and live in the market you are serving
  • A collaborative and team player mentality
  • Prior Salesforce experience or equivalent
  • Even better:
    • 2+ years of payment processing OR related technology (i.e. payroll, loyalty, time management)
    • 1+ years of relevant audience experience (experience working in/selling to restaurants, retailers or services based businesses)

title: Senior Software Engineer, Developer Experience
locations: Bay Area, CA, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
Block is one company built from many blocks, all united by the same purpose of economic empowerment. The blocks that form our foundational teams — People, Finance, Counsel, Hardware, Information Security, Platform Infrastructure Engineering, and more — provide support and guidance at the corporate level. They work across business groups and around the globe, spanning time zones and disciplines to develop inclusive People policies, forecast finances, give legal counsel, safeguard systems, nurture new initiatives, and more. Every challenge creates possibilities, and we need different perspectives to see them all. Bring yours to Block.

About the role

More and more of our engineering work now runs through autonomous agents, and those agents can only be as effective as the tools, context, and codebase around them. As a Developer Experience Engineer, you'll build the tooling and agent workflows that let humans and agents change our largest monorepos quickly and safely.

You'll own the interfaces engineers use to observe, steer, and give context to the agents working on our code. You'll also build the guardrails that keep complexity in check as those agents take on bigger changes. Large-scale work like framework upgrades, language migrations, and dependency health is still part of the job, but you'll do it by building and steering agents rather than making the changes by hand. This is a high-leverage role. Every improvement you ship multiplies across the whole engineering organization.

What you’ll do

  • Build and ship the tools engineers and their agents use every day, such as CLIs, desktop integrations, and interfaces for observing, unblocking, and steering autonomous agents, and own their adoption, distribution, and support
  • Design and evolve agentic loops (the plan, act, verify, and iterate cycles) and the harnesses, skills, and context that let agents do real engineering work reliably
  • Build agent workflows that drive large-scale changes across the codebase, including framework upgrades, language migrations, and dependency updates, with minimal disruption to product teams
  • Build the guardrails, tests, and automation that make large, agent-authored changes safe to land, and track the leading indicators of growing complexity
  • Find friction in the development workflow for both humans and agents, and fix the root causes
  • Partner with builders inside and outside of engineering to understand their pain points, and measure the adoption and impact of what you ship
  • Set technical direction and mentor other engineers on agent design, tooling, and codebase health

What we’re looking for

We care more about what you've done than about which specific technologies you used to do it.

Required

  • Shipping developer tooling at scale: You've shipped tools that engineers use daily, such as CLIs, desktop integrations, configuration management, or internal platforms. You understand what it takes to drive adoption, debug problems, and support users.
  • Scaling work with agents: You've built agent workflows that finished work that would normally take a team weeks. Examples include generating codebase summaries or world models, writing skills and loops, or orchestrating a team of semi-deterministic agents. You have a deep understanding of agentic loops (tool use, context management, verification, failure handling) and are eager to keep evolving them as the field changes.
  • Evolving frameworks and large codebases: You have deep experience with application or platform frameworks, including upgrading them and managing their evolution over time. You also have a track record of leading migrations or large refactors from planning through rollout.
  • Significant experience (typically 10+ years for Staff, 7+ for Senior) working in large, complex codebases
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to build trust with teams by owning the outcomes of your work

Nice to have

  • Experience with harness engineering or context engineering
  • Experience with agent observability, for example through OpenTelemetry
  • Experience distributing internal tools (versioning, release channels, auto-update) and measuring adoption with telemetry or surveys
  • Background in developer productivity metrics, test infrastructure, or CI/CD
  • A passion for intuitive user experience and good taste in elegant solutions
  • Open source contributions to developer tooling or agent frameworks

title: Territory Account Executive, Halifax
locations: Halifax, Nova Scotia, Canada
descriptionHtml:
Square is building a best-in-class, high-impact field sales organization, and we are looking for an exceptional Territory Account Executive — someone who consistently exceeds expectations, takes full ownership of their territory, and brings Square’s mission of economic empowerment directly to the businesses that need it most.

This is a field-driven, execution-focused role designed for individuals who thrive in dynamic, demanding environments. You will spend most of your week out in the market — meeting businesses, conducting live demos, and closing deals with confidence. The pace is fast, the expectations are high, and your ability to operate strategically and decisively will determine your success.

You will serve as Square’s presence and competitive advantage in one of our highest-opportunity markets — responsible for building pipeline from the ground up, elevating Square’s visibility in your community, establishing high-value partnerships, and helping local businesses grow through our ecosystem of industry-leading software and hardware.

If you are motivated by impactful work, driven to outperform, and eager to join a high-performance team with high standards, this role is built for you.

You will:

Lead your market with disciplined, in-person execution

  • Spend ~80% of your week in the field — walking your territory, engaging local businesses, and driving 50–60 targeted business visits each week.
  • Run a full-cycle, self-sourced sales motion: generate leads, identify needs, deliver compelling demos, and close deals across Square’s full product suite.

Establish yourself as the go-to Square expert in your city

  • Build strong, trust-based relationships with local sellers by being present, reliable, and value-driven.
  • Partner cross-functionally to ensure a seamless onboarding experience and fast time-to-value for new sellers.
  • Implement a disciplined referral strategy to turn every new customer into future opportunities.

Build a high-velocity pipeline from the ground up

  • Develop a repeatable top-of-funnel engine through door-to-door outreach, community engagement, events, networking, and targeted partnerships.
  • Work with channel partners to generate a consistent, high-quality referral stream that grows over time.

Master your verticals and sell with precision

  • Build deep expertise in key verticals — including restaurants, retail, and services — to diagnose challenges and position the right Square solutions.
  • Sell consultatively and competitively, staying proactive and strategic throughout the sales cycle.

Achieve exceptional results in a high-accountability environment

  • Maintain strong operational rigor in Salesforce: track activity, manage pipeline, and forecast accurately.
  • Measure performance frequently and improve continuously.
  • Consistently exceed quota within a culture where high standards are the norm.

You have:

  • 3+ years of sales experience in a full cycle closing role with field sales experience
  • Experience exceeding sales targets, selling a diverse ecosystem of products, and closing complex deals
  • Ability to drive deals independently in a fast-paced, dynamic environment 
  • Business development experience (e.g. hunting and cold calling)
  • Since this is a field position, you must have reliable transportation and live in the market you are serving
  • A collaborative and team player mentality
  • Prior Salesforce experience or equivalent
  • Even better:
    • 2+ years of payment processing OR related technology (i.e. payroll, loyalty, time management)
    • 1+ years of relevant audience experience (experience working in/selling to restaurants, retailers or services based businesses)

The Role

Square Financial Services is seeking an IT Audit Senior Manager with deep technical audit expertise and direct experience auditing regulated financial institutions. In this role you will lead and personally execute risk-based operational, technology, and cybersecurity audits from risk assessment and scoping through testing, reporting, and remediation validation. As well as assess the systems, infrastructure, applications, and technology service providers supporting banking activities, including services delivered through affiliated entities.

You Will

  • Plan and perform risk-based IT audits, including technical walkthroughs, control design assessments, operating effectiveness testing, workpaper preparation, and reporting.
  • Assess technology and cybersecurity risks across identity and access management, privileged access, cloud and infrastructure security, network security, vulnerability management, security monitoring, and incident response.

  • Contribute to audit methodology, coach colleagues, and support integrated audits by assessing technology risks within broader banking processes.

You Have

  • 7+ years of IT audit experience, including substantial hands-on responsibility for engagements within a regulated financial institution.
  • Strong understanding of internal controls, risk assessment, and audit methodologies, with experience driving continuous improvement in audit processes, risk coverage, and/or issue management.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex issues into clear, actionable insights for technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to apply data analytics and artificial intelligence (AI) tools across the audit lifecycle to strengthen risk assessment and testing.

  • Executive presence and sound judgment, with a demonstrated capacity to build cross-functional relationships and influence stakeholders.

We would also value

title: Ecosystem Partner Development Lead
locations: Bay Area, CA, United States of America
department: 20417 S&M - Marketing - Cash App Brand Experience
descriptionHtml:
It all started with an idea at Block in 2013. Initially built to take the pain out of peer-to-peer payments, Cash App has gone from a simple product with a single purpose to a dynamic ecosystem, developing unique financial products, including Afterpay/Clearpay, to provide a better way to send, spend, invest, borrow and save to our 50+ million monthly active customers. We want to redefine the world’s relationship with money to make it more relatable, instantly available, and universally accessible.

Today, Cash App has thousands of employees working globally across office and remote locations, with a culture geared toward innovation, collaboration and impact. We’ve been a distributed team since day one, and many of our roles can be done remotely from the countries where Cash App operates. No matter the location, we tailor our experience to ensure our employees are creative, productive, and happy.

The Role

The Block Ecosystem Partnerships team leads product partnerships, business development, and commercialization for Afterpay, Cash App, and Square. We develop partnerships that extend the capabilities and reach of our products across the payments and technology industries, building relationships with leading companies in payments, finance, and technology.

We’re looking for an experienced business development and partnerships leader to define and own the global strategy for a portfolio of high-impact partnerships and emerging opportunities. You’ll identify where we should invest, shape our approach, and lead execution across teams to turn those opportunities into measurable business results.

A significant part of this role will involve leading multiple zero-to-one initiatives where the product, partnership model, or go-to-market approach may not yet exist. You’ll bring structure to open-ended opportunities, develop the strategic rationale and commercial model, and work with cross-functional leaders to take ideas from initial concept through launch and scale. This requires strong business judgment about which opportunities to pursue, what not to prioritize, and when to change direction.

You’ll work closely with leaders across Afterpay, Cash App, and Square, including Product, Engineering, Sales, Account Management, Marketing, Finance, Compliance, and Legal. Beyond delivering results for your portfolio, you’ll build repeatable approaches that improve how teams develop, launch, and grow partnerships.

You will:

  • Define and own partnership strategy: Set the long-term growth direction for your partnership area. Translate customer needs, payments economics, competitive developments, and emerging technologies into clear priorities, investment recommendations, and execution plans. Balance near-term commercial results with longer-term opportunities, including agentic commerce.
  • Build new opportunities from zero to one: Identify unmet customer and partner needs, develop business cases, and shape new partnership and distribution models. Lead multiple initiatives in parallel, establishing direction where there is no existing playbook.
  • Make commercial and investment decisions: Evaluate market potential, unit economics, strategic fit, and execution requirements. Recommend which opportunities to pursue or decline, with clear tradeoffs, resource needs, and expected returns.
  • Turn early bets into scalable businesses: Define experiments, milestones, and criteria to scale, pivot, or stop. Lead opportunities through partner development, negotiation, integration, launch, and commercialization. Turn successful approaches into repeatable models that other teams and markets can adopt.
  • Own portfolio performance: Take accountability for the commercial outcomes and long-term health of your partnerships. Establish success measures, assess performance, and adapt strategy as products, partner priorities, and market conditions evolve. Coordinate with colleagues working with the same partners to create a coherent global approach.
  • Build executive relationships and lead complex negotiations: Earn trust with senior decision-makers while maintaining effective working relationships across partner organizations. Structure and negotiate agreements that expand distribution, extend product capabilities, and support sustainable economics, including situations where partners may also be competitors.
  • Shape cross-functional priorities and resolve blockers: Translate strategy into clear product dependencies, resource requirements, ownership, and delivery plans. Influence roadmap and investment decisions, resolve competing priorities across teams, and bring clear recommendations to senior leaders when tradeoffs require broader decisions.
  • Commercialize products globally: Develop distribution strategies for business-to-business and business-to-business-to-consumer payment products, including new integrations, upsell, and cross-sell opportunities. Expand our reach through partner platforms while accounting for regional customer, regulatory, and operational requirements.
  • Build practices that scale beyond your portfolio: Establish shared planning cadences, decision frameworks, and accountability across participating teams. Improve how opportunities are evaluated and partnerships are executed. Mentor senior colleagues and other leaders, helping them navigate ambiguity and make stronger strategic and commercial decisions.

Qualifications

  • 12+ years of experience across business development, strategic partnerships, and commercialization, with deep experience in payments or financial technology. Demonstrated ownership of business strategy and commercial outcomes across complex partnerships, products, or markets.
  • A proven track record of building new businesses or partnership models from zero to one. Experience identifying opportunities, developing business cases, shaping product and go-to-market strategy, negotiating complex agreements, and delivering measurable growth.
  • Strong commercial and strategic judgment, including evaluating investment tradeoffs, assessing unit economics, prioritizing resources, and influencing senior leaders on which opportunities to pursue, scale, or stop.
  • Deep knowledge of consumer and business payments, including payments economics, distribution models, and competitive dynamics. Ability to translate market developments and emerging business models into actionable growth strategies.
  • Proven ability to build C-suite relationships and navigate complex organizations. Expert negotiation skills, a strong understanding of commercial contracts, and experience managing dynamics that may be simultaneously cooperative and competitive.
  • Strong product fluency and experience working with multiple Product and Engineering teams for a single partner. Ability to connect customer needs, technical capabilities, integration requirements, and commercial value.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence without formal authority, resolve organizational blockers, and secure cross-functional commitment to shared priorities. Experience building repeatable frameworks or operating practices that improve execution beyond your immediate responsibilities.
  • Entrepreneurial ownership and sound decision-making in ambiguous, fast-changing environments. Ability to guide senior colleagues and communicate strategy, risks, and tradeoffs clearly.
  • Willingness to travel, primarily domestically with some international travel.
  • BS/BA required. An MBA or other master’s degree is a plus.

title: Implementation Specialist
locations: Melbourne, Australia
descriptionHtml:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

The Role

The Global Seller Onboarding (GSO) team partners directly with Square’s largest and most complex sellers (what we call our clients) to ensure they fully realize the value of Square’s products and services. As an Implementation Specialist, you will lead the technical onboarding and activation of new merchants, delivering a seamless, scalable, and high-quality onboarding experience.

In this role, you will work cross-functionally with Sales, Account Management, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to implement Square deployments for primarily SMB sellers. For certain sellers, you may engage pre-sale to support discovery, solution validation, and the positioning of Square’s professional services offerings. This role is pivotal to Square’s upmarket growth strategy and to shaping the enterprise seller experience from initial solution design through activation.

You Will

  • Engage with sellers post-sales to support scoping, planning, and solution validation.
  • Advise on and document Square's product capabilities and limitations to ensure clear, accurate expectations are set with prospective sellers.
  • Own and manage multiple onboarding projects concurrently, balancing competing priorities, timelines, and resource constraints.
  • Build strong cross-functional partnerships with Sales & Account Management.
  • Collaborate effectively with technical partners and clearly communicate technical requirements to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Proactively identify and manage risk throughout the onboarding lifecycle, ensuring consistent stakeholder communication and successful outcomes.
  • Support data entry and data migration activities as part of the onboarding process for select sellers.
  • Maintain deep expertise in Square's platform and ecosystem, providing guidance on technical and product capabilities to optimize the seller experience.
  • Act as a liaison between sellers and Product teams, translating requirements into actionable feature requests and roadmap input.
  • Demonstrate professionalism, collaboration, and strong executive presence while working under deadlines with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Identify process gaps and drive improvements by leveraging scalable AI-powered automation.
  • Travel up to 10% for client meetings, hardware installations, and other internal events.

You Have

  • 3+ years of experience in a customer-facing role, including 2+ years of experience in project management, implementation, or onboarding
  • Proven ability to manage multiple complex projects simultaneously across competing priorities, timelines, and resources.
  • Strong ability to distill complex requirements into tailored solutions and communicate technical concepts clearly and concisely.
  • Working knowledge of project management methodologies, tools, and best practices.
  • Experience in the POS, payments, or broader technology industry.

title: Director, Global Tax Information, Reporting & Withholding
locations: Bay Area, CA, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
Block is one company built from many blocks, all united by the same purpose of economic empowerment. The blocks that form our foundational teams — People, Finance, Counsel, Hardware, Information Security, Platform Infrastructure Engineering, and more — provide support and guidance at the corporate level. They work across business groups and around the globe, spanning time zones and disciplines to develop inclusive People policies, forecast finances, give legal counsel, safeguard systems, nurture new initiatives, and more. Every challenge creates possibilities, and we need different perspectives to see them all. Bring yours to Block.

The Role

You will lead customer and payee tax reporting, documentation, and withholding across Square, Cash App, Afterpay, and our other Block businesses. You will also lead the team and providers, embed requirements in products and onboarding, modernize operations to improve compliance and customer experience.

You Will

  • Own global reporting and withholding strategy, governance, and implementation of regulatory changes.
  • Own Forms 1099 and 1042-S, including filing, recipient delivery, reconciliations, and corrections. Lead digital asset reporting, including applicable cost basis and transfer-reporting requirements. 
  • Own backup and foreign-person withholding, including under Chapters 3 and 4, state obligations, deposits, reconciliations, and Forms 945 and 1042.
  • Lead applicable FATCA, Form 8966, CRS, DAC7, Australian and other local reporting.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, and Data to build and test documentation, reportability, withholding, and reporting logic, including W-9/W-9 validation, W-8 expiration tracking, TIN matching, and remediation. .
  • Lead notices, B-Notice processes, examinations, and penalty defense, including CP2100/CP2100A, Notice 972CG, reasonable cause, and abatement. .
  • Own reporting and withholding controls; coordinate SOX requirements with Tax Reporting and Internal Audit. 
  • Develop the team and manage platforms and providers, with clear responsibilities, review standards, escalation, and backup coverage. 
  • Deliver an automation roadmap with Tax Technology and Engineering, improving data quality, controls, timeliness, cost, and customer experience. 

You Have

  • 10+ years of information reporting and withholding experience, including high-volume operations in payments, fintech, digital assets, or financial services. 
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field. CPA, MST, or JD strongly preferred.
  • Deep 1099, Chapters 3 and 4, FATCA, and CRS expertise, with hands-on withholding, deposit, reconciliation, and related filing experience. .
  • Experience translating tax requirements into tested product specifications; advanced transaction-data analysis skills. 
  • Experience rebuilding high-volume workflows and delivering measurable improvements through automation or AI. 
  • Experience leading high-volume notice, penalty, and examination responses, including reasonable and abatement.
  • People leadership and clear communication of reporting risk to technical, business, and executive audiences

Even Better

  • Form 1099-DA or other digital asset reporting implementation.
  • Platform implementation or migration, high-volume corrections, and coordination with Support, Legal, and Compliance.

Technologies We Use and Teach

  • We expect tax leaders to redesign processes, implement AI and automation, and develop team capabilities. Validate outputs and maintain technical accuracy, documentation, controls, and audit defensibility within Block's data governance and privilege protocols.

locations: Bay Area, CA, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
Block is one company built from many blocks, all united by the same purpose of economic empowerment. The blocks that form our foundational teams — People, Finance, Counsel, Hardware, Information Security, Platform Infrastructure Engineering, and more — provide support and guidance at the corporate level. They work across business groups and around the globe, spanning time zones and disciplines to develop inclusive People policies, forecast finances, give legal counsel, safeguard systems, nurture new initiatives, and more. Every challenge creates possibilities, and we need different perspectives to see them all. Bring yours to Block.

The Role

Block is looking for a Director, Tax Provision & Compliance to lead consolidated ASC 740 reporting, effective tax rate forecasting,  income tax disclosures, SOX controls,  and U.S. federal and state income tax compliance. Partner with International Tax, Tax Planning & Controversy, Accounting, Financial Reporting, Treasury, and advisors to identify Y significant matters early and implement supported conclusions consistently in the provision and returns.  

This hands-on role leads the team and providers, coordinates close and filing priorities, and modernizes processes through technology and automation.

You Will

  • Own the quarterly and annual worldwide income tax provision: current and deferred computations, effective tax rate reconciliation, deferred tax inventory and valuation allowance assessments, stock-based compensation, uncertain tax positions, and return-to-provision true-ups
  • Own the tax journal entries, account reconciliations, income tax footnote and disclosures, and the supporting workpapers and SOX controls; manage the financial statement audit relationship with our Big 4 auditors
  • Coordinate the international components of the provision with the team and outside advisors, and drive continuous improvement in close speed and quality
  • Manage the US federal and state income tax compliance program, working with our co-sourced Big 4 providers: returns, estimated payments and extensions, elections and disclosures, and the compliance calendar
  • Own cash tax forecasting and support tax authority notices, examinations, and audit defense
  • Drive automation and tax technology adoption across the provision and compliance processes, including AI tooling
  • Prepare and review technical memos documenting positions for auditors and leadership, and model the cash tax and effective tax rate consequences of proposed structures for Corp Dev, Finance, and Legal while deals are being negotiated
  • Mentor and develop tax team members and help build the function as the company grows
  • Manage outside advisors on opinions, studies, and valuations, and own those budgets and relationships

You Have

  • 10+ years of corporate income tax experience with deep ASC 740 reporting and U.S. federal and state compliance expertise, including public accounting (Big Four or equivalent) and in-house public company experience.
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field. CPA required.
  • Direct ownership of a public company consolidated provision, including interim reporting, the effective tax rate modeling, and discrete items.
  • Experience preparing SEC income tax disclosures and supporting conclusions with external auditors.
  • Hands-on ownership of  multi-entity federal consolidated and of multistate income and franchise returns 
  • Deep experience with book-to-tax adjustments, return-to-provision analysis, and Section 382 testing and limitation calculations.
  • Hands-on income tax SOX experience including control design, operation, documentation, testing support, and remediation. 
  • A record of managing federal and state examinations, including negotiating with examiners and resolving assessments.
  • Experience directing and reviewing provider work across provision and compliance.  
  • Write clear, well-organized technical memos that hold up with Big 4 auditors, and can explain the same issue in plain terms to non-tax partners
  • People leadership across provision and compliance, including developing talent and managing overlapping close and filing priorities. 
  • A record of implementing process redesign, automation, or AI workflows with measurable improvements in quality, controls, timeliness, or cost.

Even Better

  • Payments, financial services, fintech, digital assets, or technology experience, including digital asset tax accounting.
  • Experience with a reported non-GAAP effective tax rate.
  • Experience with financial-receipts sourcing and apportionment rules for financial services.
  • Experience building tax tools with Engineering, Data or business technology teams.

Technologies We Use and Teach

  • We expect tax leaders to redesign processes, implement AI and automation, and develop team capabilities. Validate outputs and strengthen technical accuracy, documentation, controls and audit defensibility within Block’s data governance and privilege protocols.

title: Bilingual Implementation Specialist
locations: Los Angeles, CA, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
Overview 

The Global Seller Onboarding team works directly with sellers and internal teams to ensure they are able to take full advantage of Square’s products and services. Global Seller Onboarding Specialists work closely with teams within Sales & Account Management as well as Product Specialists and Product Marketing Managers to deliver a seamless and exceptional merchant experience and give key input into the product roadmaps for customer-facing developer products. Additionally, Global Seller Onboarding Specialists play a key role in merchant discovery and lead the final stages of the sale, working with Square's upmarket sellers and cross-functional teams to successfully implement and activate new accounts.

Square initially pioneered the simple self-service model to enable small businesses to take a payment. Now, we aspire to expand that same seamless experience up-market. This position will play a pivotal role in establishing seller success needed for us to drive growth, retention, and scale our services up-market. We’re working to find new and better ways to help businesses succeed on their own terms—and we’re looking for people like you to help shape tomorrow at Square.

Seller Onboarding Expert - L3 (IC)

You Will (Responsibilities):

Strategic Onboarding & Education (Estimated 70% of work)

  • Guide sellers (customers) to start transacting with Square quickly and with confidence, delivering high-quality onboarding and implementation experiences for Square’s SMB and mid-market sellers
  • Lead seller-facing scoping and onboarding calls, help sellers along their onboarding journey by delivering tailored, necessary training content, and support sellers after they begin transacting with Square
  • Learn and maintain a strong understanding of relevant product features and releases
  • Execute onboarding best practices consistently while escalating complex product or technical needs.
  • Balance the needs of numerous (20-30) sellers at any given time, ensuring successful completion of each onboarding engagement

Project / Process Execution (Estimated 20% of work)

  •  Identify issues or blockers that could affect a seller’s onboarding experience or go-live date, and escalate appropriately to senior team members or cross-functional partners.
  • Contribute to improvements in onboarding processes by documenting gaps, proposing refinements, and sharing observations from seller engagements.
  • Maintain clear, proactive communication with assigned sellers and demonstrate the ability to maintain an onboarding tracker with key milestones, target dates, and next steps to keep sellers informed and on track for go-live.
  • Help sellers understand and complete the steps required for launch, following up on outstanding needs and confirming readiness ahead of their target go-live date.
  • Use AI to improve the seller experience and automate or enhance internal processes.

🤝 Team Collaboration & Skill Development (Estimated 10% of work)

  • Share best practices with peers and contribute to a positive team culture.
  • Take ownership of keeping product knowledge current, including new features, updates, and known limitations, to provide sellers with accurate guidance.
  • Support team knowledge areas (POS, Online, integrations) by developing product expertise and serving as a go-to resource for standard questions.
  • Participate in internal meetings, training, roadmap updates, and optimization discussions to build broader product and organizational understanding.
  • Escalate product, process, or policy issues clearly and promptly to senior teammates and product teams; assist in resolving routine internal or client concerns.
  • Demonstrate reliability and consistency in onboarding execution while learning to manage more complex workflows.
  • Comfortable working in a high-volume, high-tempo, customer-focused onboarding environment.

You Have (Qualifications):

  • Full language proficiency in English and any second language, preferably Spanish
  • 2–4+ years of experience in onboarding, implementation, operations, or account management customer support, customer success; relevant industry experience (restaurant, services, retail) is a plus.
  • Demonstrated strong performance and consistency in onboarding work (metrics, CSAT, responsiveness, quality).
  • Experience managing multiple onboarding projects simultaneously with reliable delivery.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; professionalism in client and stakeholder interactions.
  • Proactive attitude and eagerness to learn; ability to apply feedback quickly.
  • Strong time-management and organizational skills.
  • Comfort operating through change and ambiguity with appropriate support.
  • Familiarity with project management practices.
  • Basic understanding of data analysis or reporting tools (Looker, Salesforce, etc.) is a plus.
  • Strong understanding and consistent usage of AI tools and platforms

At Square, we want you to be well and thrive. Our global benefits package includes:

  • Healthcare coverage
  • Retirement Plans
  • Work from home flexibility 
  • Employee Stock Purchase Program
  • Wellness perks
  • Paid parental leave
  • Paid time off
  • Learning and Development resources

title: SMB Account Executive
locations: Sydney, Australia
descriptionHtml:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

The Role

At Square, we’re re-imagining how mid-market businesses grow. As an Account Executive on our SMB Market Team, you’ll bring Square’s ecosystem to new sellers across diverse industries by building, shaping, and closing your own pipeline. You’ll run sophisticated, multi-product deals from the first touch to final close — blending hunter instincts, consultative depth, and strategic execution.

If you’re an experienced closer who thrives in outbound environments, loves solving meaningful business challenges, and consistently delivers against ambitious targets — this is your role.

You Will

  • Own the full outbound sales cycle — from prospecting to negotiation to close — with SMB merchants.
  • Build and manage a high-quality pipeline through cold outreach, social selling, targeted campaigns, and creative outbound strategies.
  • Develop multi-product solutions across Square’s ecosystem and tailor them to each merchant’s unique needs.
  • Partner with Business Development on lead flow while independently driving net-new logo acquisition.
  • Conduct high-impact discovery, demos, and negotiations with decisiveness across multi-stakeholder deals.
  • Act as a consultant and trusted advisor — seamlessly flexing across BDR, AE, and AM responsibilities when needed.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Marketing, Implementation, and Operations to deliver cohesive solutions.
  • Maintain disciplined pipeline management and forecasting accuracy in Salesforce.
  • Consistently hit and exceed revenue goals — monthly and quarterly.

You Have

  • 1-2 years of full-cycle B2B sales experience with consistent quota achievement.
  • Proven success in outbound prospecting and net-new business creation (SaaS or fintech preferred).
  • Experience closing complex, multi-threaded deals 
  • Ability to build pipeline from scratch using targeted, strategic outreach.
  • Exceptional communication, presentation, and negotiation skills across phone, video, and written channels.
  • Strong consultative selling skills — diagnose business challenges and map tailored solutions.
  • A hunter’s mindset — resilient, creative, and driven to win.
  • Ability to work independently while contributing to a team-first environment.
  • Advanced proficiency with Salesforce and modern sales tools.
  • BA/BS degree or equivalent experience.

Square has an established enterprise presence in Australia, supporting businesses including Thisbowl, The Pancake Parlour, and Brunetti Oro with technology that connects payments, commerce, and operations. You’ll lead our enterprise account management team, with accountability for growing and retaining our existing customer portfolio - and building on that foundation to deliver Square’s next phase of enterprise growth.

This is a player-coach role. You’ll set the commercial direction, lead and develop your account managers, and stay directly involved in strategic opportunities. You’ll bring commercial judgement and practical leadership to complex account strategies, executive relationships, and negotiations.

With significant growth potential ahead, you’ll have the opportunity to shape an important part of Square’s Australian business. The role offers high visibility among global leaders, direct engagement with global teams, and scope to influence Square’s global enterprise approach. You’ll combine meaningful commercial responsibility with the opportunity to progress your career as the business scales.

You Will

  • Own enterprise portfolio performance. Set and deliver the strategy for retention, account growth, and product adoption. Make clear choices about where the team invests its time and how Square creates long-term value for customers.
  • Lead and develop your account managers. Set clear commercial priorities and performance expectations. Provide coaching relevant to each account manager’s experience and career objectives, and create opportunities for continued development through complex accounts and strategic deals.
  • Stay directly involved in strategic deals. Work alongside account managers to shape deal strategy, engage executive stakeholders, and lead complex negotiations.
  • Lead strategic customer relationships. Engage executive decision-makers to understand business priorities, demonstrate the value Square delivers, and agree opportunities to deepen the relationship.
  • Lead enterprise commercial execution. Lead account and opportunity reviews that sharpen strategy, test assumptions, and improve commercial decisions. Maintain clear accountability for growth plans, opportunity qualification, and forecast accuracy.
  • Apply sound commercial judgement. Balance growth, retention, pricing, and account economics. Work with Finance, Legal, and other stakeholders to reach agreements that create value for customers and Square.
  • Navigate a distributed global organisation. Align colleagues in Australia and across global teams, including Product, Engineering, Sales, Support, Risk, Finance, and Legal. Resolve competing priorities and secure the decisions needed to deliver for enterprise customers.
  • Shape Square’s enterprise priorities in Australia. Bring a clear view of customer needs, competitive dynamics, and portfolio risks. Turn that insight into recommendations that inform product and commercial decisions.

You Have

  • 12+ years of professional experience, including substantial commercial responsibility for growing and retaining complex business accounts.
  • 3+ years of direct people leadership experience in a commercial role, with a track record of developing account managers, building a high-performing culture, and delivering team commercial outcomes.
  • A track record of consistently exceeding commercial objectives, through both your own contribution and the performance of your team.
  • Deep commercial experience, including personally shaping complex deals, negotiating agreements, evaluating trade-offs, and building business cases.
  • Experience with enterprise sales processes, including qualification, stakeholder mapping, procurement, negotiation, and forecasting. You know how to apply that discipline to growth within existing accounts.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with experience aligning cross-functional teams, navigating competing priorities, and influencing decisions across a distributed global organisation.
  • Credibility with executive decision-makers and the ability to build alignment across commercial, operational, and technical stakeholders.
  • The ability to understand enterprise technology requirements and work with technical specialists to connect product capabilities, integration considerations, and customer business needs.
  • A hands-on leadership approach. You combine clear direction with practical coaching and direct contribution to complex commercial work.

Fintech or payments experience is welcome, but not required. Enterprise commercial depth, leadership capability, and sound judgement matter more.

locations: Bay Area, CA, United States of America
descriptionHtml:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

The role

We’re looking for an Engagement Marketing Lead to help Square sellers discover more value in our products and build lasting relationships with Square. You’ll lead a team that turns seller insights into strategies that drive product adoption, deepen engagement, and deliver measurable business growth.

You’ll bring together audience strategy, messaging, experimentation, and channel planning to create relevant, connected experiences across the seller journey. Working closely with Product and cross-functional partners, you’ll set priorities, develop your team, and balance long-term growth opportunities with business commitments. The role has global scope, with an initial focus on the U.S.

You will

  • Lead and develop the engagement marketing team. Set outcome-based goals, coach senior strategists, and define quarterly priorities, owners, and dependencies while delivering business commitments.
  • Own cross-product growth priorities. Size opportunities and allocate capacity based on seller needs and business impact. Partner with Product on adoption, monetization, and the end-to-end seller experience.
  • Establish proactive go-to-market planning. Align Product, Growth, Brand, Sales, Customer Insights, Creative, and channel partners on launch support, audiences, messaging, ownership, and resource tradeoffs.
  • Lead program-wide experimentation. Partner with Data Science on coordinated holdouts and incremental measurement. Test recommendations, messaging, incentives, and channels; use evidence and economics to decide what to scale, refine, or stop.
  • Establish communications governance. Set ownership, eligibility, frequency, sequencing, suppression, and risk-based review standards. Resolve competing messages, prevent over-messaging, and protect required communications.
  • Scale execution responsibly. Partner with Lifecycle Operations, GTM Automation, and external agencies on production and automation. Retain accountability for strategy, approvals, access, quality, and escalation.
  • Oversee portfolio delivery and partnerships. Hold owners accountable for launches, ongoing growth, incentives, and partnership commitments. 

You have

  • 10+ years in engagement marketing or equivalent experience demonstrating senior-level impact. A track record of leading teams and delivering measurable portfolio growth.
  • Experience developing senior strategists and partnering with Product leaders. You can align teams, resolve tradeoffs, and establish clear accountability.
  • Strong analytical judgment and hands-on fluency with SQL and analytics tools. You can diagnose seller behavior, size opportunities, assess economics, and distinguish incremental impact from attributed results.
  • Deep experimentation experience and the ability to turn imperfect evidence into clear investment decisions.
  • Strong positioning and messaging skills, with experience connecting audience insight, product value, and channel strategy.
  • Experience building cross-program communications governance and translating strategy into actionable briefs, journey designs, and test plans with Lifecycle Operations.
  • Fluency with lifecycle platforms, personalization, and delivery controls, with experience partnering with Engineering and Data Science on shared capabilities.
  • Clear executive communication, sound judgment in ambiguity, and practical experience using AI to improve the quality or speed of your work.
  • Experience with small-business customers, multi-product platforms, regulated products, agency partnerships, or international growth is valuable.

title: Head of Enterprise Accounts, Australia
locations: Sydney, Australia
descriptionHtml:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

The Role

Square has an established enterprise presence in Australia, supporting businesses including Thisbowl, The Pancake Parlour, and Brunetti Oro with technology that connects payments, commerce, and operations. You’ll lead our enterprise account management team, with accountability for growing and retaining our existing customer portfolio - and building on that foundation to deliver Square’s next phase of enterprise growth.

This is a player-coach role. You’ll set the commercial direction, lead and develop your account managers, and stay directly involved in strategic opportunities. You’ll bring commercial judgement and practical leadership to complex account strategies, executive relationships, and negotiations.

With significant growth potential ahead, you’ll have the opportunity to shape an important part of Square’s Australian business. The role offers high visibility among global leaders, direct engagement with global teams, and scope to influence Square’s global enterprise approach. You’ll combine meaningful commercial responsibility with the opportunity to progress your career as the business scales.

You Will

  • Own enterprise portfolio performance. Set and deliver the strategy for retention, account growth, and product adoption. Make clear choices about where the team invests its time and how Square creates long-term value for customers.
  • Lead and develop your account managers. Set clear commercial priorities and performance expectations. Provide coaching relevant to each account manager’s experience and career objectives, and create opportunities for continued development through complex accounts and strategic deals.
  • Stay directly involved in strategic deals. Work alongside account managers to shape deal strategy, engage executive stakeholders, and lead complex negotiations.
  • Lead strategic customer relationships. Engage executive decision-makers to understand business priorities, demonstrate the value Square delivers, and agree opportunities to deepen the relationship.
  • Lead enterprise commercial execution. Lead account and opportunity reviews that sharpen strategy, test assumptions, and improve commercial decisions. Maintain clear accountability for growth plans, opportunity qualification, and forecast accuracy.
  • Apply sound commercial judgement. Balance growth, retention, pricing, and account economics. Work with Finance, Legal, and other stakeholders to reach agreements that create value for customers and Square.
  • Navigate a distributed global organisation. Align colleagues in Australia and across global teams, including Product, Engineering, Sales, Support, Risk, Finance, and Legal. Resolve competing priorities and secure the decisions needed to deliver for enterprise customers.
  • Shape Square’s enterprise priorities in Australia. Bring a clear view of customer needs, competitive dynamics, and portfolio risks. Turn that insight into recommendations that inform product and commercial decisions.

You Have

  • 12+ years of professional experience, including substantial commercial responsibility for growing and retaining complex business accounts.
  • 3+ years of direct people leadership experience in a commercial role, with a track record of developing account managers, building a high-performing culture, and delivering team commercial outcomes.
  • A track record of consistently exceeding commercial objectives, through both your own contribution and the performance of your team.
  • Deep commercial experience, including personally shaping complex deals, negotiating agreements, evaluating trade-offs, and building business cases.
  • Experience with enterprise sales processes, including qualification, stakeholder mapping, procurement, negotiation, and forecasting. You know how to apply that discipline to growth within existing accounts.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with experience aligning cross-functional teams, navigating competing priorities, and influencing decisions across a distributed global organisation.
  • Credibility with executive decision-makers and the ability to build alignment across commercial, operational, and technical stakeholders.
  • The ability to understand enterprise technology requirements and work with technical specialists to connect product capabilities, integration considerations, and customer business needs.
  • A hands-on leadership approach. You combine clear direction with practical coaching and direct contribution to complex commercial work.

Fintech or payments experience is welcome, but not required. Enterprise commercial depth, leadership capability, and sound judgement matter more.

locations: New York, NY, United States of America
descriptionHtml:

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time.
